title: The price of locality: Maxwell-Cattaneo charge transport in Schwinger-Keldysh effective field theory
summary: We determine the conditions under which the nonlinear Maxwell-Cattaneo theory of charge transport admits a local Gaussian Schwinger-Keldysh embedding with a particular modified dynamical KMS symmetry. We show that treating the additional vector as intrinsically dissipative fundamentally modifies the entropy-current analysis: the hydrostatic generating functional no longer fixes all entropy-current improvements, which must instead be supplied independently. Subsequently we discuss the additional constraints not contained in the hydrodynamic analysis that are imposed by the modified KMS transformation becoming a symmetry of the action. We both interpret and supply the corresponding stochastic quasi-hydrodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非线性Maxwell-Cattaneo电荷输运理论何时允许具有修正动力学KMS对称性的局部高斯Schwinger-Keldysh嵌入，并给出相应随机准流体力学描述。
AI.motivation: 确定非线性Maxwell-Cattaneo输运理论可嵌入Schwinger-Keldysh框架的条件，并理解耗散性矢量场对熵流分析的影响。
AI.method: 将附加矢量视为内禀耗散量，重新进行熵流分析；研究修正KMS变换成为作用量对称性所施加的额外约束，并构造随机准流体力学。
AI.result: 发现静水生成泛函不再能固定所有熵流改进项，这些改进须独立给出；同时得到超出流体力学分析的额外约束，并提供对应的随机准流体力学。
AI.conclusion: 非线性Maxwell-Cattaneo理论在一定条件下可具有局部高斯Schwinger-Keldysh嵌入，但需独立指定熵流改进项并满足修正KMS对称性的额外约束。

title: Strain-Induced Helical Superconductivity and the Zero-Field Diode Effect
summary: Motivated by the strain-induced zero-field superconducting diode effect observed in PbTaSe$_2$, we identify a mechanism by which strain generates nonreciprocal superconducting transport without magnetism or an external magnetic field. Uniaxial strain mixes a dominant $s$-wave order parameter with a subdominant two-component pairing channel and enhances their symmetry-allowed Lifshitz coupling. Beyond a critical strain, this coupling drives a transition into a helical state with spontaneously selected finite Cooper-pair momentum and broken time-reversal symmetry. The resulting diode effect is generically non-monotonic in strain and exhibits distinct responses for currents parallel and perpendicular to the residual mirror plane, consistent with experiment. Our theory predicts that reversing the principal strain switches the diode direction by $90^\circ$, while shear strain rotates it continuously. These results establish strain as a symmetry-selective means of creating, controlling, and diagnosing spontaneous helical superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 该理论提出应变可在无磁性和外场下产生非互易超导输运：通过混合s波与双分量配对通道并增强Lifshitz耦合，超过临界应变后进入螺旋态，实现可调控的超导二极管效应。
AI.motivation: 受PbTaSe₂中观测到的应变诱导零场超导二极管效应启发，寻找一种无需磁性或外磁场即可产生非互易超导输运的机制。
AI.method: 建立理论模型：单轴应变将主导s波序参量与次主导双分量配对通道混合，并增强其对称性允许的Lifshitz耦合；分析超过临界应变后向螺旋态的转变。
AI.result: 耦合驱动系统进入自发选择有限库珀对动量、破坏时间反演对称性的螺旋态；二极管效应对应变普遍非单调，且平行/垂直残余镜面电流响应不同，与实验一致；反转主应变使二极管方向切换90°，剪切应变则使其连续旋转。
AI.conclusion: 应变是一种对称性选择性的手段，可用来产生、控制和诊断自发螺旋超导性。

title: Quantum Stochastic Walks on the Permutation Group
summary: How rapidly does order give way to randomness, and can quantum coherence accelerate this process? We address these questions through the paradigmatic problem of card shuffling, formulated as a random walk on the symmetric group $S_n$. We first recast the random-transposition walk studied by Diaconis and Shahshahani, as well as more general walks generated by conjugacy classes of $S_n$, in continuous time. We then identify the transition matrix of each classical walk with a permutation Hamiltonian generating a corresponding unitary quantum walk. Purely unitary evolution, however, does not generically converge to the uniform distribution in the classical sense of mixing: coherence preserves information rather than erasing it. We therefore embed the problem into a quantum stochastic walk, where coherent dynamics competes with the dissipative process responsible for classical mixing. In this setting, quantum coherence assists randomization. We prove that it can only decrease the distance from the uniform distribution in the computational basis and can therefore accelerate mixing. An analysis of the slowest mode yields a criterion for the coupling strength required to produce an appreciable speedup. Finally, numerical results reveal a scaling collapse of the ratio between quantum and classical mixing times onto a simple one-parameter form. Our results illustrate how coherence and dissipation can cooperate in the emergence of randomness in walks on permutation groups.

AI.tldr: 本文用洗牌问题研究量子相干能否加速随机化：将经典随机转置游走对应到排列哈密顿量生成的量子游走，并嵌入量子随机游走框架，证明相干只能降低与均匀分布的距离、从而加速混合，并给出耦合强度判据及混合时间比的标度坍缩。
AI.motivation: 研究有序如何快速转变为随机，以及量子相干能否加速这一过程；以对称群上的洗牌随机游走为范例。
AI.method: 将Diaconis-Shahshahani随机转置游走及更一般的共轭类生成游走改写为连续时间形式；把经典转移矩阵对应为排列哈密顿量生成的酉量子游走；再嵌入量子随机游走，让相干动力学与耗散过程竞争。
AI.result: 证明量子相干只能减小与计算基下均匀分布的距离，故可加速混合；对最慢模式的分析给出产生显著加速所需耦合强度的判据；数值结果显示量子与经典混合时间之比满足单参数标度坍缩。
AI.conclusion: 相干与耗散可协同促进排列群游走中随机性的产生。

title: Topological classification through knotted graphs: Fermi surface dispersions and Lifshitz transitions
comment: 50 pages total: 12-page main article (including references) and 38-page Supplemental Material; 6 main-text figures and 20 supplemental figures
summary: Knot theory has provided a rich topological taxonomy for band structures, but its reach is fundamentally limited: knot invariants classify only 1D nodal lines at gap closure, and cannot encode the full dispersion or rich Fermi surface structure of realistic materials. Here we show that knotted graphs (knots that admit graph-like intersections in 3D space) - which have so far been elusive in condensed matter literature - provide a unified topological language for classifying the entire band dispersion, and even the eigenstate topology in some contexts. We propose a new framework beyond the existing Yamada polynomials that can topologically characterize the intricacies of realistic Fermi surfaces completely, crucially including how their multiple disconnected pieces are nested. This yields the Yamada set, a boundary-resolved extension which organizes the full topological evolution across energy into a Yamada sequence: a compact dispersion-level fingerprint directly tied to experimental signatures of Lifshitz transitions. Our framework is demonstrated with DFT-based band structures of real materials. Beyond dispersion-level classifications, this framework can be extended to non-Hermitian exceptional surfaces, where Berry-curvature flux further equips the knotted-graph skeleton with a directed Abelian edge flow that also captures the eigenstate topology.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用"打结图（knotted graphs）"作为能带色散的统一拓扑语言，将传统纽结不变量从1D节点线推广到完整费米面及本征态拓扑，并引入Yamada集与Yamada序列进行刻画。
AI.motivation: 纽结理论虽为能带结构提供了拓扑分类，但现有纽结不变量仅能分类带隙闭合处的1D节点线，无法编码真实材料的完整色散与复杂费米面结构。
AI.method: 提出超越Yamada多项式的框架，用打结图（具图状交叉的纽结）刻画真实费米面的复杂结构，包括多连通分量的嵌套关系；构造边界分辨的Yamada集，并组织为跨能量演化的Yamada序列；用DFT能带结构验证，并推广至非厄米奇异面，用Berry曲率流赋予有向Abelian边流。
AI.result: 框架能完整刻画真实费米面拓扑及其嵌套结构，Yamada序列作为紧凑的色散级指纹与Lifshitz转变的实验信号直接关联；在非厄米奇异面上，边流可同时捕捉本征态拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 打结图为能带色散乃至本征态拓扑提供了统一拓扑语言，将纽结分类推广到完整费米面，并自然衔接实验可观测的Lifshitz转变及非厄米拓扑。

title: Data-Driven Cohesive Zone Modeling within the Generalized Standard Materials Framework
summary: Cohesive zone models are widely used to describe fracture and interfacial failure, yet most formulations prescribe problem-specific analytical traction-separation laws together with phenomenological rules for unloading and reloading, leading to specialized models for different cohesive behaviors. This work develops a unified learnable cohesive formulation within the generalized standard materials framework, in which the response is generated from learned constitutive functions while the underlying thermodynamic structure remains fixed. The surface free energy is decomposed into active and contact contributions, and irreversible damage evolution is governed by a learned mode-dependent damage resistance. The active energy is represented by an input-convex neural network, while the inverse damage resistance is represented by a monotone neural network. Convexity, monotonicity, normalization, and damage irreversibility are incorporated directly into the constitutive representation. Direct parameterization of the inverse resistance yields an explicit damage update and avoids local nonlinear inversion during constitutive evaluation. Material-point studies show that the formulation can represent qualitatively distinct cohesive responses, including plateaus, extended softening tails, irregular softening, nonlinear unloading, distinct Mode I and Mode II behaviors, and several classical mixed-mode cohesive laws. The framework therefore replaces law-specific model construction with a single thermodynamically structured representation capable of learning cohesive responses of broad functional complexity from data.

AI.tldr: 本文在广义标准材料框架下提出统一的"可学习"内聚区模型，用输入凸神经网络和单调神经网络分别表示活性自由能与逆损伤阻力，直接嵌入凸性、单调性、归一化与损伤不可逆性约束，从而用单一热力学结构化表示替代针对不同内聚行为的专用模型。
AI.motivation: 传统内聚区模型多为特定问题预设解析的牵引-分离律及卸载/重载唯象规则，导致不同内聚行为需要各自专门的公式，缺乏统一性；作者希望用数据驱动但保持热力学结构的方式统一建模。
AI.method: 在广义标准材料框架下构建可学习内聚本构：将表面自由能分解为活性与接触两部分，不可逆损伤演化由可学习的模式相关损伤阻力控制；活性能用输入凸神经网络表示，逆损伤阻力用单调神经网络表示；将凸性、单调性、归一化与损伤不可逆性直接嵌入本构表示。直接参数化逆阻力使损伤更新显式，避免本构计算中的局部非线性反演。
AI.result: 材料点研究表明，该公式能表示定性上不同的内聚响应，包括平台、延长软化尾、非规则软化、非线性卸载、不同的Mode I与Mode II行为，以及若干经典混合模式内聚律。
AI.conclusion: 该框架用单一热力学结构化表示取代律特定的模型构建，能够从数据中学习广泛功能复杂度的内聚响应。

title: Can Autonomous LLM Agents Execute Multireference Quantum Chemistry Calculations?
summary: Multireference electronic-structure calculations remain difficult to automate because critical workflow decisions, including active-space selection, state averaging, convergence recovery, and state identification, traditionally rely on expert judgment. Here, we investigate whether an autonomous large language model (LLM) agent can perform these tasks without human intervention. The agent selects active spaces using literature-grounded analogies or explicitly documented chemical reasoning, generates and submits ORCA calculations, analyzes outputs, and records all decisions in an auditable reasoning log. Benchmarking against 558 vertical transition energies (VTEs) from QUESTDB shows that an unguided baseline agent achieves 24.9% coverage with a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.373 eV. Introducing a structured decision ladder increases coverage to 44.1% while reducing the MAE to 0.339 eV. The largest gains are observed for double and Rydberg excitations, demonstrating that expert-informed procedural guidance substantially improves active-space construction and state identification. When provided with complete workflow information, the agent successfully reproduces published QUEST calculations with an MAE of only 23 meV, resolving 75% of target configurations within seven attempts. These results demonstrate that contemporary LLM agents can autonomously execute and reproduce complex multireference quantum-chemical workflows, while highlighting the importance of structured reasoning frameworks for achieving reliable high-throughput and high-fidelity electronic-structure calculations.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM智能体能否自主完成多参考电子结构计算的工作流决策，发现结构化决策框架可显著提升覆盖率与精度，并能在给出完整信息时重现已发表计算。
AI.motivation: 多参考电子结构计算难以自动化，因为活性空间选择、态平均、收敛恢复和态识别等关键决策依赖专家判断。作者想探究自主LLM智能体能否无需人工干预完成这些任务。
AI.method: 构建自主LLM智能体，通过文献类比或明确化学推理选择活性空间，生成并提交ORCA计算，分析输出，并将所有决策记录在可审计推理日志中。以QUESTDB的558个垂直跃迁能(VTE)为基准，对比无引导基线与结构化决策阶梯。
AI.result: 无引导基线覆盖率为24.9%，MAE为0.373 eV；引入结构化决策阶梯后覆盖率升至44.1%，MAE降至0.339 eV，双激发和Rydberg激发提升最大。提供完整工作流信息时，智能体以仅23 meV的MAE重现已发表QUEST计算，并在7次尝试内解决75%的目标配置。
AI.conclusion: 当代LLM智能体可自主执行并重现复杂的多参考量子化学工作流，但结构化推理框架对实现可靠的高通量、高保真电子结构计算至关重要。

title: Effective theory of the hidden-order pseudogap phase in a doped antiferromagnet
summary: The microscopic origin of the pseudogap phase constitutes a longstanding puzzle related to the emergence of high-temperature superconductivity in cuprate materials. In this work, we develop an effective model for doped antiferromagnets in terms of fluctuating stripes, or string-like domain walls, which obscure the antiferromagnetic order of the spin background. The open ends of such domain walls of the N'eel order are treated as vortices in the resulting lattice gauge theory. We numerically evaluate the phase diagram by classical Monte Carlo simulations, using percolation-based geometric order parameters to diagnose hidden N'eel order. At high temperatures, we identify a BKT-type crossover in which the domain wall ends become deconfined. We interpret this as the $T^*$ crossover from the hidden order regime to the paramagnetic metal above. At low temperatures, we identify stripe instabilities. Predictions of our effective model can be tested in ultracold fermion quantum simulators.

AI.tldr: 本文用涨落条纹（弦状畴壁）构建掺杂反铁磁体的有效模型，将畴壁端点视为规范理论中的涡旋，通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究赝能隙相行为。
AI.motivation: 赝能隙相的微观起源是铜氧化物高温超导中的长期难题，需要理解其与隐藏反铁磁序的关系。
AI.method: 以涨落条纹/弦状畴壁描述掺杂反铁磁体，将Neel序畴壁端点处理为晶格规范理论中的涡旋；用经典蒙特卡洛模拟计算相图，并用基于渗流的几何序参量诊断隐藏Neel序。
AI.result: 高温下发现畴壁端点退禁闭的BKT型渡越，被解释为从隐藏序区到上方顺磁金属的T*渡越；低温下识别出条纹不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 该有效模型的预言可在超冷费米子量子模拟器中检验。

title: Visualizing impurity-driven scattering phase textures in EuCd2As2
summary: Understanding how disorder modifies electronic states in magnetic semiconductors is important for controlling spin-dependent transport and topological responses. Here we use scanning tunneling microscopy to visualize scattering phase textures in EuCd2As2. By isolating a single surface wavevector we reconstruct spatial phase maps of the local density of states and identify phase dislocations characterized by 2pi winding around impurity sites. These phase singularities emerge systematically within charge puddles generated by Eu interstitials and their positions evolve with bias voltage. We show that their spatial structure is consistent with interference between multiple scattering channels, including contributions from spin-orbit coupling. We provide a model which reproduces phase dislocations and relates the decay of the phase gradient to the relative strength of spin-orbit and scalar scattering. Our results establish a route to access the phase of electronic scattering in real space and study the role of local disorder and spin-orbit interactions in shaping electronic states in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 利用扫描隧道显微镜可视化EuCd2As2的散射相位织构，发现杂质周围的2π相位位错，并建立模型将相位梯度衰减与自旋轨道及标量散射的相对强度联系起来。
AI.motivation: 理解无序如何改变磁性半导体中的电子态，对控制自旋相关输运和拓扑响应至关重要。
AI.method: 用扫描隧道显微镜，通过隔离单一表面波矢重建局域态密度的空间相位图，识别杂质位点周围的相位位错，并结合多散射通道干涉（含自旋轨道耦合）建立模型。
AI.result: 发现由Eu间隙原子产生的电荷水坑中系统出现相位奇点，其位置随偏压演化；空间结构与多通道干涉一致，相位梯度衰减反映自旋轨道与标量散射的相对强度。
AI.conclusion: 建立了实空间获取电子散射相位的途径，有助于研究量子材料中局域无序与自旋轨道相互作用对电子态的调控。

title: Digital quantum lattice Boltzmann evolution by reversible compute and open-system reset
summary: Turbulent fluid simulation is computationally demanding because nonlinear interactions couple a wide range of scales. Quantum computing offers another computational model, but fluid evolution is nonlinear and dissipative whereas closed gate-based dynamics is linear and reversible. The lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) is an attractive discrete target because streaming is a local permutation, yet conventional collision reconstructs a nonlinear equilibrium and applies dissipative relaxation. We present a digital quantum lattice Boltzmann (QLBM) algorithm that keeps that nonlinear timestep in computational-basis registers. Each step writes the updated populations into a clean destination bank, uncomputes the workspace, and resets the obsolete source. The resulting channel is completely positive and trace preserving (CPTP), composes without intermediate measurement, and applies to any lattice Boltzmann stencil that can be evaluated reversibly into a clean bank. Forced D3Q19 homogeneous isotropic turbulence, in direct numerical simulation (DNS) and Smagorinsky large-eddy simulation (LES) at Reynolds number 15000 over one million lattice steps, shows statistical agreement in mass, energy budgets, spectra, and intermittency. The three-dimensional calculations use a digital-register emulator of the circuit. A separate D2Q9 implementation compiles the same contract to reversible gates and agrees bit-exactly with its integer twin. Two-bank storage and serial lattice depth limit near-term feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数字量子格子玻尔兹曼方法（QLBM），将非线性时间步保留在计算基寄存器中，通过写入干净目标银行、反向计算工作区并重置源实现CPTP信道；在D3Q19湍流DNS/LES上统计一致，D2Q9门级实现与整数孪生逐位一致。
AI.motivation: 湍流模拟因非线性跨尺度耦合而计算昂贵；量子计算提供新模型，但流体演化非线性且耗散，而封闭门动力学线性可逆。LBM的流动是局部置换，适合作为离散目标，但其碰撞需重构非线性平衡并施加耗散松弛，与门模型存在矛盾。
AI.method: 构造数字QLBM算法：每步将更新后的分布写入干净目标寄存器，反向计算(uncompute)工作区，并重置过时源寄存器，使整体信道为CPTP，无需中间测量即可组合；可推广到任何能以可逆方式评估到干净银行的LBM模板。用数字寄存器模拟器实现三维计算，另用D2Q9门级编译验证。
AI.result: 强制D3Q19均匀各向同性湍流在雷诺数15000、百万格点步数的DNS与Smagorinsky LES中，质量、能量收支、谱和间歇性均统计一致；D2Q9门级实现与整数孪生逐位一致。
AI.conclusion: 该QLBM方案可在门级量子计算框架下保留非线性LBM时间步并保持CPTP性质，数值上与经典结果统计一致，但受双银行存储和串行格点深度限制，近期可行性受限。

title: Automated AFGL quantum number assignment for CO$_2$ isotopologues using a graph neural network
summary: Accurate quantum number assignment for calculated molecular energy levels is a critical bottleneck in generating line broadening parameters for comprehensive line lists for radiative transfer applications. We present an automated pipeline for assigning Air Force Geophysics Laboratory (AFGL) quantum numbers to CO2 calculated rovibrational states lying below 15,000cm$^{-1}$ across all 12 stable isotopologues. A GraphSAGE graph neural network is trained transductively on empirical (MARVEL) energy levels, exploiting inter-isotopologue perturbation chains and intra-isotopologue rotational ladder edges to propagate assignment information to unlabelled calculated states. Physical uniqueness is enforced locally by a Hungarian algorithm solver operating within groups of states sharing the same polyad, rotational quantum number, and parity. A five-generation bootstrap loop iteratively promotes high-confidence predictions into the training set, expanding coverage without additional labelling effort. The pipeline assigns 224,650 previously unlabelled states over 12 isotopologues, accounting for 10.7$\%$ of all available states (including MARVEL-derived levels), with coverage now increased to 97.4$\%$ below 5000cm$^{-1}$. The pipeline includes a novel decision tree method for converting AFGL to Herzberg notation in asymmetric isotopologues, while the architecture and Hungarian uniqueness enforcement are applicable beyond CO2, any molecular system with a conserved polyad-like quantum number and a large body of unlabelled computed states is a natural target for this approach, suggesting a pathway toward automated quantum number annotation for the next generation of large-scale computed line lists.

AI.tldr: 提出基于GraphSAGE图神经网络与匈牙利算法的自动化流程，为CO2的12种稳定同位素在15,000cm⁻¹以下的振转能级分配AFGL量子数，新标注约22.5万条能级。
AI.motivation: 计算分子能级的量子数分配是生成完整谱线表、服务辐射传输应用的瓶颈，需大量人工标注，成本高。
AI.method: 用GraphSAGE在MARVEL经验能级上做直推式训练，利用同位素间微扰链和同位素内转动阶梯边传播标签；用匈牙利算法在多组（同一polyad、转动量子数、宇称）内局部强制物理唯一性；用五轮自举循环将高置信预测加入训练集；并提出AFGL转Herzberg符号的决策树方法。
AI.result: 为12种同位素分配224,650条未标注能级，占全部可用能级的10.7%，5000cm⁻¹以下覆盖率提升至97.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法架构与唯一性约束可推广至其他具有守恒polyad类量子数和大规模未标注计算态的分子体系，为大规模计算谱线表的自动量子数标注提供路径。

title: Effect of Buried-Interface Preparation for Nb Superconducting Resonators on InP
summary: Substrate surface preparation is a key step in the fabrication of electronic devices. In III--V semiconductor platforms, e.g. used in HEMTs and lasers, removal of the native substrate oxide is extremely important, where improper removal will negatively affect end-of-line device performance. However, the impact of substrate preparation in hybrid superconductor--semiconductor (S--Sm) systems relevant to quantum information applications remains poorly understood. This study compares three surface preparations for the deposition of sputtered Nb films on InP: (i) no intentional oxide removal (control), (ii) \textit{in-situ} $\mathrm{Ar}^{+}$ milling, and (iii) S-passivation. \textit{In-situ} $\mathrm{Ar}^{+}$ milling reduces the O concentration at the metal--substrate (MS) interface, but also roughens the InP surface, increasing the effective thickness of the Nb--InP interface and promoting O incorporation through extended defects in the Nb film. S-passivation suppresses interfacial O more effectively while preserving a sharper and smoother buried interface. It also yields Nb films with higher superconducting transition temperatures and less structural damage than the $\mathrm{Ar}^{+}$-milled samples. Despite these materials improvements, the microwave response is comparable across the three preparations. At single photon powers, the highest internal quality factors, $Q_i$, are approximately $1.30\times10^{5}$ ($130\mathrm{k}$) for the control resonators, $9.7\times10^{4}$ ($97\mathrm{k}$) for the S-passivated resonators, and $8.4\times10^{4}$ ($84\mathrm{k}$) for the $\mathrm{Ar}^{+}$-milled resonators. These results suggest that the present devices are not primarily limited by dielectric loss at the buried Nb--InP interface.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了 InP 基底上溅射 Nb 薄膜的三种表面处理（无处理、Ar+ 铣削、S 钝化）对超导—半导体混合体系的影响。S 钝化在界面氧抑制和薄膜质量上最优，但三种处理的微波响应相近，表明当前器件并非主要受埋入 Nb–InP 界面介电损耗限制。
AI.motivation: 在量子信息相关的超导—半导体（S–Sm）混合系统中，基底制备（尤其是原生氧化物的去除）对器件性能的影响尚不清楚，而这对 III–V 平台（HEMT、激光器等）器件至关重要。
AI.method: 在 InP 上溅射 Nb 薄膜前采用三种表面处理进行对比：(i) 不刻意去氧化（对照）、(ii) 原位 Ar+ 铣削、(iii) S 钝化；并评估界面氧浓度、界面粗糙度、薄膜结构与超导转变温度及微波谐振器品质因子。
AI.result: 原位 Ar+ 铣削降低金属—基底界面 O 浓度，但使 InP 表面粗糙、界面有效厚度增加并促进 O 掺入；S 钝化更有效抑制界面 O，保持更锐利平滑的埋入界面，且 Nb 膜超导转变温度更高、结构损伤更小。然而微波响应三者相当：单光子功率下最高内品质因子 Qi 分别约为对照 1.30×10^5、S 钝化 9.7×10^4、Ar+ 铣削 8.4×10^4。
AI.conclusion: S 钝化在材料层面优于 Ar+ 铣削，但微波性能并未随之提升，说明当前器件的主要限制并非埋入 Nb–InP 界面的介电损耗。

title: Superconducting Diode Effect in Josephson $\varphi_0$ Junction
summary: We investigate the superconducting diode effect in a Josephson junction with a ferromagnetic weak link in the presence of Rashba spin-orbit coupling. While the standard $\varphi_0$ junction model is valid only for weak exchange fields $h \lesssim T_c$, realistic ferromagnetic barriers typically operate in the regime $h \gg T_c$, where the conventional Ginzburg-Landau gradient expansion becomes insufficient and requires the inclusion of higher order gradient terms to ensure stability of the free energy. By extending the free energy with such higher order term, we demonstrate that the linear gradient coupling alone leads to finite momentum Cooper pairing while leaving the critical current symmetry unchanged. The interplay between this linear term and the higher order gradient one leads to the Josephson diode effect.

AI.tldr: 研究铁磁弱连接约瑟夫森结中的超导二极管效应，指出常规φ0结模型仅适用于弱交换场，需引入高阶梯度项才能得到稳定的自由能；线性梯度项与高阶梯度项的相互作用导致约瑟夫森二极管效应。
AI.motivation: 标准φ0结模型只在弱交换场h≲Tc时成立，而实际铁磁势垒通常处于h≫Tc区间，此时传统Ginzburg-Landau梯度展开不充分，无法保证自由能稳定，需要引入高阶梯度项。因此有必要在更现实的强交换场条件下重新研究超导二极管效应的起源。
AI.method: 在含Rashba自旋轨道耦合的约瑟夫森结中，以铁磁体作为弱连接，构建自由能展开；在自由能中额外加入高阶梯度项，并结合原有的线性梯度耦合项，分析二者对Cooper对有限动量配对和临界电流对称性的影响。
AI.result: 线性梯度耦合项单独作用时会产生有限动量Cooper配对，但不改变临界电流的对称性；当线性梯度项与高阶梯度项共同作用时，才出现约瑟夫森二极管效应。
AI.conclusion: 在强交换场铁磁弱连接中，稳定自由能必须包含高阶梯度项；超导二极管效应源于线性梯度项与高阶梯度项的相互竞争，而非单一线性项所致。

title: Tripartite entanglement in chaotic eigenstates
summary: It is now well-established that classical statistical mechanics emerges from the entanglement structure of quantum chaotic systems, as quantified by the (subsystem) eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH). While this statement rests on the well-studied bipartite entanglement of the eigenstates of such systems, recent years have shown that many-body states are often characterized by multipartite entanglement, raising the question: what are the universal multipartite entanglement features of chaotic eigenstates? We answer this question in part by studying a tripartite generalization of the ergodic bipartition ansatz through the lens of two tripartite entanglement probes, the Rényi tripartite multi-entropy and the Rényi reflected entropy. We derive leading-order analytical expressions for the ensemble averages of both quantities using a saddle-point analysis. Beyond these measures, we obtain the average of the Rényi-2 reflected density matrix, $ρ_{AA^*}^{(2)}$,which controls the Rényi-2 reflected entropy. We show that $ρ_{AA^*}^{(2)}$ in a chaotic eigenstate is well-described by this ensemble average which, unlike an ordinary reduced density matrix, takes three qualitatively distinct forms across subsystem-size regimes, which may be viewed as a tripartite generalization of subsystem ETH. We benchmark our analytical predictions against exact diagonalization of the mixed-field Ising model.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究量子混沌本征态的多体纠缠普适特征，通过三分Ergodic Bipartition ansatz推导Rényi三体multi-entropy与反射熵的系综平均解析式，并用混合场Ising模型验证。
AI.motivation: 经典统计力学源自量子混沌系统的纠缠结构（子系统ETH），但现有理解依赖二分纠缠；近年来表明多体态常具有多体纠缠特性，因此需追问：混沌本征态的普适多体纠缠特征是什么？
AI.method: 研究三分Ergodic Bipartition ansatz，借助两种三分纠缠探针——Rényi三体multi-entropy与Rényi反射熵，用鞍点分析推导二者系综平均的主导阶解析表达式，并计算控制Rényi-2反射熵的反射密度矩阵ρ_{AA*}^{(2)}的平均。
AI.result: 得到二者的主导阶解析式及ρ_{AA*}^{(2)}的系综平均；发现混沌本征态的ρ_{AA*}^{(2)}可由该平均很好描述，且不同于普通约化密度矩阵，在不同子系统尺寸区域呈现三种定性不同形式，可视为子系统ETH的三分推广；用混合场Ising模型精确对角化验证了理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 工作部分回答了混沌本征态普适多体纠缠特征的问题，提出子系统ETH的三分推广，并证明反射密度矩阵的系综平均可刻画混沌本征态的三分纠缠结构，数值结果支持该解析预测。

title: Precessional modes of phonon angular momentum
summary: Magnons are collective precessional excitations of electron spins and are ubiquitous in emerging information technologies. Here, we show that the crystal lattice can support an analogous precessional mode of phonon angular momentum. Superposition of a circularly polarized phonon and a linearly polarized phonon normal to the circular-motion plane generates a transverse angular-momentum component that rotates at their difference frequency and decays on a timescale set by the participating phonon linewidths, defining a mode with its own resonance and lifetime. Coupling between spin and phonon angular momentum hybridizes this precessional mode with a magnon near resonance. Our results establish phonon angular momentum precessional modes as lattice analogues of magnons and identify their spectroscopic and time-domain signatures.

AI.tldr: 该文提出晶格中可存在类比于磁振子的声子角动量进动模式，并揭示其与磁振子的杂化耦合，为声子角动量的谱学与时域探测提供新方向。
AI.motivation: 磁振子是自旋的集体进动激发，在信息技术中广泛应用。作者希望探索晶格是否也能支持类似的声子角动量进动模式，从而建立声子版的“磁振子”。
AI.method: 将圆偏振声子与垂直于其圆运动平面的线偏振声子叠加，产生以两者频率差旋转的横向角动量分量；该分量按参与声子的线宽所设定的时间尺度衰减。进一步利用自旋-声子角动量耦合，使该进动模式在共振附近与磁振子杂化。
AI.result: 发现声子角动量存在具有自身共振频率和寿命的进动模式；该模式可与磁振子发生杂化；给出了对应的谱学与时域特征信号。
AI.conclusion: 声子角动量进动模式可作为磁振子的晶格类比物，为声子角动量及自旋-声子耦合研究提供新的物理图像与探测途径。

title: Exceptional-point conjugate symmetry and migration in fluid-loaded elastic waveguides: restructuring the physical dispersion spectrum
comment: Keywords: Fluid-loaded waveguide; Leaky Lamb waves; Scholte wave; Exceptional points; Inter-manifold transport; Non-Hermitian dispersion
summary: The dispersion spectrum of a fluid-loaded elastic waveguide is a non-Hermitian system with eigenmodes on a two-sheeted Riemann manifold. Although exceptional points (EPs) organize avoided crossings, the topological rules by which fluid loading restructures the observable spectrum (both physically admissible modes and their connectivity) remain unknown, and conventional solvers fail to recover complete branches. Here we establish these rules. We prove that, for real elastic moduli and real fluid parameters, EPs obey a conjugate-pair symmetry, and that a pair on the physical sheet enforces an avoided crossing of real wavenumbers between the two modes it controls, yielding a topological criterion for mode identification. We then identify two independent reconstruction mechanisms. First, the physical observation space expands continuously: a mode observable above its vacuum cut-off can extend downward to the sound line, admitting solutions in a frequency band empty in vacuum; vacuum-anchored seeds above cut-offs continued downward capture such branches systematically. Second, EP migration rewires mode connectivity: as fluid density increases, conjugate pairs leaving the physical sheet (signaled by a sign reversal of the imaginary part of either the in-plane or the vertical wavenumber) leave the two previously coupled physical branch segments unconnected by any EP within the observation space; they become independent curves that may intersect freely on the real frequency axis, with the narrowest veerings losing their topological protection first. Mirror-symmetry breaking births additional EPs generically in the trapped regime but only conditionally in the leaky regime. Numerical computations on symmetric and asymmetric composite laminates under single- and double-sided water loading validate the framework, recovering multiple leaky branches missed by standard solvers.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了流体加载弹性波导色散谱的拓扑规则，解释了异常点(EP)如何重排可观测模式及其连通性，并给出可系统恢复完整模式分支的重构机制，数值验证于对称/非对称层合板的单/双面水加载。
AI.motivation: 流体加载弹性波导是双叶Riemann面上的非Hermitian系统，EP组织着避让交叉，但流体加载如何从拓扑上重构可观测谱（哪些模式物理允许、如何连通）尚不清楚，且传统求解器无法恢复完整分支。
AI.method: 证明在实弹性模量与实流体参数下，EP满足共轭对对称性；物理叶上的一对EP强制其所控两模式在实波数上发生避让交叉，从而给出模式识别的拓扑判据。识别两种独立重构机制：(1) 物理观测空间连续扩张——真空截止以上的模式可下延至声线，采用真空锚定的截止以上种子向下延拓捕捉此类分支；(2) EP迁移重连模式连通性——随流体密度增大，共轭对离开物理叶（由面内或垂向波数虚部变号指示），原本耦合的两段物理分支不再被观测空间内的EP连接，成为可自由相交的独立曲线，偏转最窄者最先失去拓扑保护。镜像对称破缺在陷获区普遍催生新EP，而在泄漏区仅条件性产生。
AI.result: 对对称与非对称复合层合板在单面和双面水加载下的数值计算验证了该框架，并恢复了标准求解器遗漏的多个泄漏分支。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了流体加载波导中EP的共轭对对称与模式连通性的拓扑规则，提出两种分支重构机制，为完整色散谱的求解提供理论依据与数值方法。

title: Accelerating ab initio spin-phonon relaxation simulation of single-ion magnets by quantum embedding and spatial truncation
summary: Single-ion magnets (SIMs) show promise for high-density storage and quantum computing, but predicting spin-phonon coupling (SPC) and magnetic relaxation remains challenging due to the need for numerous non-equilibrium multiconfigurational calculations. Recent advances in quantum embedding methods offer a potential route to address this issue. In this work, density matrix embedding theory (DMET) combined with complete active space self-consistent field (CASSCF) is benchmarked for the static magnetic properties and spin-phonon coupling (SPC) parameters of Dy$^{3+}$-based SIMs. The method is further combined with spatial truncation to calculate SPC parameters for these SIMs. It is found that truncating the space near the first coordination sphere reduces the computational cost dramatically while keeping the errors in the effective energy barrier and relaxation time-scale negligible. This study provides a practical calculation framework for accurate and efficient spin dynamics prediction, laying the foundation for the rational design of high-performance single-molecule magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文将DMET与CASSCF结合并搭配空间截断，用于Dy³⁺基单离子磁体的静态磁性和自旋-声子耦合参数计算，证明截断第一配位层附近空间可大幅降本且误差可忽略。
AI.motivation: 单离子磁体在存储与量子计算有前景，但预测自旋-声子耦合和磁弛豫需大量非平衡多组态计算，成本高，亟需高效准确的量子嵌入方案。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵嵌入理论（DMET）结合完整活性空间自洽场（CASSCF）对Dy³⁺基单离子磁体的静态磁性与自旋-声子耦合参数进行基准测试，并进一步引入空间截断计算SPC参数。
AI.result: 在第一配位层附近进行空间截断可显著降低计算成本，同时有效能垒和弛豫时间尺度的误差可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个准确高效的自旋动力学预测计算框架，为高性能单分子磁体的理性设计奠定基础。

title: Heating of black-Si by microwaves at 2.45 GHz: effect of nano-needle orientation
summary: Silicon, which is highly reflective and has negligible absorption at the microwave 2.45 GHz range, can be heated when it is turned into black-Si with a surface texture of nano-needles made by SF6/O2 plasma etching. Microwave heating of flat Si and of black-Si with vertical and with tilted (oriented) nano-needles was compared under identical conditions in a cylindrical TM010 resonator. Samples were placed horizontally on a 150-micrometer-thick cover glass, which standardized their height and position inside the cavity and allowed a common calibration of the radiation thermometer against a K-type thermocouple. Under a stepwise protocol of only 2-3-4 W of microwave power (60 s per step), black-Si with vertical needles reached ~ 260 C, systematically exceeding flat Si (~ 190 C), while black-Si with oriented needles showed a delayed but abrupt onset of heating at 3 W. In situ monitoring of the cavity resonance revealed a 2-3 MHz downshift of the resonance frequency f for all samples, with the drift consistently appearing once the sample temperature exceeded ~ 120 - 150 C, consistent with thermally activated carrier generation in Si. At a given temperature, each sample loads the cavity at a different f and quality factor Q, indicating an orientation-dependent effective permittivity of the nano-needle array, in line with the strong form birefringence of tilted black-Si. Application potential and challenges in the quantitative temperature and permittivity determination are discussed.

AI.tldr: 黑硅（纳米针表面）在2.45 GHz微波下可被有效加热，加热效率与纳米针取向相关，且腔谐振频移可用于原位监测温度与介电特性。
AI.motivation: 硅在微波2.45 GHz下高反射、几乎无吸收，难以直接微波加热；需探索通过表面纳米结构化（黑硅）实现微波吸收与加热的可行性及其机理。
AI.method: 用SF6/O2等离子体刻蚀制备垂直与倾斜（取向）纳米针黑硅；在圆柱TM010谐振腔中，将样品水平置于150 μm盖玻片上以统一高度与位置，用K型热电偶标定辐射温度计；采用2-3-4 W分级（每步60 s）微波功率加热，并原位监测腔谐振频率f与品质因数Q。
AI.result: 垂直纳米针黑硅达约260 °C，高于平面硅（约190 °C）；倾斜纳米针样品在3 W时出现延迟但突发的升温。所有样品谐振频率下移2-3 MHz，漂移在温度超过约120-150 °C时出现（与热激活载流子产生一致）。相同温度下各样品的f与Q负载不同，表明纳米针阵列有效介电常数具取向依赖性，与倾斜黑硅的强形状双折射一致。
AI.conclusion: 黑硅可实现微波选择性加热，加热行为与纳米针取向及有效介电常数相关；谐振腔监测可原位反映热激活载流子与介电变化，但定量测温与介电常数测定仍存在挑战。

title: Topological superconductivity in an altermagnet-superconductor heterostructure
summary: Fully gapped spin-triplet superconductors offer a natural setting for topological edge transport and Majorana excitations. Here we propose a heterostructure that interfaces altermagnetic monolayer V$_2$Se$_2$O with a conventional $s$-wave superconductor. Starting from an ab-initio description of V$_2$Se$_2$O, we construct a low-energy model of its spin-split Fermi surface and study the superconducting instability of the coupled stack. We find that the momentum-dependent exchange splitting of the altermagnet strongly favors equal-spin pairing and converts the proximity-induced order into a fully gapped $p$-wave state. Over a broad range of interface parameters, the resulting Bogoliubov-de Gennes bands carry a nonzero Chern number, and slab spectra exhibit chiral Majorana edge modes traversing the bulk gap. We further quantify the inverse proximity effect and show how the induced gap evolves across a finite multilayer stack. These results establish a route to topological triplet superconductivity by interfacing a conventional superconductor with an experimentally available altermagnetic semiconductor, and provide practical guidance for interface fabrication and experimental detection.

AI.tldr: 通过在交错磁体V₂Se₂O与常规s波超导体界面构建异质结，可诱导出全能隙p波（自旋三重态）超导态，并实现非零陈数的BdG能带与手性马约拉纳边缘模。
AI.motivation: 全能隙自旋三重态超导体是拓扑边缘输运与马约拉纳激发的理想平台，但如何在实验可得的材料体系中实现此类拓扑三重态超导仍是关键挑战。
AI.method: 以第一性原理描述交错磁单层V₂Se₂O为起点，构建其自旋劈裂费米面的低能模型，研究该材料与常规s波超导体所组成耦合叠层的超导不稳定性及逆近邻效应。
AI.result: 动量依赖的交错磁交换劈裂强烈倾向于等自旋配对，将近邻诱导的序参量转化为全能隙p波态；在较宽的界面参数范围内，BdG能带具有非零陈数，板状谱呈现穿越体能隙的手性马约拉纳边缘模；并刻画了诱导能隙在有限多层叠层中的演化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了通过常规超导体与实验可实现的交错磁半导体界面实现拓扑三重态超导的路径，并为界面制备与实验探测提供实用指导。

title: Thermodynamic geometry of inclusion statistics
summary: We investigate the thermodynamic geometry of an ideal quantum gas obeying inclusion statistics, characterized by a negative statistical parameter $g < 0$. In this framework the grand-canonical partition function admits a finite maximum fugacity, and the thermodynamic scalar curvature $R$ is strictly positive for all $g < 0$, reflecting effective attractive statistical interactions analogous to those of a bosonic system. As the fugacity approaches its maximum value, $R$ diverges, signaling a phase transition of the Bose-Einstein condensation type. A key distinction from the ordinary ideal Bose gas is that the condensation temperature is elevated relative to the bosonic case, and finite-temperature condensation occurs even in the dimensional regime $1/2 < D/σ\leq 1$ where standard bosons do not condense, while for $D/σ\leq 1/2$ the transition temperature vanishes. Three independent criteria; divergence of $R$, the maximum fugacity singularity, and the non-analytic cusp in the specific heat, coincide at the same condensation point, confirming the thermodynamic consistency of the transition.

AI.tldr: 研究服从 inclusion statistics（负统计参数 g<0）的理想量子气体的热力学几何，发现其标量曲率恒正、在最大逸度处发散，对应 Bose-Einstein 型凝聚，且凝聚温度高于普通玻色气体，并在 1/2 < D/σ ≤ 1 维度区间也可发生有限温凝聚。
AI.motivation: 探究 inclusion statistics（g<0）这一非标准统计框架下理想量子气体的热力学性质与相变行为，特别是其与普通玻色气体在凝聚条件上的差异。
AI.method: 采用热力学几何方法，计算巨配分函数（存在有限最大逸度）及热力学标量曲率 R，并用三个独立判据（R 发散、最大逸度奇异性、比热非解析尖点）分析凝聚点。
AI.result: 对 g<0，R 恒正，对应有效吸引统计相互作用（类似玻色系统）；逸度趋于最大值时 R 发散，标志 Bose-Einstein 型相变。凝聚温度高于普通玻色气体，且在 1/2 < D/σ ≤ 1 区间出现有限温凝聚（普通玻色子不凝聚），而 D/σ ≤ 1/2 时转变温度趋于零。
AI.conclusion: 三个独立判据在同一凝聚点重合，验证了该相变的热力学自洽性，表明 inclusion statistics 气体具有独特的凝聚特性。

title: Probing the anomalous symmetry-breaking in kagome material CsV3Sb5 via third-order nonlinearity
summary: The kagome material has rapidly established itself as a research frontier in condensed matter physics, owing to its distinctive geometric structure and the rich array of unconventional physical phenomena. In the kagome AV3Sb5 (A = K, Rb, Cs) family, the charge-ordered state exhibits a remarkable characteristic, i.e., anomalous symmetry-breaking, which is tied to the topological nature of the electronic band structure. Here, we report the third-order nonlinear longitudinal and Hall responses that persist stably up to room temperature in the kagome material CsV3Sb5. Notably, the nonlinear responses demonstrate significant enhancement below the charge density wave (~ 77 K) order and anomalous symmetry-breaking (~ 39 K) state. The scaling analysis indicates that the third-order nonlinear transport is governed jointly by quantum geometric contribution and extrinsic scattering. This study realizes a giant third-order nonlinear response and provides a distinct method to detect anomalous symmetry-breaking in CsV3Sb5.

AI.tldr: 在kagome材料CsV3Sb5中，报道了三阶非线性纵向与霍尔响应可稳定持续至室温，并在电荷密度波和反常对称破缺态以下显著增强，其机制由量子几何贡献与外禀散射共同主导。
AI.motivation: kagome材料因独特几何结构与非寻常物理现象成为前沿；在AV3Sb5家族中，电荷有序态具有与拓扑能带相关的反常对称破缺，需要新的探测手段。
AI.method: 测量CsV3Sb5的三阶非线性纵向和霍尔响应，并结合标度分析（scaling analysis）刻画其温度演化与机制来源。
AI.result: 三阶非线性响应稳定持续至室温；在CDW（~77 K）和反常对称破缺（~39 K）以下显著增强；标度分析表明该响应由量子几何贡献与外禀散射共同决定。
AI.conclusion: 实现了巨大的三阶非线性响应，并提供了一种探测CsV3Sb5反常对称破缺的独特方法。

title: Cracking the case: fluctuations enhance ductility in refractory alloys
summary: Refractory body-centered cubic (BCC) alloys are attractive candidates for structural applications at extreme temperatures, yet combining room-temperature ductility with high-temperature strength remains the unsolved challenge. Ductility in crystals requires that dislocations emit from a sharp crack tip before brittle cleavage, but continuum theories that treat disordered alloys as chemically homogeneous incorrectly predict brittleness for many experimentally ductile alloys. Here we show that atomic-scale stress fluctuations in disordered alloys create an additional local stress intensity at the crack tip, enabling dislocation loop nucleation below the cleavage threshold. Accounting for these fluctuations yields a local ductility criterion where alloys deemed brittle by conventional fracture mechanics can be intrinsically ductile. Atomistic simulations with machine-learned interatomic potentials and an analytic fracture mechanics model correctly predict composition-driven brittle-to-ductile transitions in binary and ternary Mo-Nb-Ti alloys, in Nb-Ti alloys at 4 K, and in several commercial BCC alloys at room temperature. Guided by this criterion, we predict, fabricate, and test the Hf$_{15}$Mo$_{15}$Nb$_{32}$Ti$_{38}$ alloy, confirming its room-temperature ductility. This fluctuation-driven mechanism provides a quantitative basis for designing ductile multicomponent BCC alloys.

AI.tldr: 难熔BCC合金难以兼具室温韧性与高温强度。研究表明，无序合金中的原子尺度应力涨落会在裂纹尖端产生额外局域应力强度，使位错环可在解理阈值以下形核，从而给出新的局域韧性判据，并成功预测与验证了多种Mo-Nb-Ti、Nb-Ti及商业合金乃至新合金Hf15Mo15Nb32Ti38的韧性。
AI.motivation: 难熔BCC合金是极端高温结构应用的理想候选，但室温韧性与高温强度的兼顾仍是未解难题。传统连续介质理论把无序合金视为化学均匀体，无法解释实验上许多韧性合金，误判其为脆性，因此需要揭示原子尺度非均匀性对裂纹尖端位错形核的作用机制。
AI.method: 提出无序合金中原子尺度应力涨落会在裂纹尖端产生额外局域应力强度的机制，建立考虑该涨落的局域韧性判据；结合机器学习势的原子尺度模拟与解析断裂力学模型，对二元、三元Mo-Nb-Ti合金、4 K下Nb-Ti合金及若干商业BCC合金进行预测验证，并据此设计、制备与测试Hf15Mo15Nb32Ti38合金。
AI.result: 考虑应力涨落的局域判据可将传统断裂力学判定为脆性的合金正确识别为本征韧性；模拟与解析模型准确预测了成分驱动的脆-韧转变，包括二元/三元Mo-Nb-Ti、4 K下Nb-Ti及多种商业BCC合金；据此预测并制备的Hf15Mo15Nb32Ti38合金经实验证实具有室温韧性。
AI.conclusion: 应力涨落驱动的位错形核机制为理解与设计韧性多组元BCC合金提供了定量依据，可指导兼具室温韧性与高温强度的难熔合金开发。

title: Efficient calculation of inductive coupling for arrays of wire ring resonators
summary: Generalization of the inductance to the case of non-quasistatic electromagnetic field oscillations appears to be fruitful when considering wireless power transfer and RF metamaterials consisting of thin wire loop meta-atoms. When dealing with large systems of interacting loops carrying currents, efficiency and precision of calculation in the presence of retardation is crucial. In this work, we derive a series expansion of such generalized inductance and propose a way for its efficient numerical approximation. Illustrative examples are provided both for inductance convergence of a pair of two loops and extinction efficiency for scattering by metamaterial samples.

AI.tldr: 本文将电感推广到非准静态（含推迟效应）电磁场振荡情况，推导其级数展开并提出高效数值近似方法。
AI.motivation: 在无线功率传输和由细导线环超原子构成的RF超材料中，考虑非准静态振荡时推广电感是有意义的。对于承载电流、存在推迟效应的大型相互作用环系统，计算的效率与精度至关重要。
AI.method: 推导广义电感的级数展开，并提出一种高效数值近似方法。
AI.result: 给出了两个说明性算例：一对环的电感收敛性，以及超材料样品散射的消光效率。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可用于含推迟效应的大型环系系统的电感计算，兼顾效率与精度。

title: From Transition-State Geometry to Gap Times: What Lagrangian Betweenness Measures in Chemical Reaction Dynamics
summary: A chemical transition state is a phase-space bottleneck: trajectories approach along stable directions and leave along unstable directions. Lagrangian betweenness (LB), introduced in finite-time transport theory for fluid flows, combines backward and forward deformation in a way suggestive of this gather-and-disperse geometry. We ask what LB measures when the transition-state geometry is known. For a linear rank-one saddle, LB is spatially constant even though the stable and unstable manifolds are present. Relative nonlinear corrections remain small on shrinking initial neighborhoods, including observation times on the logarithmic local escape scale. At fixed spatial resolution, however, increasing observation time can concentrate the spatial variation of LB near a stable or unstable manifold. A separable quartic Hamiltonian makes these two limits explicit. A nonseparable Hamiltonian shows local flattening near a hyperbolic periodic orbit. We then use HCN/CNH isomerization, where dividing surfaces and gap times are established by phase-space transition-state theory. Before any exit, larger LB generally accompanies longer eventual gap times. The incoming reactive action provides a dynamical interpretation: initial conditions closer to the normally hyperbolic invariant manifold have longer local passages and greater accumulated stretching during passage. Among trajectories still inside at 0.5 ps that exit before 5 ps, early LB does not usefully rank exit times. LB therefore characterizes transition-state-organized transport in this example; a large value is neither an intrinsic manifold marker nor a general measure of molecular residence time.

AI.tldr: 本文考察有限时间输运理论中的Lagrangian betweenness (LB) 在已知过渡态几何下的物理含义，并用HCN/CNH异构化验证其意义与局限。
AI.motivation: 化学过渡态是相空间瓶颈，轨迹沿稳定方向接近、沿不稳定方向离开。LB结合前后向形变，似乎契合这种"聚集-分散"几何，但其在过渡态中究竟测量什么尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在解析可解模型（线性秩一鞍点、可分四次哈密顿量、非可分哈密顿量及双曲周期轨道）中分析LB的空间结构；结合HCN/CNH异构化，用相空间过渡态理论定义的dividing surface与gap time，比较LB与最终gap time、出射时间的关系，并引入incoming reactive action作动力学解释。
AI.result: 线性鞍点下LB空间恒定，非线性修正随初始邻域收缩而变小（即便在对数局域逃逸尺度上）；固定空间分辨率时，延长观测时间可使LB变化集中于稳定/不稳定流形附近。HCN/CNH中，出射前较大的LB总体伴随更长的最终gap time，incoming reactive action可解释之；但对0.5 ps内仍在、5 ps前出射的轨迹，早期LB无法有效排序出射时间。
AI.conclusion: LB刻画的是过渡态组织下的输运；大LB值既非流形的内在标记，也不是分子驻留时间的通用度量。

title: The effect of light scattering in cavity electrodynamics: Fresnel equations with decoherence
summary:
We consider the effect of light decoherence in a Fabri-Perot (FP) microcavity. We show that, when present, it may significantly change its linear response to the incident light.The optical properties of the bounding mirrors are described using the classical electrodynamics, and the light scattering causing the phase breaking is treated as a multichannel scattering problem employing a model introduced by Büttiker to describe dephasing in electron transport. We show that the dephasing causes a gradual erosion of the cavity photon mode and thus impedes the formation of molecular polaritons.
  Consequently, the polaritons signatures in the transmission and absorption optical spectra of the microcavity are fading away as the scattering intensifies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究FP微腔中光退相干的影响，发现退相干会逐渐侵蚀腔光子模式，阻碍分子极化激元形成，使透射和吸收谱中的极化激元信号随散射增强而消失。
AI.motivation: 探究光退相干（相位破缺散射）如何影响Fabri-Perot微腔的线性光学响应，特别是其对分子极化激元形成的影响。
AI.method: 用经典电动力学描述腔镜的光学性质；将引起相位破缺的光散射作为多通道散射问题处理，采用Büttiker提出的描述电子输运中退相干的模型。
AI.result: 退相干会逐渐侵蚀腔光子模式，阻碍分子极化激元的形成；随散射增强，微腔透射和吸收光谱中的极化激元特征逐渐消失。
AI.conclusion: 光退相干对FP微腔光学响应有显著影响，可破坏极化激元的形成与光谱特征。

title: Spatial instability of a homogeneous superconductor after an interaction quench
summary: We investigate the quantum dynamics of a conventional superconductor, described by the attrac- tive Hubbard model, driven far from equilibrium by quenching the Hubbard attraction. We evolve the full density matrix of the system in time using the Heisenberg equation of motion, tracking the spatiotemporal dynamics of the pairing and density fields. We use very weakly inhomogeneous initial conditions to probe the stability of the homogeneous dynamics to spatial perturbations. At initial times after the quench the pairing and density fields remain homogeneous in space while fluctuating in time. However, depending on the quench strength the spatially uniform dynamics can become unstable beyond a threshold time, with emergence of spatial textures. The onset time for the instability depends on the strength of the quench and the initial inhomogeneity. At long times the system evolves towards a state with significantly reduced spatial heterogeneity. The time dependence of the global superconducting order parameter suggests two broad categories of re- sponse to a quench. One of these involves strongly inhomogeneous pairing and bond currents in the nonequilibrium superconductor.

AI.tldr: 本文用含时密度矩阵研究了吸引Hubbard模型在调控吸引作用后远离平衡的量子动力学，发现均匀配对与密度场在阈值时间后可能失稳并形成空间织构，长期趋向弱空间非均匀态。
AI.motivation: 探究常规超导体在突然改变Hubbard吸引作用后的非平衡量子动力学，并检验近均匀初态下均匀演化对空间微扰的稳定性。
AI.method: 以吸引Hubbard模型描述常规超导体，通过突然淬火Hubbard吸引强度实现远离平衡；利用Heisenberg运动方程对系统完整密度矩阵进行时间演化，追踪配对场和密度场的时空动力学，并采用非常弱的空间非均匀初态作为扰动。
AI.result: 淬火后早期，配对场和密度场保持空间均匀但随时间涨落；根据淬火强度不同，空间均匀动力学会在超过阈值时间后失稳并出现空间织构。失稳起始时间取决于淬火强度和初始非均匀性。长时间后系统演化为空间非均匀性显著降低的状态。全局超导序参量的时间依赖显示两类淬火响应，其中一类伴随强非均匀配对和键流。
AI.conclusion: 非平衡超导淬火响应可大致分为两类；在特定淬火条件下，均匀超导态会因空间微扰失稳，生成强非均匀配对与键流，最终又趋于较均匀状态。

title: Local pair correlations and network geometry govern collective oscillations in nonreciprocal Ising networks
summary: Nonreciprocal many-body dynamics can develop a swap phase characterized by spontaneous global oscillations far from equilibrium. To determine how local nonreciprocal interactions predict global oscillations and how broadly this prediction applies, we compare mean-field theory, independent-node theory, and nearest-neighbor spin-coupling theory for a two-spin nonreciprocal Ising model on networks of fixed coordination number (\(z=4\)). Nearest-neighbor spin-coupling theory retains nine independent joint edge probabilities. Monte Carlo benchmarks show that it predicts the oscillation amplitude, angular momentum, and period on edge-swapped networks with a 2.1\% aggregate mean absolute relative error. We then extend the square lattice to degree-preserving edge-swapped networks and find sharply different behavior. With increasing system size, the oscillation amplitude and angular momentum decay strongly on the periodic square lattice but remain nearly size independent on edge-swapped networks. These results show that identical local parameters do not determine the macroscopic phase. The contrasting finite-size trends identify network geometry as a key determinant of collective oscillations at fixed local interaction parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双自旋非互易Ising模型在固定配位数网络上的全局振荡行为，比较平均场、独立节点与最近邻自旋耦合三种理论，发现网络几何（而非局部参数）决定宏观振荡相，且边缘重连网络与方形晶格的有限尺寸趋势截然不同。
AI.motivation: 非互易多体动力学可产生远离平衡的自发全局振荡（swap相），但局部非互易相互作用如何预测全局振荡、该预测的普适性如何尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在固定配位数z=4的网络上构建双自旋非互易Ising模型，对比平均场理论、独立节点理论和保留九个独立联合边概率的最近邻自旋耦合理论，并以Monte Carlo模拟为基准，在方形晶格与保持度数的边缘重连网络上考察系统尺寸效应。
AI.result: 最近邻自旋耦合理论在边缘重连网络上预测振荡振幅、角动量与周期的总体平均绝对相对误差为2.1%；随系统增大，周期性方形晶格上振荡振幅与角动量强烈衰减，而边缘重连网络上几乎与尺寸无关。
AI.conclusion: 相同的局部参数不能决定宏观相，网络几何是固定局部相互作用参数下集体振荡的关键决定因素。

title: Layer- and Orbital-Selective Mott Physics Driving Dimensional Crossover in Nickelate Superlattices
summary: The design of quantum materials to manipulate dimensionality and electronic correlations is a central focus in the exploration of emergent phenomena. We propose a new correlated quantum material platform for realizing a layer- and orbital-selective Mott transition (LOSMT) in a nickelate heterostructure by combining bilayer and monolayer LaNiO$_3$ separated by a monolayer LaAlO$_3$ spacer under compressive strain from the LaAlO$_3$ substrate. The LOSMT emerges from the layer-dependent dimensional confinement of the apical Ni($d$)-$z^2$ orbital and strain-induced lifting of the orbital degeneracy. The monolayer LaNiO$_3$ exhibits an orbital-selective Mott insulating phase with a Mott gap in the Ni($d$)-$z^2$ orbital, whereas the bilayer LaNiO$_3$ exhibits a multi-orbital metallic phase, triggering the orbital-selective Mott transition upon cooling $via$ inter-layer hybridization of the Ni($d$)-$z^2$ orbitals. Calculations within the density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory (DFT+DMFT) framework reveal that the LOSMT drives a dimensional crossover by enabling out-of-plane electronic transport through the metallization of the localized apical Ni($d$)-$z^2$ orbital, while the planar Ni($d$)-$x^2-y^2$ orbital remains itinerant across the transition. The emergence of the LOSMT provides a new pathway for engineering correlated quantum materials toward unconventional superconductivity and Mott-transistor functionalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种镍酸盐异质结新平台，通过层与轨道选择性的Mott转变（LOSMT）实现维度调控与关联电子效应。
AI.motivation: 探索通过维度调控与电子关联设计量子材料以实现涌现现象是核心课题，需要新平台来操控层与轨道选择性Mott转变。
AI.method: 构建由双层与单层LaNiO₃被单层LaAlO₃间隔层隔开、并受LaAlO₃衬底压应变的异质结；采用DFT+DMFT框架进行计算。
AI.result: 单层LaNiO₃呈现轨道选择性Mott绝缘相（Ni d-z²轨道有Mott能隙），双层LaNiO₃为多轨道金属相；通过Ni d-z²轨道层间杂化触发LOSMT，驱动维度交叉，实现面外电子输运金属化，而平面内d-x²-y²轨道保持巡游。
AI.conclusion: 该LOSMT为工程化关联量子材料、探索非常规超导和Mott晶体管功能提供了新路径。

title: Particle Inertia-Driven Pore Formation over Material Property Effects in Laser Powder-blown Directed Energy Deposition
summary: Laser Powder-blown Directed Energy Deposition (LP-DED) offers flexibility for process and materials and high productivity (~5 kg/h), but process-induced pores often compromise mechanical properties. This study utilizes in-situ X-ray synchrotron imaging to compare pore formation mechanisms in Ti-6Al-4V (Ti64) and stainless steel 316L (SS316L), focusing on the interplay between particle dynamics and thermophysical properties. Four distinct pore formation mechanisms were identified, with most large pores originating from the closure of cavities formed behind incident particles impinging on the melt pool. High Weber number (We >> 1) governs this behavior, indicating that particle inertia, rather than thermophysical property differences, is the primary driver of large pore formation. The study demonstrates that increased energy density leads to larger melt pool volumes, facilitating deeper particle penetration. This greater penetration depth directly correlates with increased pore diameters. While thermophysical properties secondarily influence pore-formation frequency and cavity symmetry, particle inertia remains the dominant factor. These findings provide a physically grounded basis for understanding and controlling porosity in powder-blown DED processes.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用同步辐射原位X射线成像，对比Ti64与SS316L在LP-DED中的气孔形成机制，发现多数大气孔源于入射颗粒撞击熔池后方空腔的闭合，高韦伯数表明颗粒惯性是主要驱动因素。
AI.motivation: LP-DED具有高灵活性和高生产率（约5 kg/h），但工艺诱导的气孔常损害力学性能。需要从物理机制层面理解并控制粉末吹送DED中的气孔问题，尤其是颗粒动力学与热物理性质之间的相互作用尚不清晰。
AI.method: 采用同步辐射原位X射线成像技术，对比Ti-6Al-4V（Ti64）和SS316L两种材料的气孔形成过程，重点考察颗粒动力学与热物理性质的相互作用，并分析能量密度、熔池体积与颗粒穿透深度的关系。
AI.result: 识别出四种不同的气孔形成机制；多数大气孔来自入射颗粒撞击熔池后方所形成空腔的闭合；该行为由高韦伯数（We >> 1）主导，表明颗粒惯性而非热物理性质差异是大气孔形成的主要驱动力。增加能量密度会扩大熔池体积，促进更深的颗粒穿透，穿透深度与气孔直径直接正相关。热物理性质次要影响气孔形成频率和空腔对称性。
AI.conclusion: 颗粒惯性是粉末吹送DED中大气孔形成的主导因素，热物理性质起次要作用。研究为理解和控制该工艺中的气孔率提供了物理依据。

title: Neural Modal Decomposition: Architectural Priors from Observables
summary: Many engineering building blocks behave as multi-port linear time-invariant systems. RF cavities, photonic devices, and superconducting quantum chips, despite their different underlying physics, all share a common mathematical structure for their port-level response. Each entry of the response matrix is a sum of contributions from a small number of intrinsic resonant modes, the pole-residue form. A model capable of predicting such responses for arbitrary geometries and arbitrary port configurations, while simultaneously extracting the underlying eigenmode structure, would therefore establish a foundational design principle spanning all these domains. We propose a neural framework that learns this modal decomposition end-to-end, supervised only by system-level observables and without supervising the modal parameters themselves. The architecture decomposes into a port-independent pole predictor and two port-dependent coupling predictors whose outputs are combined entry-wise, separating intrinsic from port-dependent features. This factorization yields a single trained model that generalizes to port counts unseen during training, dissolving the $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ scaling barrier of direct regression. Despite no modal supervision, the freely-parameterized poles converge to physically meaningful eigenmodes, verified by cross-validation against the AAA rational approximation algorithm. We instantiate the framework in radio-frequency electromagnetic surrogate modeling. A model trained only on 2-port data accurately predicts $N$-port responses unseen during training.

AI.tldr: 提出一种端到端神经网络框架，从系统级观测中学习多端口线性时不变系统的模态分解（极点-留数形式），只用2端口数据训练即可预测任意N端口响应。
AI.motivation: RF腔体、光子器件、超导量子芯片等虽物理机制不同，但在端口响应上共享同样的极点-留数数学结构。现有方法受限于O(N^2)缩放，且缺乏能同时提取本征模态、泛化到任意几何与端口配置的统一模型。
AI.method: 将响应矩阵解耦为与端口无关的极点预测器和两个与端口相关的耦合预测器，逐元素组合，从而分离本征特征与端口相关特征。仅用系统级可观测量监督，不监督模态参数本身，实现端到端学习。
AI.result: 单一模型可泛化到训练时未见过的端口数量，打破O(N^2)直接回归瓶颈；无模态监督下自由参数化的极点收敛到物理有意义的本征模态（与AAA有理逼近交叉验证）；在RF电磁代理建模中，仅用2端口数据训练的模型能准确预测未见过的N端口响应。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以模态分解为核心，为RF、光子、超导量子等多领域的多端口系统建模建立统一的设计原理，兼具可扩展性与物理可解释性。

title: Compile-once operation graphs for reusable continuous unitary transformations
summary: Continuous unitary transformations repeatedly evaluate the same operator algebra as the coefficients of a Hamiltonian and its observables evolve. We compile these algebraic relationships once into a numerical operation graph that can be saved and reused for new coefficient sets, additional operators, derivatives, and forward and reverse calculations on CPUs and GPUs. Reuse is demonstrated by applying the same compiled graph to hydrogen and deuterium parameterizations of a reduced molecular model without regenerating the operator equations. The main computational challenge is construction: generated many-body algebra can contain hundreds of millions of contributions before numerical propagation begins. We address this by determining the required storage in advance and writing contributions directly into the final disk-backed representation. In a deliberately large diagnostic-enabled stress test containing more than 350 million generated contributions, peak host memory remains only about 7\% above the final stored size. Cross-checks show that CPU and GPU implementations, forward and reverse operations, and repeated loading of the compiled graph reproduce the tested operations to numerical precision. This compile-once representation separates expensive operator-algebra generation from the numerical transformations that reuse it.

AI.tldr: 提出将连续酉变换中重复的算子代数关系一次性编译为可保存、复用的数值运算图，避免重复生成代数方程，并解决大规模构造的内存问题。
AI.motivation: 连续酉变换在哈密顿量系数和可观测量演化时会反复评估相同的算子代数，逐一重新生成算子方程成本高、浪费算力。
AI.method: 将代数关系编译成一次性的数值运算图，可保存并复用于新的系数集合、额外算子、导数以及CPU/GPU上的正向与反向计算；通过预先确定所需存储并将贡献直接写入磁盘后端表示来解决构造挑战。
AI.result: 同一编译图无需重新生成算子方程即可应用于氢和氘参数化的简化分子模型；在超过3.5亿贡献的压力测试中，峰值主机内存仅比最终存储大小高约7%；CPU与GPU实现、正反向操作及重复加载均以数值精度复现。
AI.conclusion: 这种“一次编译”表示将昂贵的算子代数生成与重复使用它的数值变换分离开来。

title: Spectral density of angular momentum transfer from a swift electron to a large spherical nanoparticle
summary: Swift electrons in scanning transmission electron microscopy transfer both linear and angular momentum to nanoparticles, underlying electron-beam-driven nanoscale manipulation ("electron tweezers"). Prior theory relied either on the small-particle (dipolar) approximation, valid only well below experimentally relevant sizes, or on frequency-integrated multipolar calculations that leave the spectral structure of the interaction unresolved. Here we present a fully retarded, causal, multipole-converged electrodynamical methodology for the angular momentum transfer from a swift electron to an isolated spherical nanoparticle, based on a closed-surface Maxwell stress tensor formulation whose angular integrals reduce analytically to a small, material- and trajectory-independent set of irreducible integrals over associated Legendre functions. This lowers the cost of the double multipolar sum from O(l_max^4) to O(l_max^3), enabling convergence up to l_max=51 for nanoparticles as large as a=50 nm, nearly four times the order of the largest previous calculation at this size and previously unreached for an optically complex material, at three to four orders of magnitude lower cost. Applied to aluminum and gold nanoparticles up to a=50 nm, the method resolves the transfer's spectral density across the full frequency domain, showing it is set by interference between the electron and scattered fields, dominating at essentially every frequency; the electric contribution exceeds the magnetic one by two to three orders of magnitude, though spectral resolution reveals sign changes in the magnetic term hidden in the frequency-integrated transfer. At a=50 nm, gold transfers substantially more angular momentum than aluminum despite its more intricate response, by a factor growing with velocity from about 2x at v=0.5c to more than 6x as v->c (fixed b=51 nm from the nanoparticle center).

AI.tldr: 该文提出了一个全延迟、因果、多极收敛的电动力学方法，用于计算快速电子向球形纳米颗粒的角动量转移，将计算成本从O(l_max^4)降至O(l_max^3)，并揭示了角动量转移的频谱结构。
AI.motivation: 现有理论要么依赖仅适用于远小于实验尺寸的小颗粒（偶极）近似，要么采用频率积分多极计算而无法解析相互作用的频谱结构。
AI.method: 基于闭合曲面麦克斯韦应力张量公式，其角积分可解析约化为少量与材料和轨迹无关的连带勒让德函数不可约积分，从而将双多极求和的成本从O(l_max^4)降至O(l_max^3)，实现l_max=51的收敛，适用于a=50 nm的颗粒。
AI.result: 应用于铝和金纳米颗粒（至a=50 nm），解析了全频域角动量转移的频谱密度，发现其由电子场与散射场的干涉决定并在几乎每个频率占主导；电贡献比磁贡献大2-3个数量级，但频谱分辨揭示磁项存在符号变化；a=50 nm时金转移的角动量显著多于铝，且随速度增加倍数增大（v=0.5c约2倍，v→c超过6倍）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在更低成本下实现了更大尺寸和更高多极阶数的收敛，可解析角动量转移的完整频谱结构，为电子束驱动纳米尺度操控提供了更精确的理论工具。

title: Disorder-driven transport in ZrN thin films grown by ion-beam-assisted sputtering
summary: We investigate the structural and electronic transport properties of zirconium nitride (ZrN) thin films grown by dc ion-beam assisted sputtering (IBAS) as a function of nitrogen partial pressure, sputtering power and deposition temperature. Variation of growth conditions enables controlled tuning from disordered metallic and superconducting behavior to insulating transport. Increasing nitrogen flow drives an increase in sheet resistance, suppression of superconducting transition temperature, and non-metallic conduction. XRD shows no measurable change in long range crystallinity or order. In the insulating regime, low-temperature transport is well described by 3D Mott variable-range hopping (VRH), with the characteristic temperature $T_0$ increasing monotonically with sheet resistance over four orders of magnitude. Despite this strong correlation between $T_0$ and disorder, $T_c$ exhibits no systematic dependence on $T_0$, indicating a decoupling between localization physics and the superconducting energy scale. Magnetotransport measurements are not well described by the standard BCS model nor the dirty type-II Werthamer-Helfand-Hohenberg model. The phase boundary is instead captured by a free-exponent power law, $μ_0 H_{c2}(T) = μ_0 H_{c2}(0)[1 - (T/T_c)^{n}]$ with $n \approx 3.47$, and extrapolates to $μ_0 H_{c2}(0) \approx 6.4$ T. The films have an extracted coherence length of 7 nm. These results establish IBAS-grown ZrN as a broadly tunable platform for investigating disorder-driven transport and the crossover between metallic conduction, electronic localization, and superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 研究了IBAS生长的ZrN薄膜性质，发现可调控从超导金属到绝缘转变，低温符合3D Mott VRH，Tc与T0解耦。
AI.motivation: 探究ZrN薄膜中无序驱动的输运行为及金属导电、电子局域化与超导之间的交叉，需要一个可广泛调控的平台。
AI.method: 采用直流离子束辅助溅射(IBAS)生长ZrN薄膜，改变氮分压、溅射功率和沉积温度；用XRD、电输运和磁输运测量表征结构与输运性质。
AI.result: 氮流量增加导致薄层电阻上升、Tc受抑制、出现非金属导电；XRD显示长程结晶性无明显变化。绝缘区低温输运符合3D Mott VRH，T0随薄层电阻单调增加达四个数量级。Tc与T0无系统关系。磁输运不符合标准BCS及脏型II WHH模型，相边界由自由指数幂律描述，n≈3.47，μ0Hc2(0)≈6.4 T，相干长度约7 nm。
AI.conclusion: IBAS生长的ZrN是一个可广泛调控的平台，用于研究无序驱动输运及金属导电、电子局域化与超导之间的交叉。

title: Phase ordering kinetics in Light-Heavy-Vacancy model: unusual coarsening dynamics
summary: We study a one dimensional lattice model of coupled driven system where two kinds of hardcore particle species, `light' and `heavy', move on a fluctuating landscape. Light particles prefer to move upward along the local height gradient of the landscape, and heavy particles prefer to move downhill. In addition, these particle species also exert bias on the local height profile. The unoccupied or vacant parts of the landscape experience no bias and undergo symmetric height fluctuations. In an earlier work, we had derived a phase diagram of the system consisting of different kinds of ordered and disordered phases. In the ordered phase, one or both particle species phase-separate, while the landscape forms a large hill or deep valley. Here we study coarsening by monitoring the development of long-range order in the particles and landscape from an initially disordered state. Unlike conventional phase-ordering systems, where coarsening proceeds through the formation and merger of ordered domains, here we find that domains formed at early times become unsustainable at later times. Instead of merging together, these early domains disintegrate and new domains emerge which finally give rise to large scale ordered structure in the long time limit, resulting a highly unusual coarsening behavior. For particle coarsening, the characteristic length scale grows with two distinctly different power law exponents at early and late times. The landscape coarsening is even more dramatic where the length scale decreases for brief time-intervals, instead of increasing continuously. The height fluctuations of the landscape shows periodic oscillations with time during the coarsening phase. Using linear hydrodynamics we explain that this is caused by three normal modes which move through the system like travelling waves. We calculate the propagation velocities of these modes within mean field approximation.

AI.tldr: 研究一维耦合驱动格点模型中轻/重硬核粒子与涨落地形的共轭相分离共arsening，发现非常规畴演化与双指数标度。
AI.motivation: 常规相排序系统中共arsening依赖有序畴形成与合并，但耦合粒子-地形驱动系统中是否存在类似机制尚不清楚，需研究其从无序态到有序态的动力学。
AI.method: 监测粒子和地形长程有序的发展；计算特征长度尺度随时间演化；用线性流体力学分析地形高度涨落；用平均场近似求三个简正模传播速度。
AI.result: 早期畴后期不可持续，非合并而是解体并产生新畴，最终形成大尺度有序结构；粒子特征长度呈两个不同幂律指数；地形长度尺度短期下降；高度涨落周期性振荡，由三个简正模以行波形式传播引起。
AI.conclusion: 该耦合驱动系统呈现高度非传统的共arsening行为，与常规相排序系统显著不同。

title: Bilinear magnon--exciton coupling in biased ferromagnetic electron--hole bilayers
summary: Two-dimensional magnetic semiconductors provide a unique platform where strong magnon--exciton interactions can be realized. Owing to the intrinsic energy mismatch between excitons and magnons, however, these interactions are typically between the exciton density and magnons. We propose biased ferromagnetic electron--hole bilayers, where the exciton energy gap can be lowered with the voltage bias, as a platform in which excitons and magnons can instead couple resonantly. Starting from the microscopic exchange interactions between electrons and localized magnetic moments, we demonstrate the linear hybridization of magnons and spin-flip excitons in this regime. As the exciton energy is lowered further, a magnon--exciton Bose--Einstein condensate is formed. We show that this condensate is further modified by an attractive magnon--exciton density--density interaction, which we derive microscopically. We study the condensate's collective modes and demonstrate their hybridization with the magnons, providing an alternative detection mechanism for the formation of exciton condensates.

AI.tldr: 提出偏压铁磁电子-空穴双层作为平台，使激子能量可被电压调低，从而实现激子与磁子的共振耦合，并预言磁子-激子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚及集体模杂化。
AI.motivation: 二维磁性半导体中磁子-激子相互作用通常因能量失配而仅停留在激子密度与磁子之间，无法实现共振耦合，限制了对二者强耦合物理的研究。
AI.method: 从电子与局域磁矩间的微观交换相互作用出发，研究偏压铁磁电子-空穴双层中激子能隙随电压降低时的物理行为，推导磁子与自旋翻转激子的线性杂化及吸引型磁子-激子密度-密度相互作用。
AI.result: 证明了磁子与自旋翻转激子的线性杂化；激子能量进一步降低时形成磁子-激子玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚，且该凝聚受吸引型密度-密度相互作用修正；凝聚体集体模与磁子发生杂化。
AI.conclusion: 偏压铁磁电子-空穴双层可实现磁子-激子共振耦合与凝聚，集体模杂化为激子凝聚的形成提供替代探测机制。

title: Symmetry- and Property-Aware Crystal Generation with Reinforcement Learning for Inverse Materials Design
summary: The inverse design of crystalline materials ultimately seeks structures with desired physical properties. However, for many functional responses, a favorable numerical value is meaningful only when supported by the symmetry of the underlying crystal. Without the appropriate crystallographic constraints, an apparent response may be ill defined, accidental, or not symmetry protected. Here we introduce SPARC, a symmetry- and property-aware reinforcement learning framework that optimizes physical objectives while preserving the structural conditions required for their realization. We demonstrate SPARC on two complementary tasks. The first targets strong uniaxial dielectric anisotropy, a tensorial response that is well defined only within appropriate crystal classes. The second maximizes the spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency, a scalar device-level objective without a prescribed symmetry class, allowing the framework to identify favorable crystallographic motifs. These results show that symmetry is not merely an additional design constraint, but a physical foundation for generating candidates with meaningful, robust, and realizable functional properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPARC，一个对称性与性质感知的强化学习框架，用于在保持晶体对称性约束的同时优化物理目标，实现晶体材料的逆向设计。
AI.motivation: 晶体材料逆向设计需在满足对称性条件下才有意义的物理响应；若缺乏晶体学约束，响应可能是定义不当、偶然的或非对称保护的。
AI.method: SPARC：对称性与性质感知的强化学习框架，优化物理目标的同时保持实现该性质所需的结构条件。应用于两个任务：强单轴介电各向异性（仅特定晶类中良定义的张量响应），以及最大化光谱极限最大效率（无预定对称类的标量器件级目标）。
AI.result: 框架成功在两个任务中生成候选：一是在合适晶类中实现强单轴介电各向异性，二是识别出有利于SLME的晶体学结构基元。
AI.conclusion: 对称性不仅是额外的设计约束，更是生成有意义、稳健且可实现功能性质候选材料的物理基础。

title: Transformed in Translation: Two-Stage Structural Uncertainty in LLM-Based Scientific Autoformalization
summary: Scientific autoformalization turns verbal accounts into executable mathematics, but executable code does not settle which model has been constructed. We examine two sources of structural uncertainty: the formalizer that generates a response law, and the recurrence that turns that law into trajectories. In secondary analyses of an openly archived crossed experiment, we studied 320 response maps generated by two pinned language-model formalizers from five engineered cognitive accounts within one sparse quadratic grammar and 16 randomized blocks. With whole blocks held out, source-account identity was recovered at 78.8% accuracy (chance 20.0%) and formalizer identity at 96.3% (chance 50.0%; both p < 0.001). Program size was the stronger single feature family; a pre-specified exploratory comparison found no stable source-account predictive gain from local geometry beyond size. Holding every response map fixed, we then evaluated five recurrence families spanning 33 configurations and 1,013,760 finite-horizon trajectories. Added feedback, projection and leak produced sharply different outcome distributions. The consequential distinction was which comparisons survived: median cross-recurrence rank concordance was 0.73 for endpoint magnitude but 0.05 for settling, among the configuration pairs with defined rankings. Thus a common mathematical language did not erase translation provenance, and robust ordering under one observable did not transfer to another. Scientific autoformalization is usefully studied as model-space construction: the generated ensemble and its dynamical embedding are both part of the specification supporting a scientific claim.

AI.tldr: 科学自动形式化的可执行代码无法唯一确定所构建的模型；形式化器来源与递归规则都带来结构性不确定性。
AI.motivation: 可执行数学代码虽能运行，但并不能确定性地唯一指定所构建的模型，存在两大结构不确定性来源：生成响应律的形式化器，以及将响应律转化为轨迹的递归方式。
AI.method: 对公开存档的交叉实验做二次分析：320个响应图（两种固定语言模型形式化器×五种认知账户×同一稀疏二次文法、16个随机区块）；留出整块交叉验证，用分类器恢复来源账户与形式化器身份；再固定响应图，评估5类递归家族、33种配置、1,013,760条有限时域轨迹。
AI.result: 来源账户身份恢复准确率78.8%（随机20.0%），形式化器身份96.3%（随机50.0%），均p<0.001；程序规模是最强单一特征，局部几何相较规模无稳定增益。递归中加入反馈、投影与泄漏产生显著不同结果分布；中位数跨递归秩一致性：端点幅值为0.73，稳定化为0.05，排序稳健性无法在观测指标间迁移。
AI.conclusion: 共同数学语言无法消除翻译来源痕迹，某一观测下的稳健排序不能迁移到另一观测；科学自动形式化应作为"模型空间构建"来研究，生成的集成与其动力嵌入共同构成科学主张的规格说明。

title: Exchange-Correlation Potentials and Energies from Inverse Generalized Kohn-Sham Calculations
summary: The Kohn-Sham (KS) formulation of density functional theory (DFT) is a map from the many-electron problem to an effective single-electron problem that is governed by a local multiplicative potential. The generalized-Kohn-Sham (GKS) formalism extends it to permit any single-electron operator---nonlocal, local non-multiplicative, local multiplicative, or any combination of them. Doing so expands the scope and ease of modeling the exchange-correlation (XC) functional in DFT, which encodes the complicated many-electron interactions into a mean-field of the electron density. However, unlike KS theory, development of XC functionals in GKS theory has been hindered by the absence of corresponding exact XC potentials and energies. We present the exact XC potentials and energies for atoms and molecules by solving the inverse GKS problem, using highly accurate correlated \textit{ab initio} densities. Our approach is validated across weakly and strongly correlated systems. We further examine a common, yet untested, assumption that KS and GKS correlation potentials and energies are similar, finding instead that they differ substantially in strongly correlated systems. Overall, this work offers a powerful tool to model next-generation of XC functionals within the GKS formalism of DFT.

AI.tldr: 本文通过求解逆GKS问题，利用高精度关联从头算密度，给出了原子和分子的精确GKS交换关联势与能量，并发现强关联体系中KS与GKS关联势和能量差异显著。
AI.motivation: 广义Kohn-Sham（GKS）形式可扩展DFT中交换关联泛函的建模范围，但不同于KS理论，GKS理论缺乏对应的精确交换关联势与能量，阻碍了其泛函发展。
AI.method: 通过求解逆GKS问题，并使用高度精确的关联从头算密度，得到原子和分子的精确交换关联势与能量。
AI.result: 方法在弱关联和强关联体系上均得到验证；进一步检验了"KS与GKS关联势和能量相似"这一常见但未经测试的假设，发现在强关联体系中二者差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在GKS框架下建模新一代交换关联泛函提供了有力工具。

title: First Demonstration of Flip DRAM from Process, Architecture to System to Push DRAM Scaling beyond 4F2: 2F2 Self-aligned Flip Vertical Channel Transistor (FVCT) DRAM and Flip WL (FWL) 3D-DRAM
summary: For the first time, we proposed a novel stacking technology for DRAM scaling by flipping and backside processes, making full use of DRAM wafer's backside and investigating it on both 4F2 and 3D-DRAM. For 4F2 VCT, 2F2 Flip VCT featuring self-aligned back-to-back stacked 1T1C bitcell, with various BL and WL configurations, were studied and key process modules such as self-aligned stacked vertical channel, BL and WL formations, wafer bonding and flipping, substrate thinning and low-R Co storage node (SN) were successfully developed, addressing the potential thermal, misalign and parasitic concerns in the Flip VCT process. A full DRAM DTCO framework was also established from device to mat and chip level. Compared to 4F2 VCT DRAM with the same mat size, 2F2 FVCT delivers 27.5% less parasitics, 11% better sense margin, 16.3% higher charge sharing (CS) speed and 50% less area. For 3D-DRAM, a brand-new flip WL staircase design with peripheral circuit innovations was studied and proved to have 25% density gain, 15.1% faster turn-on speed and 6.8% less CS time, proving further extendibility of flip technology on DRAM.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出通过翻转与背面工艺的DRAM堆叠技术，在4F2和3D-DRAM上验证，显著提升了性能与密度。
AI.motivation: DRAM微缩遇到瓶颈，需新型堆叠与工艺技术以延续scaling，充分利用晶圆背面。
AI.method: 提出Flip VCT架构（2F2，自对准背靠背堆叠1T1C），开发自对准堆叠垂直沟道、BL/WL形成、晶圆键合翻转、衬底减薄、低阻Co存储节点等工艺；建立从器件到mat和芯片级的DTCO框架；对3D-DRAM提出翻转WL阶梯设计及外围电路创新。
AI.result: 2F2 FVCT相比同mat尺寸4F2 VCT：寄生减少27.5%、感测裕度提升11%、电荷共享速度提升16.3%、面积减少50%。3D-DRAM翻转WL阶梯：密度增益25%、开启速度提升15.1%、CS时间减少6.8%。
AI.conclusion: 翻转堆叠技术可有效解决热、对准与寄生问题，在4F2和3D-DRAM上均展现性能与密度优势，证明其在DRAM上的可扩展性。

title: Vortex rivers and multiple voltage transitions in superconducting MgB$_2$ thin films
summary: Vortex dynamics govern the dissipation and magneto-resistive properties of type-II superconductors. At large transport currents, the current-voltage ($I$-$V$) characteristics of a superconductor in the mixed state usually exhibit a nonlinear upturn followed by an abrupt jump occurring due to a flux-flow instability. However, other transition behaviors are also possible, including the formation of phase-slip lines and normal domains. Which mechanism dominates depends on the sample uniformity, its dimensions relative to the coherence length and penetration depth, and the rates of electron energy relaxation and heat removal. Here, based on the time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau equation, we present the results of numerical modeling of the $I$-$V$ curves of superconducting films with various types of disorder. For a grain-boundary defect mesh, we find multiple voltage transitions overlaid with a nonlinear upturn of the $I$-$V$ curves. For randomly arranged elongated defects, the $I$-$V$ curves exhibit voltage steps, whereas for L-shaped defects oriented perpendicular to the transport current, the $I$-$V$ curves show extended linear regimes separated by voltage transitions. We analyze the evolution of the order parameter along the $I$-$V$ curves and discuss the experimental accessibility of the revealed dynamics regimes.

AI.tldr: 基于含时Ginzburg-Landau方程数值模拟不同无序类型超导薄膜的I-V曲线，揭示不同缺陷构型导致的多重电压跃变、电压台阶及线性区等特征。
AI.motivation: 涡旋动力学决定第二类超导体的耗散与磁阻特性；大传输电流下I-V非线性上翘后突变（磁通流不稳定性）之外，还可能存在相滑移线、正常畴等转变，主导机制取决于样品均匀性、尺寸及能量弛豫/散热速率，需厘清不同无序下的行为。
AI.method: 采用含时Ginzburg-Landau方程，对不同类型无序的超导薄膜I-V曲线进行数值建模。考察三种缺陷：晶界缺陷网格、随机排列的拉长缺陷、垂直于电流取向的L形缺陷，并沿I-V曲线分析序参量演化。
AI.result: 晶界缺陷网格：出现叠加在I-V非线性上翘上的多重电压转变；随机拉长缺陷：I-V呈电压台阶；垂直电流的L形缺陷：呈被电压转变分隔的延伸线性区。并讨论这些动力学机制的实验可观测性。
AI.conclusion: 无序类型和缺陷几何显著影响超导薄膜的I-V转变行为，为实验识别不同涡旋耗散机制提供了理论依据和预测。

title: Conserved quantities in a bosonic tight-binding chain with non-Hermitian quartic terms
summary: We investigate local conserved quantities in non-Hermitian bosonic lattice systems whose underlying Yang--Baxter structure remains unclear. Focusing on a one-dimensional bosonic chain with quartic interactions of creation operators, we provide a new representation of the local conserved quantities previously constructed by Sanatani and Shiraishi. Using Fourier transformation and trigonometric identities, we systematically derive these conserved quantities and show directly that they form a mutually commuting family. We further extend the construction to interactions extending beyond a single site, cubic interactions, asymmetric hopping, and an on-site potential. Our results provide a unified framework for constructing and characterizing local conserved quantities in this class of non-Hermitian many-body systems.

AI.tldr: 研究非厄米玻色晶格系统的局域守恒量，给出新表示并推广到多种相互作用情形。
AI.motivation: 非厄米玻色晶格系统缺乏明确的Yang-Baxter结构，其局域守恒量的构造与刻画尚不清晰。
AI.method: 聚焦含创建算符四次相互作用的一维玻色链，利用Fourier变换与三角恒等式系统推导守恒量，并验证其互相对易性。
AI.result: 给出Sanatani-Shiraishi局域守恒量的新表示，证明其对易性，并推广到跨格点相互作用、三次相互作用、非对称跃迁及在位势情形。
AI.conclusion: 为该类非厄米多体系统局域守恒量的构造与刻画提供了统一框架。

title: Exact solutions of hidden free fermion models
summary: Hidden-free-fermion (HFF) Hamiltonians exhibit free-fermion spectra despite lacking an explicit quadratic representation, yet their algebraic provenance and periodic-boundary behavior remain open questions. Here we establish that a broad class of HFF models arises from distinct Lax operator realizations of a twisted multistate Perk--Schultz \(R\) matrix. Its reflected degeneration generates a closed finite hierarchy of mutually commuting transfer matrices, whose functional relations determine the complete many-body spectrum. As a decisive example, we solve the inhomogeneous free-fermions-in-disguise (FFD) chain, which exhibits HFF, nested HFF, or interacting spectra, depending on its coupling. The homogeneous FFD chain with both one-wrap and periodic boundary conditions exhibits an emergent cubic finite-size gap while retaining the exact \(z=3/2\) bulk behavior. The construction extends to higher-state and face-type realizations, providing a common algebraic framework for coupling-dependent spectral organization and multiscale behavior in interacting quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了隐藏自由费米子(HFF)Hamiltonian的代数起源：它们源自twisted multi-state Perk-Schultz R矩阵的不同Lax算子实现，并构建出有限对易转移矩阵层级以求解完整多体谱。
AI.motivation: HFF Hamiltonian虽具自由费米子谱却缺乏显式二次表示，其代数来源及周期边界行为尚未解决。
AI.method: 通过twisted multistate Perk-Schultz R矩阵的不同Lax算子实现构造HFF模型，利用反射退化生成有限对易转移矩阵层级，并由函数关系确定多体谱；以非均匀FFD链为例求解。
AI.result: 非均匀FFD链依耦合呈现HFF、嵌套HFF或相互作用谱；均匀FFD链在one-wrap与周期边界下出现涌现立方有限尺寸gap，同时保持精确的z=3/2体行为。
AI.conclusion: 该构造可推广至更高态与face-type实现，为相互作用量子系统中耦合依赖的谱组织与多尺度行为提供统一代数框架。

title: Non-reactive sintering enhances density and ionic conductivity of NASICON solid electrolytes
summary: NASICON materials are promising solid electrolytes for room-temperature sodium solid-state batteries and are typically synthesized via solid-state reaction. While sintering has been extensively studied, the effect of calcination on electrolyte properties remains poorly understood. In this work, the temperatures at which the NASICON phase forms in Na3Zr2Si2PO12 and Na3.4Zr2Si2.4P0.6O12 are identified. Calcination temperature is then varied between 900 °C and 1200 °C to obtain powders with different degrees of reaction prior to sintering. Under identical sintering conditions, higher NASICON phase content in the calcined powder is shown to yield denser electrolytes. Non-reactive sintering also improves grain boundary conductivity, increasing it by 130% for Na3.4Zr2Si2.4P0.6O12 and raising total conductivity from 1.60 to 2.95 mS/cm for powders calcined at 900 °C and 1200 °C, respectively. Finally, it is shown that phosphorus loss during processing compromises cycling stability against Na metal electrodes, and that adding off-stoichiometric phosphorus resolves this issue, while reaching a critical current density of 5.0 mA/cm^2 and a room-temperature conductivity of 3.82 mS/cm with over 400 hours of stable cycling. Overall, these findings directly relate synthesis and processing conditions to the final material properties and electrochemical performance of NASICON solid electrolytes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究煅烧温度对NASICON固态电解质性能的影响，发现煅烧后NASICON相含量越高、烧结体越致密，晶界电导率提升，总电导率由1.60增至2.95 mS/cm；补加非化学计量磷可解决磷损失问题，实现5.0 mA/cm²临界电流密度、3.82 mS/cm室温电导率及超400小时稳定循环。
AI.motivation: NASICON是有前景的室温钠固态电池电解质，通常经固相反应合成。烧结已被广泛研究，但煅烧对电解质性能的影响仍不清楚，因此需要厘清煅烧条件与最终材料性能的关系。
AI.method: 确定Na3Zr2Si2PO12和Na3.4Zr2Si2.4P0.6O12中NASICON相的形成温度；将煅烧温度在900–1200 °C间变化以获得不同反应程度的粉末，再在相同条件下烧结，比较相含量、致密度与电导率；并通过补加非化学计量磷来补偿磷损失。
AI.result: 煅烧粉末中NASICON相含量越高，烧结体越致密；非反应性烧结改善晶界电导率，对Na3.4Zr2Si2.4P0.6O12提升130%，900和1200 °C煅烧样品总电导率分别为1.60和2.95 mS/cm。磷损失损害对钠金属电极的循环稳定性，补磷后临界电流密度达5.0 mA/cm²，室温电导率3.82 mS/cm，稳定循环超400小时。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将合成与加工条件同NASICON固态电解质的最终材料性质及电化学性能直接关联，为优化煅烧与磷配比提供指导。

title: Digital Twin of an Argon-Hydrogen Plasma Reactor
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, COMSOL Conference Cambridge 2026 proceedings
summary: The principal proof of concept revolves around an argon-hydrogen plasma reactor that melts, reduces, atomizes and quenches critical raw material in one step, with premium spherical powder as the deliverable output and control of the composition chemistry. Each usage of the reactor is monitored through thermocouples and pressure sensors, which provide a daily data source of the real-world experiments.
