The reactor is modeled through COMSOL Multiphysics, which represents the core solver used to provide multiphysics simulations. The usage of COMSOL is complemented with Artificial Intelligence (AI) models, to enable seamless data assimilation and optimization. This paper presents the COMSOL twin of the reaction chamber and converging-diverging nozzle, together with a custom phase-change particle-tracing layer validated on Ti-6Al-4V (Ti64). Moreover, we highlight how the synergy between COMSOL simulations and AI-based digital surrogates can be leveraged to build self-consistent optimization loops geared toward (i) fully autonomous live control of the reactor and (ii) optimization of the process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于COMSOL多物理场仿真与AI数字代理相结合的反应器数字孪生框架，用于氩氢等离子体反应器的自主控制与工艺优化，并以Ti-6Al-4V验证。
AI.motivation: 关键原材料的一步法熔化、还原、雾化与淬火过程需要精确控制成分化学与球形粉末品质，而实验数据与实时优化需求促使建立仿真-数据融合的数字孪生体系。
AI.method: 以氩氢等离子体反应器为对象，通过热电偶与压力传感器采集日常实验数据；采用COMSOL Multiphysics作为核心求解器构建反应腔与拉伐尔喷嘴的数字孪生，并开发自定义相变粒子追踪层；结合AI模型实现数据同化与优化，形成自洽优化闭环。
AI.result: 建立了反应腔与收敛-扩张喷嘴的COMSOL孪生模型及相变粒子追踪层，并在Ti-6Al-4V(Ti64)上完成验证；展示了COMSOL仿真与AI数字代理协同用于优化环路的可行性。
AI.conclusion: COMSOL仿真与AI数字代理的协同可支撑自洽优化环路，服务于反应器的完全自主实时控制与工艺优化。

title: Toward Predictive Hydride Bond Energetics with Neural-Network Wavefunctions
summary: Accurate prediction of transition-metal hydride (TM-H) bond dissociation energies (BDEs) remains challenging because of strong electron correlation, relativistic effects, and nuclear quantum contributions. Here, we assess the performance of neural-network variational Monte Carlo (NN-VMC) based on the Psiformer ansatz for systems with increasing complexity (LiH, OH, TiH and NiH), and compare it against CCSDT(Q)/CBS as well as available theoretical and experimental data. Throughout this study, both NN-VMC and ab initio calculations employ a common ccECP Hamiltonian to enable tractable and consistent comparisons. To reduce finite-training errors, we introduce complementary zero-variance and infinite-step extrapolation schemes. For LiH and OH systems, NN-VMC yields total energies that differ within sub-milli Hartree compared to CBS extrapolated ab initio results and the BDE differences remain under 2$σ$. In case of Ti and TiH, the variational NN-VMC energies at the end of training are already consistent with CCSD(T)/CBS, while post-training extrapolation systematically closes the gap towards the CCSDT(Q)/CBS results. In contrast, NiH provides a stringent test of wavefunction expressivity, where increasing the number of determinants in NN-wavefunction ansatz improves the recovered correlation energy. The comparison of NiH BDE reveals that, while the existing theoretical predictions cluster into distinct high and low BDE groups, the broad scatter in available experimental data prevents a definitive assessment of the most accurate theoretical approach. This work demonstrates that NN-VMC with ccECPs Hamiltonian provides a competitive framework for quantitative prediction of main-group and early TM-H energetics, while identifying late TM-H as an important benchmark for future developments in neural-network wavefunctions and electronic structure theory.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了基于Psiformer的神经网络变分蒙特卡洛(NN-VMC)方法预测过渡金属氢化物键解离能(BDE)的能力，与CCSDT(Q)/CBS及实验数据对比，证明其对主族和早期过渡金属体系具有竞争力，而晚期过渡金属仍是挑战。
AI.motivation: 过渡金属氢化物(TM-H)键解离能预测困难，源于强电子相关、相对论效应和核量子贡献。评估NN-VMC这一新兴方法能否胜任此类高难度体系的定量预测。
AI.method: 采用基于Psiformer拟设的NN-VMC，结合统一的ccECP哈密顿量，对复杂度递增的体系(LiH、OH、TiH、NiH)进行计算，并与CCSDT(Q)/CBS及已有理论、实验数据对比；引入零方差和无限步外推方案减少有限训练误差。
AI.result: LiH和OH的总能量与CBS外推结果相差亚毫哈特里，BDE差异小于2σ；Ti和TiH的变分能量与CCSD(T)/CBS一致，外推后趋近CCSDT(Q)/CBS；NiH中增加行列式数量可改善相关能恢复；NiH的BDE理论预测分为高、低两组，而实验数据散布较大，难以判定最优方法。
AI.conclusion: NN-VMC结合ccECP哈密顿量为主族和早期TM-H能量学提供了有竞争力的定量预测框架，并将晚期TM-H确定为神经网络波函数和电子结构理论未来发展的重要基准。

title: Giant second-harmonic generation in few-atomic layer metals
summary: Quantum confinement restructures the electronic phase space of ultrathin metals, but the resulting density-of-states (DOS) change is not generically large. We show that, within a three-dimensional confinement theory based on the suppression of long-wavelength electronic states, the Fermi-level DOS enhancement on the weak-confinement branch is bounded by $(4/3)^{1/3}-1\simeq10.1\%$. Instead, confinement-induced redistribution of electronic phase space can be strongly amplified by resonant denominators in the second-order susceptibility. A minimal double-resonance closure predicts giant amplification when the film thickness approaches $L_c=(2π/n)^{1/3}$, where $n$ is the carrier density, and a dominant optical pathway lies within a dephasing linewidth of resonance. Applied to recent Ag(111) measurements, the theory gives an effective phase-space carrier density parameter $n_{\rm eff}\simeq3.6\times10^{20}\,\mathrm{cm}^{-3}$, a tenfold enhancement of $|χ^{(2)}|$, and hence the observed $\sim100$-fold increase of thickness-normalized second-harmonic-generation efficiency, together with the observed non-oscillatory thickness dependence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出三维量子限域理论，指出Fermi能级态密度增强受限不超过约10.1%，但通过二阶磁化率中的共振分母，限域引起的电子相空间重分布可导致巨大光学非线性放大，解释了Ag(111)薄膜中二次谐波效率近百倍增强。
AI.motivation: 超薄金属中量子限域会重构电子相空间，但其引起的态密度变化通常不大，难以解释实验中观测到的巨大光学非线性增强，因此需要揭示限域放大光学响应的机制。
AI.method: 建立基于长波长电子态抑制的三维限域理论，计算弱限域分支上Fermi能级态密度增强的上限，并引入二阶磁化率的双共振闭合模型，分析薄膜厚度接近临界厚度L_c=(2π/n)^{1/3}时的共振放大效应。
AI.result: 弱限域分支的Fermi能级态密度增强被限制在(4/3)^{1/3}-1≈10.1%以内；双共振模型预测当膜厚接近L_c且主光学通道位于退相干线宽内时出现巨大放大。应用于Ag(111)实验，得到有效相空间载流子密度参数n_eff≈3.6×10^20 cm^-3，|χ^(2)|提升十倍，对应厚度归一化二次谐波效率约100倍增强及观测到的非振荡厚度依赖。
AI.conclusion: 限域本身对态密度影响有限，但通过二阶磁化率的共振机制可显著放大光学非线性，该理论成功定量解释了Ag(111)薄膜中二次谐波效率的巨大增强与非振荡厚度依赖。

title: Altermagnetism across the BCS-BEC crossover
summary: We study a two-dimensional paired Fermi system in which altermagnetism produces a spin splitting that depends on momentum. The interaction strength is described through the two-body binding energy, so that the chemical potential and pairing gap evolve self-consistently from the weak-coupling Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer (BCS) regime to the strong-coupling Bose-Einstein-condensate (BEC) regime at fixed density. The stability of the uniform paired state is examined by giving the pairs a small center-of-mass momentum and following the resulting change in free energy. We show that at zero temperature, the phase stiffness follows a universal quadratic suppression, $J/J_0 = 1 - (α/α_0)^2$, across the entire fully gapped crossover regime. Deviations from this relation emerge only on the BCS side upon the opening of gapless Bogoliubov pockets, which rapidly reduce the stiffness and can trigger an instability toward finite-momentum pairing. In the BEC regime, this universal quadratic correction corresponds to the altered effective mass of the tightly bound composite bosons. The model therefore provides a simple setting in which to compare altermagnetic pair breaking on the BCS and BEC sides of the crossover.

AI.tldr: 研究二维交变磁性配对费米子在BCS-BEC crossover中的相刚度，发现零温完全能隙区内相刚度遵循普适二次抑制律 J/J0 = 1-(α/α0)²，偏离仅出现在BCS侧。
AI.motivation: 交变磁性产生动量依赖的自旋劈裂，其对超导配对的影响在BCS和BEC两侧可能不同，需要一个简单模型来系统比较交变磁性对配对破坏的作用机制。
AI.method: 构建二维配对费米子系统，用两体束缚能描述相互作用强度，使化学势和配对能隙自洽演化，覆盖从弱耦合BCS到强耦合BEC的crossover；通过给配对赋予小质心动量并追踪自由能变化来检验均匀配对态的稳定性。
AI.result: 零温下相刚度在整个完全能隙crossover区间遵循普适二次抑制 J/J0 = 1-(α/α0)²；偏离仅出现在BCS侧，伴随无隙Bogoliubov口袋打开，迅速降低刚度并可触发向有限动量配对的失稳。BEC区间的该普适修正对应紧束缚复合玻色子有效质量的改变。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为比较交变磁性对BCS与BEC两侧的配对破坏提供了一个简单框架，揭示了相刚度修正的普适性与BCS侧失稳机制。

title: A New Framework for Interfacial Statistics: Exact n-Point Correlations of Gaussian Level Sets
comment: Published in Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 196101 (2026), 7 pages, 4 figures
summary: We derive exact analytical expressions for higher-order correlations of Gaussian level-set interfaces, establishing a direct link between bulk field statistics and interface geometry. This framework enables efficient reconstruction of disordered media, detailed modeling of {Gaussian foams}---structured, double-thresholded interfaces with tunable morphology---and analysis of {memory-enhanced anisotropy} reflecting directional persistence in surface structure. These results open new possibilities for characterizing complex transport, guiding stochastic reconstructions, designing materials with desired properties, quantifying the information content of correlation functions and modelling directional processes on irregular boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了高斯水平集界面高阶关联的精确解析表达式，建立体场统计与界面几何的直接联系，并应用于无序介质重构、高斯泡沫建模及记忆增强各向异性分析。
AI.motivation: 需要刻画复杂无序介质的界面几何与关联结构，并将体场统计与界面几何联系起来以支撑重构、材料设计和方向性过程建模。
AI.method: 推导高斯水平集界面高阶关联的精确解析表达式，构建将体场统计与界面几何直接关联的框架，并定义双阈值的高斯泡沫结构与记忆增强各向异性。
AI.result: 实现了无序介质的高效重构、具有可调形貌的规则双阈值界面建模，以及对表面结构方向持久性的分析。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为复杂输运表征、随机重构、材料设计、关联函数信息量量化及不规则边界方向性过程建模开辟了新可能。

title: Haldane-Holstein model at fractional filling: Route to bosonic fractional Chern insulator and quantum anomalous Hall crystal
summary: Electron-phonon coupling is generally expected to suppress band topology, driving a topological band insulator into a trivial phase. Here we show that, using the prototypical Haldane-Holstein model at partial filling of a topological band, strong electron-phonon coupling can instead stabilize topological phases of matter. The electron-phonon coupling plays a double role: it generates the longer-range interactions that correlate the carriers and, in the attractive channel, also binds them into bosonic pairs. For spinful electrons, it pairs opposite spins into charge-$2e$ bipolarons that form a bosonic fractional Chern insulator (FCI) at filling $ν=1/2$ with charge-$e$ semionic excitations. Tuning the band topology and the coupling strength maps out a rich phase diagram containing this bosonic FCI, superconductors condensed at the $M$ and $K$ points, and several charge-ordered solids. For spin-polarized electrons, strong coupling instead stabilizes a $C=2$ quantum anomalous Hall crystal (QAHC) at $ν=1/3$. Electron-phonon coupling thus emerges as a route to, rather than an obstruction against, topology in partially filled Chern bands.

AI.tldr: 本文用Haldane-Holstein模型证明强电声耦合在部分填充拓扑带时可稳定拓扑相（而非抑制），包括玻色分数量子陈绝缘体和C=2量子反常霍尔晶体。
AI.motivation: 电子-声子耦合通常被认为会抑制能带拓扑，使拓扑能带绝缘体变为平庸相；作者希望探究在部分填充拓扑带时，强耦合是否能反而稳定拓扑物态。
AI.method: 采用原型Haldane-Holstein模型，在拓扑带部分填充下研究电子-声子耦合的双重作用：既产生关联载流子的长程相互作用，又在吸引通道中将电子束缚为玻色双极化子。分别分析自旋电子（配对成电荷2e双极化子）和自旋极化电子（C=2 QAHC）情形，并绘制相图。
AI.result: 自旋电子在ν=1/2形成玻色分数量子陈绝缘体，带电荷e的半子激发；相图包含该玻色FCI、在M和K点凝聚的超导体及多种电荷有序固体。自旋极化电子在ν=1/3稳定C=2量子反常霍尔晶体。
AI.conclusion: 电声耦合可作为在部分填充陈带中实现拓扑的一条途径，而非拓扑的阻碍。

title: Slow Thermalization and Long-Lived Coherence across Acoustic Phonon Branches in BAs
summary: The exceptionally high thermal conductivity of cubic boron arsenide (BAs) arises from suppressed three-phonon scattering associated with its large acoustic--optical gap. In this regime, four-phonon processes become non-negligible, creating an unusual scattering hierarchy with unexplored consequences for nonequilibrium phonon dynamics. Here, time-resolved x-ray diffuse scattering reveals exceptionally slow, branch-dependent acoustic phonon thermalization and long-lived coherence. Exploiting branch sensitivity in one-phonon diffuse scattering, we resolve transverse acoustic (TA) and longitudinal acoustic (LA) thermalization times of 29.2 and 13.9~ps, respectively; even the LA timescale is at least three times that in common semiconductors. Phonon dispersion calculations assign coherent oscillations at 0.19 and 0.27~THz to the TA and LA modes, respectively; both persist with little decay over 50~ps, with comparable coherence found only in diamond. These findings provide a direct dynamical manifestation of the weak phonon scattering underlying the exceptional thermal transport of BAs.

AI.tldr: 利用时间分辨X射线漫散射揭示立方砷化硼中异常缓慢且依赖声学支的声子热化与长寿命相干，证实弱声子散射是其高导热根源。
AI.motivation: 立方砷化硼(BAs)因声学-光学声子能隙大而抑制三声子散射，导致超高热导率；此环境下四声子过程不可忽略，形成特殊散射层级，其对非平衡声子动力学的影响尚不明。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨X射线漫散射，利用单声子漫散射的支敏感性分辨横向声学(TA)与纵向声学(LA)模式的热化时间，并结合声子色散计算指认相干振荡模式。
AI.result: TA与LA热化时间分别为29.2 ps和13.9 ps（LA仍比常见半导体慢至少3倍）；0.19 THz和0.27 THz的相干振荡分别对应TA与LA模式，二者在50 ps内几乎无衰减，相干性仅与金刚石相当。
AI.conclusion: 研究直接给出BAs弱声子散射的动力学证据，解释了其异常热输运的微观机制。

title: Agentic Porting, Construction and Initial Verification and Validation of Libraries within the Open Source Unified TRAnsient Multi-Physics Advanced Reactor simulation Kit (Outram Park) Part II: Nuclear Data and Neutronics
summary: An agentic Rust port of both Njoy and OpenMC was achieved to produce a convenient ENDF to Monte Carlo simulation pipeline in Outram Park. The code is still a prototype with much more extensive verification and validation studies required in future studies. Doppler-broadened cross sections of U-238 are demonstrated in this paper and compared to OpenMC pregenerated HDF5 files. Additionally, initial testing of the Monte Carlo ports from OpenMC were also performed with ICSBEP benchmarks and a FHR Pebble with TRISO Fuel used in the author's PhD dissertation. The addition of nuclear data and Monte Carlo case studies shifts the focus of Outram Park from a Multi-Phase simulation kit to a Multi-Physics simulation kit.

AI.tldr: Outram Park实现Njoy与OpenMC的Rust智能体重写，构建ENDF到蒙特卡洛模拟的便捷流程，属于原型阶段。
AI.motivation: 将Outram Park从多相模拟工具包扩展为多物理模拟工具包。
AI.method: 用Rust智能体移植Njoy和OpenMC，建立ENDF到蒙特卡洛模拟流程；对U-238进行多普勒展宽截面计算并与OpenMC预生成HDF5文件对比，用ICSBEP基准和含TRISO燃料的FHR球床进行初步蒙特卡洛测试。
AI.result: 展示了U-238多普勒展宽截面与OpenMC结果对比，蒙特卡洛移植通过ICSBEP基准和FHR TRISO球床初步测试。
AI.conclusion: 该原型仍需大量验证与确认研究，未来工作重点为扩展验证。

title: Local Response Theory of Electrified Interfaces from Screened Effective Charges
summary: First-principles, electronic-structure simulations provide direct access to ground-state, global system properties. In the context of computational electrochemistry these are, e.g., bias-dependent energies, free energies, work functions, and capacitances. However, a comparably systematic local description of how these quantities respond to biasing via interfacial charging is still missing. Here, we introduce the screened electrochemical Born effective charge (SEBEC), a mixed total-energy derivative that measures the force response of an atomic degree of freedom to interfacial charging under electrochemical boundary conditions. SEBECs play the role for electrochemistry that Born effective charges play in the modern theory of polarization: they provide an unambiguous decomposition of global response and generate the same formal structures for structural relaxation, capacitance, and electrochemical Stark tuning that are familiar from solid-state response theory. The broader implication is a local response framework that brings electrochemical interfaces closer to the conceptual rigor long established for insulating solids.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"屏蔽电化学玻恩有效电荷"(SEBEC),一种混合总能量导数,用于描述原子自由度在电化学边界条件下对界面充电的力响应,为电化学界面提供局部响应框架。
AI.motivation: 第一性原理模拟可直接获取基态全局性质(如偏压依赖能量、自由能、功函数、电容),但缺乏关于这些量如何通过界面充电响应偏压的系统性局部描述。
AI.method: 引入SEBEC——一种混合总能量导数,在电化学边界条件下测量原子自由度对界面充电的力响应,类似于极化现代理论中的玻恩有效电荷。
AI.result: SEBEC提供全局响应的无歧义分解,并为结构弛豫、电容和电化学斯塔克调谐生成与固态响应理论相同的规范结构。
AI.conclusion: 这一局部响应框架使电化学界面更接近绝缘固体长期确立的概念严谨性。

title: Persistent nonlinear Hall effect driven by parallel field across a topological phase transition and intraband sign-reversing integer quantum Hall effect
summary: We investigate the linear and nonlinear Hall effects in a two-dimensional Rashba spin-orbit coupled nodal ring electronic system. We consider both the cases of linear Hall effect, the Berry curvature induced anomalous Hall and the perpendicular magnetic field-induced integer quantum Hall effect. We observe that the system exhibits a topological gap along the boundary of the nodal ring that strongly depends on the radius of the nodal ring and the strength of the Rashba spin-orbit interaction, resulting in the quantum anomalous Hall effect. Subsequently, we include a perpendicular uniform magnetic field and obtain the exact Landau levels that exhibit sign reversal in the slope with magnetic field around the ring boundary. This causes a sign reversal in the quantum Hall conductivity in the same band by tuning the magnetic field. Most importantly, we also show that when the magnetic field is strictly parallel to the system, it can induce an anisotropy to the Berry curvature that leads to the emergence of the nonlinear Hall effect. Additionally, tuning the parallel field can close and reopen the topological gap, resulting in the reverse topological phase transition from the topological Chern insulator to a trivial insulator. The nonlinear Hall effect remains persistent in both phases, but its dependence on the chemical potential exhibits distinct signatures. Noticeably, the nonlinear Hall response exhibits a sign-changing peak structure in Chern insulating phase whereas it displays a single-sign response in trivial insulating phase. These distinct signatures suggest that nonlinear Hall can serve as a probe to study such a topological phase transition.

AI.tldr: 研究二维Rashba自旋轨道耦合nodal ring体系的线性与非线性霍尔效应，揭示平行磁场可诱导Berry曲率各向异性并驱动拓扑相变，非线性霍尔响应可作为相变探针。
AI.motivation: 探究Rashba自旋轨道耦合nodal ring体系中线性（异常/量子）霍尔效应及非线性霍尔效应，尤其是磁场调控拓扑相与非线性响应之间的联系。
AI.method: 理论计算Nodal ring边界拓扑隙（依赖ring半径与Rashba强度）；加垂直磁场求精确Landau能级；加平行磁场分析Berry曲率各向异性与非线性霍尔效应，并追踪能隙闭合-重开导致的拓扑相变。
AI.result: 垂直磁场下Landau能级斜率在ring边界反转，导致同带内量子霍尔电导变号；平行磁场诱导Berry曲率各向异性产生非线性霍尔效应，并驱动Chern绝缘体到平庸绝缘体的反转相变；非线性霍尔在Chern相呈变号双峰，在平庸相呈单符号。
AI.conclusion: 非线性霍尔效应的独特化学势依赖特征可区分Chern绝缘相与平庸绝缘相，可作为拓扑相变的探测手段。

title: Growth of superconducting boron doped diamond on 4inch silicon wafers
summary: Superconducting boron-doped diamond (BDD) films were grown on 4-inch silicon wafers by microwave plasma chemical vapour deposition using gas-phase B/C ratios ranging from 6536 to 36421 ppm. Surface morphology, boron incorporation and superconducting properties were investigated as a function of gas-phase boron concentration. No systematic variation in apparent lateral grain size was observed across the series. Superconductivity was observed in all films except that grown at a B/C ratio of 6536 ppm within the measured temperature range down to 2 K. The superconducting transition temperature initially increased with increasing B/C ratio, reaching a maximum T$_c$ of 4.03 K at 24691 ppm, before decreasing at higher gas-phase B/C ratios. The corresponding resistive upper critical field at 2 K reached 3.091 T. Raman spectroscopy showed an increase in boron incorporation with increasing gas-phase B/C ratio up to 30303 ppm, followed by a slight decrease at 36421 ppm. Spatial measurements across the film grown at 24691 ppm showed T$_c$ values of 4.02, 4.19 and 3.33 K at the centre, intermediate and edge positions, respectively, with Raman spectroscopy showing a corresponding spatial variation in boron concentration. Comparison with previous growth on 2-inch wafers showed that substantially higher gas-phase B/C ratios were required to obtain comparable boron concentrations and superconducting properties on 4-inch wafers, indicating reduced boron incorporation efficiency during large-area growth. These results demonstrate the feasibility of producing superconducting BDD over a substantial area of a 4-inch silicon wafer while identifying boron incorporation and radial uniformity as key parameters for further wafer-scale optimisation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过MPCVD在4英寸硅片上生长超导硼掺杂金刚石(BDD)薄膜，研究气相B/C比对硼掺入和超导性能的影响，发现Tc随B/C比先升后降，最高4.03 K，并揭示大面积生长的硼掺入效率降低及径向不均匀性问题。
AI.motivation: 超导BDD在电子器件等领域有应用前景，但需在晶圆尺度实现，故需研究大面积生长时B/C比对硼掺入与超导性质的影响，并与2英寸结果对比以评估可扩展性。
AI.method: 采用微波等离子体化学气相沉积(MPCVD)在4英寸硅片上以6536–36421 ppm的气相B/C比生长BDD薄膜；通过表面形貌、Raman光谱、电阻-温度及上临界场测量，系统研究硼浓度对形貌、硼掺入和超导性能的影响，并进行空间(中心/中间/边缘)对比。
AI.result: 除6536 ppm样品外所有薄膜均超导；Tc随B/C比先升高，在24691 ppm处达最高4.03 K，随后下降；2 K下上临界场达3.091 T。Raman显示硼掺入随B/C比增至30303 ppm后略降。24691 ppm薄膜空间上Tc为4.02、4.19、3.33 K(中心/中间/边缘)。与2英寸相比，4英寸需更高B/C比才能获得相近硼浓度与超导性能，表明大面积生长硼掺入效率降低。
AI.conclusion: 证明可在4英寸硅片大面积制备超导BDD，同时指出硼掺入效率和径向均匀性是晶圆级优化的关键参数。

title: Thermodynamic Realizability of Hidden Markov Processes: Attainment, Observable Certificates, and the Price of Architecture
comment: 22 pages; ancillary Python verification code and JSON output included
summary: What is the least dissipative finite Markov machine that can reproduce a given stochastic process exactly? A basic compactness worry is that a minimizing sequence might lower its cost only by sending microscopic rates to infinity, never converging to an actual finite-rate machine. We prove that this escape is impossible at fixed hidden dimension. States of vanishing stationary occupation can be traced out, and infinitely fast conductance classes can be contracted, without increasing entropy production or losing the limiting observed path law. Hence the exact-law cost $V_n(P)$ is attained and lower semicontinuous at every fixed state count, with no cap on rates or mean activity. Adding a positive price $κ$ per used hidden state yields an attained optimum over all finite dimensions and an exact representation by globally calibrated lower certificates built from finitely many observable path expectations. The lower envelope $G_κ(P)=\min_n[V_n(P)+κn]$ defines an architecture phase diagram whose slope is the selected state count; divergence of that count as $κ\downarrow0$ is equivalent to failure of any finite machine to attain the all-dimension infimum $V_\infty(P)$. For the two-block renewal family $P_q$, we derive complete finite-dimensional phase-type cancellation equations, give an explicit four-phase counterexample to a tempting restricted parameterization, and prove strictly positive minimal dissipation at every feasible finite dimension for all $0<q<1$. These results reduce the remaining problem to one sharp question: can growing hidden architecture drive the dissipation of $P_q$ to its all-dimension infimum without any finite optimizer, and in the strongest scenario, to zero?

AI.tldr: 论文研究精确复现给定随机过程所需的最小耗散有限马尔可夫机器，证明在固定隐藏维度下精确律代价 $V_n(P)$ 可达且下半连续，并引入每状态价格 $\kappa$ 得到全局优化与相图。
AI.motivation: 核心担忧是：最小化序列可能通过让微观速率趋于无穷来降低成本，从而不收敛到真正的有限速率机器。作者希望证明这种"逃逸"在固定隐藏维度下不会发生，并刻画有限维最优与全维下确界之间的关系。
AI.method: 通过追踪可忽略稳态占据的状态、收缩无穷快电导类，证明不增加熵产生且不丢失极限观测路径律；引入每使用隐藏状态的价格 $\kappa$，用有限个可观测路径期望构造全局校准的下界证书，并定义下包络 $G_\kappa(P)=\min_n[V_n(P)+\kappa n]$。
AI.result: 证明 $V_n(P)$ 在固定状态数下可达且下半连续，无速率或平均活性的上界限制；$G_\kappa(P)$ 的斜率对应当选状态数，$\kappa\downarrow0$ 时状态数发散等价于不存在有限机器达到全维下确界 $V_\infty(P)$。对双块更新族 $P_q$，给出有限维相型消除方程、一个四相反例，并证明所有 $0<q<1$ 的每个可行有限维度最小耗散严格为正。
AI.conclusion: 剩余问题被归结为一个尖锐问题：增长的隐藏架构能否将 $P_q$ 的耗散驱动到全维下确界而无需任何有限优化器，甚至在最强情形下驱动到零。

title: Emergence of Subdominant Quadrupolar Order in the 5$d^2$ Multipolar Mott Insulator Ba$_2$CaOsO$_6$
summary: Relativistic $5d$ Mott insulators host a rich variety of exotic hidden multipolar order, whose microscopic nature remains heavily debated. A broken local point-symmetry (BLPS) phase followed by antiferromagnetism was previously observed in the doped compound Ba$_2$Na$_{0.1}$Ca$_{0.9}$OsO$_6$, where mixed Os valence places the system toward the $5d^2$ end of the $5d^1$-$5d^2$ regime. In contrast, pristine $5d^2$ Ba$_2$CaOsO$_6$ has shown a single octupolar transition with average cubic symmetry, raising the question of whether BLPS arises from chemical disorder in the doped systems. Here, we discover the BLPS phase in pristine Ba$_2$CaOsO$_6$ emerging at $T^* \approx 50$ K, precisely coincident with the octupolar transition. Beyond standard ${}^{43}$Ca nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectral analysis, our spin-echo nutation measurements detect a finite electric field gradient, demonstrating spontaneous symmetry breaking despite the cubic average structure. While our NMR data support the previously identified octupolar order, the BLPS phase reveals a subdominant quadrupolar contribution, establishing that the hidden order in Ba$_2$CaOsO$_6$ is intrinsically multicomponent. Such mixed multipolar states lie beyond conventional theoretical descriptions of the $5d^2$ ground state. Our results establish local symmetry breaking as an intrinsic property of the clean $5d^2$ limit and provide a new constraint on microscopic theories of strongly spin-orbit-coupled Mott insulators.

AI.tldr: 在纯净5d² Mott绝缘体Ba₂CaOsO₆中发现破缺局域点对称(BLPS)相，与八极转变在T*≈50 K同时出现，揭示隐藏序是多分量(八极+四极)的。
AI.motivation: 5d Mott绝缘体的隐藏多极序微观本质存在争议。此前仅在掺杂Ba₂Na₀.₁Ca₀.₉OsO₆中观察到BLPS相，而纯净Ba₂CaOsO₆仅显示单一八极转变且呈立方对称，因此BLPS是否源于化学无序尚不清楚。
AI.method: 对纯净Ba₂CaOsO₆进行⁴³Ca核磁共振(NMR)研究，除常规谱分析外，采用自旋回波章动(nutation)测量检测电场梯度。
AI.result: 在T*≈50 K发现BLPS相，与八极转变重合；章动测量检测到有限电场梯度，表明平均立方结构下存在自发对称性破缺。数据支持八极序，同时揭示亚主导的四极贡献。
AI.conclusion: 局域对称性破缺是纯净5d²极限的内禀性质，隐藏序本质上是多分量(混合多极)态，超越传统5d²基态理论描述，为强自旋轨道耦合Mott绝缘体微观理论提供新约束。

title: A Symmetry-Constrained Fourier--Morse Framework for Compact Anisotropic Interaction Potentials
summary: Large-scale coarse-grained simulations of anisotropic particles require compact interaction models that retain orientation-dependent energetics. We present a symmetry-constrained Fourier--Morse framework in which the radial interaction is described by a Morse potential and its orientational dependence by Fourier expansions. The representation converges systematically with harmonic resolution, allows known orientational symmetries to be imposed directly, and supports further reduction through harmonic truncation and coefficient pruning. Its explicit Fourier structure also provides a natural basis for constructing or modifying model interactions with prescribed orientational symmetries. The parameterization requires only a sampled interaction landscape and is therefore independent of the method used to generate the reference data. We demonstrate the approach for four interaction classes of chiral $α$-polyalanine helices, representing more than \num{300000} reference energy values with tens to a few hundred coefficients while reproducing equilibrium interaction features with meV- and mÅ-level errors. As a proof of concept, molecular-dynamics simulations using the reduced analytical potentials produce stable low-temperature configurations exhibiting local ordering motifs qualitatively consistent with those identified previously by Monte Carlo simulated annealing.

AI.tldr: 提出对称性约束的Fourier–Morse框架，用少量系数量化各向异性粒子相互作用，并用分子动力学验证。
AI.motivation: 大规模粗粒化模拟各向异性粒子需紧凑且保留取向依赖能量的相互作用模型，现有方法难以在紧凑性与精确性间兼顾。
AI.method: 径向用Morse势描述，取向依赖用Fourier展开；可施加已知对称性、谐波截断与系数剪枝；仅需采样得到的相互作用能面进行参数化，不依赖参考数据生成方式。
AI.result: 对四类手性α-聚丙氨酸螺旋（超30万参考能量值），仅用数十至数百个系数即可拟合，平衡相互作用特征误差达meV与mÅ量级。
AI.conclusion: 作为概念验证，使用简化解析势的分子动力学模拟可产生稳定的低温构型，其局部有序基元与先前Monte Carlo模拟退火结果定性一致。

title: Benchmarking Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials for Dynamical Stability in Inorganic Semiconductor Nanocrystals: A CdSe Case Study
summary: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable nanosecond-scale atomistic simulations of inorganic semiconductor nanocrystals, but low errors on held-out configurations do not necessarily guarantee stable molecular dynamics. We benchmark five graph-neural-network MLIPs, SchNet, PaiNN, NequIP, Allegro and MACE, for dynamical stability in a chloride-passivated cadmium selenide nanocluster containing 149 atoms. The models were trained under harmonized conditions on 1,000 configurations and evaluated against 2,000 held-out configurations generated using density functional theory, considering force accuracy, computational efficiency, uncertainty and structural stability during 1 ns simulations at 300 K. Allegro produced the lowest validation force mean absolute errors, ranging from 12 to 14 meV per angstrom, whereas SchNet produced the largest, ranging from 84 to 110 meV per angstrom. This ranking did not predict dynamical robustness: NequIP remained stable for 1 ns without additional training data, whereas MACE became stable only after an ensemble-based active-learning procedure added 34 uncertainty-selected configurations. PaiNN and Allegro remained unstable after the addition of 100 and 95 configurations, respectively, and SchNet also failed to achieve stable dynamics within the tested augmentation budget. Under the benchmark hardware conditions, the machine-learning potentials required 6-66 ms per molecular-dynamics step, compared with approximately 20 s for density functional theory. These results show that held-out prediction errors alone are insufficient for selecting interatomic potentials for finite, surface-dominated nanostructures. Reliable deployment requires long-timescale dynamical testing combined with uncertainty-guided refinement, while the effectiveness and data efficiency of active learning remain strongly architecture dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文基准测试了五种图神经网络机器学习原子间势（SchNet、PaiNN、NequIP、Allegro、MACE）在149原子CdSe纳米团簇中的动力学稳定性，发现验证误差不能预测动力学鲁棒性，需长时间动力学测试与不确定性引导的主动学习。
AI.motivation: MLIPs可实现纳米尺度模拟，但"留出集低误差"未必保证稳定的分子动力学，尤其对表面主导的有限纳米结构，选势标准不明确。
AI.method: 在统一条件下用1000个DFT构型训练五种图神经网络势，在2000个留出构型上评估力精度、计算效率、不确定性与300 K下1 ns模拟的结构稳定性，并测试集成式主动学习补充数据的效果。
AI.result: Allegro验证力MAE最低（12–14 meV/Å），SchNet最高（84–110 meV/Å）；但该排名不预测动力学稳健性：NequIP无需额外数据即稳定1 ns，MACE在加入34个不确定性筛选构型后稳定，PaiNN与Allegro分别加100和95个仍不稳定，SchNet在预算内也未稳定。ML势每步6–66 ms，DFT约20 s。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭留出预测误差不足以选择适合有限表面主导纳米结构的原子间势；可靠部署需长时间尺度动力学测试结合不确定性引导精修，且主动学习的有效性与数据效率高度依赖架构。

title: 1D Interface-Induced Real-Space Berry Curvature Gradient Encoded in SpinValley-Coupled Nonlinear Photocurrent in Lateral Heterostructure
summary: Symmetry breaking enables helicity-dependent optoelectronic responses in quantum materials. In two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), circular photocurrent (CPC) is typically observed under oblique illumination via the circular photon drag effect, while realization of the intrinsic circular photogalvanic effect (CPGE) under normal incidence remains challenging. Here, we report a clear signature of CPGE in chemical vapor deposition-grown monolayer 2D lateral heterostructure (LHS). By probing the nonlocal photocurrent across the 1D hetero-interface, we observe a helicity-dependent photocurrent consistent with a spin-valley-coupled CPGE-dominated mechanism driven by interface-induced Berry-curvature asymmetry, i.e., Berry curvature dipole. Spatially and spectrally resolved measurements under selective excitation of the MoSe2, WSe2, and the interface regions exhibit distinct magnitudes and polarities of the CPG responses. These contrasting behaviors highlight the opposite spin-valley dichroism for MoSe2 and WSe2, as well as enhanced valley mixing at the 1D interface. Our findings establish LHS as a robust platform for realizing a hetero-interface-induced CPGE-like response and highlight its potential for valleytronics and optospintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文在CVD生长的单层二维横向异质结（LHS）中，通过探测跨1D异质界面的非局域光电流，首次观测到正常入射下由界面诱导贝里曲率不对称（贝里曲率偶极）驱动的、自旋-谷耦合的本征圆光电流（CPGE）特征。
AI.motivation: 在二维过渡金属硫族化合物中，圆光电流通常需斜入射通过圆光子拖曳效应产生，而正常入射下的本征圆光电流（CPGE）难以实现。对称性破缺是实现螺旋度依赖光电响应的关键，作者希望利用横向异质结的界面来打破对称性并实现CPGE。
AI.method: 采用化学气相沉积（CVD）生长单层MoSe2/WSe2二维横向异质结（LHS）；通过探测跨1D异质界面的非局域光电流，并进行空间与光谱分辨测量，选择性激发MoSe2、WSe2及界面区域以对比CPG响应。
AI.result: 在正常入射下观测到清晰的CPGE特征，其机制符合由界面诱导贝里曲率不对称（贝里曲率偶极）驱动的自旋-谷耦合CPGE主导机制；不同区域（MoSe2、WSe2、界面）的CPG响应在幅度和极性上呈现显著差异，揭示了MoSe2与WSe2相反的spin-valley二色性及界面处增强的谷混合。
AI.conclusion: 横向异质结可作为实现界面诱导CPGE类响应的稳健平台，在谷电子学和光自旋电子学方面具有应用潜力。

title: Multigap superconductivity in Ising superconductors: The case of (LaSe)1.14(NbSe2)m misfit layer compounds
summary: Strong spin-orbit coupling and broken inversion symmetry in transition metal dichalcogenides give rise to Ising superconductivity, a spin-protected pairing state first identified in monolayer NbSe$_2$ through in-plane critical fields far exceeding the Pauli limit. More recently, Ising superconductivity has been proposed as a potential route to unconventional and even topological superconductivity in bulk misfit compounds. Here, we investigate the superconducting order parameter of layered misfit compounds composed of alternating transition metal dichalcogenide and rocksalt layers, which host extremely doped, electronically decoupled NbSe$_2$ sheets within a three-dimensional crystal. Using directional scanning tunneling spectroscopy on the misfit superconductors (LaSe)$_{1.14}$(NbSe$_2$) and (LaSe)$_{1.14}$(NbSe$_2$)$_2$, we uncover a strongly anisotropic multigap superconducting state: a fragile gap on the $Γ$-centered Fermi-surface pocket coexists with a robust, intrinsic gap on the K and K$'$ pockets. These features are in quantitative agreement with momentum-resolved gaps $Δ(\mathbf{k})$ obtained from anisotropic Migdal-Eliashberg calculations. The marked fragility of the $Γ$-centered gap, combined with the strong sensitivity of the critical temperature to non-magnetic disorder, points to pairing beyond conventional $s$-wave symmetry, potentially involving a topological order parameter. These results establish NbSe$_2$-based misfit compounds as a tunable bulk platform for multigap, unconventional superconductivity, with Ising protection offering a promising route toward topological pairing.

AI.tldr: 通过方向性扫描隧道谱研究(LaSe)1.14(NbSe2)和(LaSe)1.14(NbSe2)2错配化合物，发现各向异性多带隙超导态，Γ口袋上脆弱带隙与K/K'口袋上稳健内禀带隙共存，与非各向同性Migdal-Eliashberg计算定量吻合，脆弱的Γ带隙及Tc对非磁无序的敏感性暗示可能超越s波配对的拓扑超导。
AI.motivation: 过渡金属硫族化物中强自旋轨道耦合与反演对称破缺导致Ising超导，近期被提议可作为实现非常规乃至拓扑超导的途径。然而体相错配化合物（交替TMD/岩盐层，含极重掺杂、电子解耦的NbSe2层）中的超导序参量尚缺乏实验研究。
AI.method: 采用方向性扫描隧道谱（directional scanning tunneling spectroscopy）对错配超导体(LaSe)1.14(NbSe2)和(LaSe)1.14(NbSe2)2进行测量，并将结果与各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg计算得到的动量分辨带隙Δ(k)进行定量对比。
AI.result: 揭示了强各向异性多带隙超导态：Γ中心费米面口袋上存在脆弱带隙，与K和K'口袋上的稳健内禀带隙共存。这些特征与各向异性Migdal-Eliashberg计算的Δ(k)定量一致。Γ带隙的明显脆弱性以及临界温度对非磁无序的强敏感性，表明配对可能超越传统s波对称性，或涉及拓扑序参量。
AI.conclusion: 确立了基于NbSe2的错配化合物作为可调控的体相平台，用于研究多带隙、非常规超导；Ising保护为实现拓扑配对提供了有前景的途径。

title: Thermodynamic Geometry of an Ideal Quon Gas
summary: We investigate the equilibrium thermodynamics and thermodynamic Riemannian geometry of an ideal quon gas within the grand canonical ensemble. By incorporating the algebraic deformation parameter $q$, the system generalizes standard bosonic behavior while recovering the conventional ideal Bose gas in the undeformed limit. A rigorous examination of the ground-state occupation reveals two disconnected mathematical domains of the fugacity. By enforcing thermodynamic continuity, single-valuedness, and consistency with the high-temperature classical limit, we exclude the second mathematical branch and establish the lower interval as the unique physically admissible state space. This identifies the deformation parameter as an intrinsic, generalized Bose--Einstein condensation threshold. Employing the Fisher-Rao metric on the equilibrium parameter manifold, we probe the thermodynamic scalar curvature across all temperature regimes. The scalar curvature remains strictly positive throughout the physical domain, confirming that the deformation preserves an effectively attractive statistical interaction without inducing fermionic tendencies. Near the critical condensation threshold, the curvature increases sharply and exhibits a definitive divergence, providing an unambiguous geometric signature of macroscopic coherence and critical fluctuations. Below the transition temperature, the pinning of fugacity eliminates a fluctuating degree of freedom, collapsing the scalar curvature to zero.

AI.tldr: 研究理想 quon 气体在巨正则系综下的平衡热力学与热力学黎曼几何，通过代数形变参数 q 推广玻色气体，并确定物理允许的态空间与曲率特征。
AI.motivation: 标准理想玻色气体可由形变参数 q 推广，但此前缺乏对 quon 气体物理允许态空间的严格界定及几何刻画，需要明确 q 如何影响凝聚阈值及统计相互作用性质。
AI.method: 在巨正则系综中引入代数形变参数 q，分析基态占据数得到两个不连通的逸度区间；结合热力学连续性、单值性及高温经典极限排除第二支。采用 Fisher-Rao 度量研究参数流形的标量曲率。
AI.result: 标量曲率在物理域内严格为正，表明形变保留有效吸引统计相互作用而不产生费米子倾向；在临界凝聚阈值附近曲率急剧增大并发散；低于转变温度时逸度被钉住，曲率塌缩为零。
AI.conclusion: 形变参数 q 可作为广义玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚阈值，曲率发散提供了宏观相干与临界涨落的明确几何签名。

title: Vestigial altermagnetism
comment: Main text: 5 pages, 3 figures. Supplemental Materials, 11 pages, 3 figures
summary: Interaction effects and fluctuations govern the phase diagram of systems with multiple competing phases. In particular, as individual phases are destroyed by increasing temperature, fluctuations can still produce a composite `vestigial' order given by a product of individual order parameters. Here, we describe vestigial Altermagnetism (AM) from the thermal melting of antiferromagnetic (AFM) and orbital orders (OO) on the square lattice. The coexistence of AFM and OO can give rise to conventional AM with ordering wave vector $\mathbf{Q}=(π,π)$. We show that a distinct `vestigial AM' phase with $\mathbf{Q}=0$ can arise from thermal melting of AFM and OO, and investigate its generic phase diagram. We find that the transition from the high-temperature disordered phase into the vestigial AM phase can be either first or second order, depending on the AFM and OO bare susceptibilities and their interactions. We then investigate the unique experimental signatures by calculating the electron spectral function for a minimal two-orbital model. Despite the fact that the vestigial AM order parameter does not couple to electrons directly, fluctuations dominate the self-energy corrections giving rise to a spin- and orbital-dependent quasi-particle lifetime with the AM symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在方格晶格上，反铁磁（AFM）与轨道序（OO）通过热涨落熔化时可产生具有 \(\mathbf{Q}=0\) 的"残余交替磁性（vestigial AM）"相，并给出其相图、相变性质及实验特征。
AI.motivation: 多竞争序系统中，当个体序被温度破坏时，涨落仍可产生由多个序参量乘积构成的"残余（vestigial）"序。作者希望将这一概念推广到交替磁性（altermagnetism），探讨 AFM 与 OO 熔化是否能产生非传统形式的残余 AM 相。
AI.method: 在方格晶格上分析 AFM 与 OO 共存/熔化，研究残余 AM 的相图，考察相变级数依赖于裸磁化率与相互作用；并构建最小双轨道模型计算电子谱函数，分析自能与准粒子寿命。
AI.result: AFM 与 OO 共存可产生 \(\mathbf{Q}=(π,π)\) 的常规 AM；热熔化则产生 \(\mathbf{Q}=0\) 的残余 AM 相。从高温无序相到残余 AM 相的相变可以是一级或二级，取决于 AFM/OO 裸磁化率及其相互作用。虽然残余 AM 序参量不直接耦合电子，但涨落主导自能修正，产生具有 AM 对称性的自旋与轨道依赖的准粒子寿命。
AI.conclusion: 残余交替磁性可作为一种由 AFM 与 OO 热涨落诱导的新奇物相存在，其相变性质受相互作用调控，并可通过自旋/轨道分辨的准粒子寿命等谱学特征加以探测。

title: Reducing the Gate-Induced Drain-Leakage Current of Carbon-Nanotube Transistors by Subliming Dispersants with Back-End-of-Line Compatible Temperature
comment: 22 pages, 6 images in the main text, 12 pages, 10 figures in the Supplymentary Material
summary: Carbon nanotube field-effect transistors (CNTFETs) are promising for monolithic 3D integration with silicon CMOS circuits in back-end-of-line (BEOL) processes. Further reduction in off-state leakage is essential for practical applications. In this study, we develop a low-temperature cleaning process for CNT-deposited wafers using a sublimable CNT dispersant. The process is carried out below 250 °C, making it BEOL-compatible, and does not deteriorate CNT morphology or lattice structure, as confirmed by atomic force microscopy and Raman spectroscopy. As a result, gate-induced drain leakage current originating from residual dispersants is reduced by approximately one order of magnitude. In addition, improvements in on-current, subthreshold slope, and threshold voltage variability are observed after the cleaning process. This study demonstrates a material-enabled approach to improve the transfer characteristics of CNTFETs and provides a practical route toward low-power CNT electronics.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种使用可升华CNT分散剂的低温清洗工艺（<250°C），可兼容BEOL工艺且不损伤CNT结构，将残留分散剂引起的栅致漏极漏电流降低约一个数量级，并改善了开态电流、亚阈值斜率和阈值电压均匀性。
AI.motivation: CNTFET在与硅CMOS进行BEOL单片3D集成方面具有前景，但实际应用需要进一步降低关态漏电流，而残留分散剂是漏电流的重要来源。
AI.method: 采用可升华的CNT分散剂，对沉积CNT的晶圆进行低于250°C的低温清洗工艺；通过AFM和拉曼光谱验证工艺对CNT形貌和晶格结构无损伤。
AI.result: 源自残留分散剂的栅致漏极漏电流降低约一个数量级；清洗后开态电流、亚阈值斜率和阈值电压变异性均得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了一种通过材料工程改善CNTFET转移特性的方法，为低功耗CNT电子器件提供了实用路径。

title: Quasilocal transport in the integer quantised Hall effect: adiabatic separation, local Ohm's law, and Joule heating of the incompressible strips
summary: We reassess the semiclassical route to integer quantum Hall transport around one idea: the separation of fast, quantised cyclotron motion from a slow, self-consistently screened guiding-centre landscape. Bohr--Sommerfeld quantisation of the canonical action fixes the Landau spectrum; smooth confinement turns it into Born--Oppenheimer surfaces with adiabatic parameter $\ell|\nabla V|/\hbarω_c$; screening supplies the self-consistent field. Transport is quasilocal, $R_H=\intρ_Hj_y\,dx/\int j_y\,dx$ with $j_y\propto1/ρ_l$, so within the regularised local Ohm model the incompressible strips attract the current by weight and the computed Joule-power profile follows the current profile. In linear response the intrinsic electrostatic AC correction of the frozen-profile model is reactive, $\mathrm{Im}\,R_H\proptoω$, with $\mathrm{Re}\,R_H-R_H^{\rm DC}\proptoω^{2}$ below $10^{-9}$ up to $2$~MHz. With the current fed back into the electrostatics at $1$--$5\,μ$A, where the Hall drop is one to five cyclotron gaps, the driven boundary condition breaks the reflection symmetry of the bar, the Hall drop concentrates in one strip (interchanged to $10^{-9}$ under current reversal), and the plateau narrows from its low-field flank while, for the GaAs parameters studied, its high-field edge stays at $ν(0)=2$. A local transverse thermal closure inspired by Akera, evaluated as a post-process on the frozen profile with two phonon-loss laws, indicates that the narrow current-carrying strips of the low-field flank may heat by of order the lattice temperature; with the activated-heat-capacity closure the cold strip loses its stationary solution at model-dependent currents of $0.3$--$2\,μ$A. The thermal conclusions are bounded by the loss law and by the frozen profile, and are presented as estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视整数量子霍尔输运的半经典图景，基于快回旋运动与慢导向中心势的自洽分离，研究局域输运、交流修正、电流反馈对称性破缺及局域热效应。
AI.motivation: 整数量子霍尔输运的传统半经典描述需要重新评估，特别是快回旋运动与慢导向中心景观分离这一核心思想的适用范围与后果尚未被系统刻画。
AI.method: 对正则作用量做Bohr-Sommerfeld量子化得到Landau谱；将平滑约束转化为Born-Oppenheimer曲面，绝热参数为ℓ|∇V|/ℏω_c；用自洽屏蔽场；采用准局域输运公式R_H=∫ρ_H j_y dx/∫j_y dx；在冻结剖面与正则化局域欧姆模型下分析线性响应的交流修正；将电流反馈至静电方程（1–5 μA，霍尔压降为一到五个回旋能隙）研究对称性破缺；并以后处理方式加入类Akera局域横向热闭合（两种声子损耗律及激活热容闭合）评估热效应。
AI.result: 线性响应中冻结剖面的内在静电交流修正为无功型：Im R_H∝ω，Re R_H−R_H^DC∝ω²，在2 MHz以下小于10^-9。电流反馈（1–5 μA）打破条形反射对称性，霍尔压降集中于单一strip（反向电流下互换至10^-9），平台从低场侧变窄，而所研究的GaAs参数下高场边缘保持在ν(0)=2。热闭合估计显示低场侧窄载流strip可能升温约等于晶格温度；激活热容闭合下冷strip在0.3–2 μA的模型依赖电流处失去定常解。
AI.conclusion: 半经典分离图景能自洽产生量子霍尔输运的主要特征，包括交流无功修正、电流驱动的对称性破缺与平台变窄；热结论受损耗律与冻结剖面限制，仅为估计值。

title: Thermal Hall effect in elemental niobium, a two-gap superconductor
summary: Niobium holds a pivotal place in superconductivity history: it is not only the elemental superconductor with the highest critical temperature, but also a long-standing candidate for multiband pairing whose evidence has remained controversial. A two-gap scenario was proposed as early as 1959, yet experimental proof stayed elusive. Here, through thermal Hall effect measurements, we unambiguously demonstrate a crossover in transverse thermal transport below $T_{\rm c}$, where the dominant carrier switches from hole-like to electron-like upon cooling. This crossover is a clear hallmark of two distinct superconducting condensates. Fitting our data to a two-gap Bardeen-Rickayzen-Tewordt (BRT) model yields a second energy gap of approximately 0.22 $k_{\rm B}T_{\rm c}$, only 11\% of the dominant gap. This small gap size accounts for the difficulty in resolving the two-gap structure in earlier experiments. Crucially, the temperature at which the electron-like contribution to longitudinal thermal conductivity begins to dominate coincides with the onset of the sign reversal in the thermal Hall coefficient, confirming consistency between the two methods, and providing crucial information on the assignment of the superconducting gaps to their respective hole- or electron-like Fermi surface sheets. These findings not only resolve a longstanding controversy, but also establish that multigap superconductivity is far more common than previously assumed, and demonstrate the thermal Hall effect as a powerful probe for resolving gap multiplicities in superconductors.

AI.tldr: 通过热霍尔效应测量，首次明确证实铌存在双能隙超导，解决自1959年以来的长期争议。
AI.motivation: 铌是临界温度最高的元素超导体，且早被推测为多带配对候选者，但双能隙证据长期存在争议、难以验证。
AI.method: 测量Tc以下的横向热输运（热霍尔效应），观察到主导载流子由空穴型向电子型转变；并用双能隙BRT模型拟合数据，结合纵向热导率分析。
AI.result: 拟合得到第二能隙约0.22 kBTc，仅为主导能隙的11%；电子型纵向热导率开始主导的温度与热霍尔系数符号反转起始温度一致。
AI.conclusion: 证实铌的双能隙超导，表明多能隙超导比以往认为的更普遍，并确立热霍尔效应为探测超导能隙多重性的有力手段。

title: Shannon Entropy as an Order Parameter for the Two-Dimensional Confined Coulomb Systems: Exact Balance Law, Topological Charge Sum Rule, and Boundary Saturation
comment: Article: 21 pages, 2 figures; Supplemental material: 12 pages, 1 table
summary: We establish a complete information-theoretic framework for the known minimum-energy configurations of the two-dimensional Thomson problem on a hard-wall disk, based on the Shannon entropy of the Voronoi topological charge distribution. Two exact results are proven and hold for all studied systems of size $N=12$--$10^5$. First, an entropy balance law decomposes the total entropy into bulk, boundary, and mixing contributions without approximation. Second, a topological charge sum rule fixes the total charge at twice the number of boundary particles plus six; together with the observed separation of bulk and boundary coordination numbers, it yields exact relations between the populations of three- and four-coordinated boundary particles and the bulk charge. We further prove that the boundary entropy is bounded by the binary maximum and that saturation of this bound is equivalent to the bulk charge per boundary particle approaching minus one half, a regime that the framework itself restricts to boundaries of at least twelve particles. All identities are verified numerically to machine precision, locating bulk nucleation at $56$ particles, the maximum of global disorder at $146$, and the onset of boundary saturation beyond about $1000$. The framework carries over to closed spherical geometry, where the total charge is fixed at twelve.

AI.tldr: 基于Voronoi拓扑电荷分布的Shannon熵，为二维硬壁圆盘Thomson问题建立完整信息论框架，并证明两个对N=12至10^5均成立的精确结果。
AI.motivation: 为已知的最小能量构型提供精确的信息论刻画，揭示体相、边界与拓扑电荷之间的定量关系。
AI.method: 以Voronoi拓扑电荷分布的Shannon熵为核心，推导熵平衡定律（分解为体相、边界、混合贡献）与拓扑电荷求和规则（总电荷=2×边界粒子数+6），并证明边界熵受二元最大值约束及其饱和条件。
AI.result: 所有恒等式数值验证达机器精度；定位体相成核于56粒子、全局无序最大于146、边界饱和起始于约1000粒子；框架可推广至球形几何，总电荷固定为12。
AI.conclusion: 该信息论框架精确且可扩展，为Thomson问题的边界与体相结构提供统一描述。

title: Reservoir-conditioned virtual returns generate random Liouvillian skin localization in a reciprocal Mott insulator
summary: Directional dissipation can concentrate relaxation modes in space, but connecting this accumulation to controlled microscopic processes in correlated matter requires separating virtual charge motion from spin coherence. We study this connection in a half-filled Hubbard chain with reciprocal hopping and number-conserving, direction-selective returns of virtual doublon--hole defects. Eliminating charge defects and then Mott coherences yields asymmetric spin-exchange rates under an explicit separation of timescales, with full short-chain dynamics supporting the reduction on finite exchange times. Balanced random returns concentrate the stationary population and several low-lying right modes at sample-selected positions rather than a predetermined edge, producing random Liouvillian skin localization despite zero end-to-end logarithmic rate bias. The accumulated rate imbalance determines an exact finite-density hard-core stationary state and a one-particle activated relaxation scale governed by random barriers. This connection between locally calibrated return rates, many-body stationary weights and slow relaxation offers a means of controlling transport in constrained open quantum matter without changing the reciprocal Hamiltonian.

AI.tldr: 研究半填充Hubbard链中方向选择性虚电荷返回，通过消除电荷与Mott相干得到非对称自旋交换率，并导致随机Liouvillian趋肤局域化。
AI.motivation: 方向性耗散可在空间集中松弛模式，但需将虚电荷运动与自旋相干分离，以关联相关物质中的受控微观过程。
AI.method: 在半填充Hubbard链中，采用互易跳跃与守恒粒子数的方向选择性虚doublon-hole缺陷返回；在明确时间尺度分离下消除电荷缺陷及Mott相干，推导有效自旋交换率，并用短链动力学验证。
AI.result: 得到非对称自旋交换率；平衡随机返回使稳态布居与低能右模局域于样本选定位置而非预定边界，出现随机Liouvillian趋肤局域化，尽管端到端对数率偏置为零；累积率失衡决定精确有限密度硬核稳态及受随机势垒控制的单粒子激活松弛尺度。
AI.conclusion: 局部校准的返回率、多体稳态权重与慢松弛之间的联系，为在不改变互易哈密顿量的情况下控制受限开放量子物质中的输运提供了手段。

title: Physics-aware global Rietveld refinement for high-energy X-ray diffraction microscopy with application to reconstructing intragranular orientation and strain fields
summary: High-energy X-ray diffraction microscopy (HEDM) has emerged as a critical technique for studying the microstructure and, increasingly, strain fields in solids. However, current algorithmic or experimental methods to obtain intragranular fields are time-intensive, provide limited spatial resolution, or yield stress and strain fields that do not satisfy the universal laws of deformation (compatibility and equilibrium). In the context of standard HEDM, a novel physics-aware approach is presented in which the physics of deformation is included in the forward diffraction simulation to ensure that the reconstructed fields are physically meaningful. The entire simulated and experimental diffractograms are compared with a differentiable optimal transport--type objective, and a Rietveld refinement is carried out globally on the internal fields and grain topology using gradient-based optimization. The method is developed, verified with synthetic data, and demonstrated experimentally using near-field HEDM data from aluminum oxynitride (a brittle ceramic), with a reference implementation released as PARA-X. The reconstructions show remarkable improvement over existing methods (improved completeness and loss), and the high-fidelity, high-resolution recovery paves the way for using HEDM to study fine-scale deformation mechanics over large polycrystalline volumes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种物理感知的HEDM重建方法，将变形物理嵌入正向衍射模拟，用可微最优传输目标函数与基于梯度的Rietveld精修，重建满足相容性与平衡律的晶内应变场。
AI.motivation: 现有获取晶内应变场的算法或实验方法耗时、空间分辨率有限，或所得应力应变场不满足变形的普适规律（相容性与平衡），需要保证重建场物理上合理。
AI.method: 在标准HEDM框架下，将变形物理引入正向衍射模拟；对完整模拟与实验衍射图采用可微的最优传输型目标函数进行比较；对内场与晶粒拓扑进行全局Rietveld精修，使用基于梯度的优化。方法经合成数据验证，并用氮氧化铝（脆性陶瓷）的近场HEDM数据做实验演示，开源实现为PARA-X。
AI.result: 重建结果相较现有方法有显著提升（完整性和损失改善），实现了高保真、高分辨率的场恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该物理感知高分辨重建为利用HEDM研究大多晶体积内的细尺度变形力学开辟了道路。

title: How Accurately Can We Describe Spin Crossover?
summary: The complicated physicochemical properties of metal complexes that exhibit thermal spin crossover make it difficult for routine electronic structure calculations to yield an accurate transition temperature prediction, $T_{1/2}$. The difficulty lies in the intricate connection between the spin-crossover energy, which is a molecular spectroscopic property, and $T_{1/2}$, a condensed phase property. Here we show how to obtain spin-crossover energies systematically by reverse engineering of experimental $T_{1/2}$ data. The protocol is based upon fitting the range separation parameter, $ω$, in the hybrid LC-$ω$PBE density functional to reproduce the experimental $T_{1/2}$ values for a series of metal complexes. We provide insights into the sources of variations of at least $\pm 15$ kJ mol$^{-1}$ found from common exchange and correlation functionals by comparing their performance against our reference data. By analysis of the sensitivity of transition temperatures to $\pm 1$ \% shifts in the range separation parameter, we determined a typical uncertainty of $\pm 50$ K for them, and a $\pm 2$ kJ mol$^{-1}$ uncertainty in the extracted spin-crossover energies due to $\pm 1$ \% variations of $T_{1/2}$. Lastly, we present results from the high-level, all-electron coupled cluster method for eight of the smaller molecules in the reference data set, and discuss the influence of the truncation of the excitation series upon the spin state energies.

AI.tldr: 通过逆向工程实验T1/2数据，拟合LC-ωPBE泛函中的范围分离参数ω，系统获得自旋交叉能，并评估常见泛函的误差及参数敏感性。
AI.motivation: 金属配合物的热自旋交叉性质复杂，分子光谱性的自旋交叉能与凝聚相转变温度T1/2关系复杂，常规电子结构计算难以准确预测T1/2。
AI.method: 以实验T1/2为参考，拟合hybrid LC-ωPBE密度泛函的范围分离参数ω，反推自旋交叉能；对比常见交换相关泛函表现，分析ω±1%变化对T1/2和自旋交叉能的影响，并用高精度全电子耦合簇方法计算8个较小分子。
AI.result: 常见交换相关泛函给出的自旋交叉能存在至少±15 kJ mol−1的偏差；ω±1%变化对应T1/2约±50 K不确定性，导致提取的自旋交叉能约±2 kJ mol−1不确定性；耦合簇结果用于讨论激发级数截断对自旋态能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过拟合ω可系统标定自旋交叉能并量化泛函误差与参数敏感性，高精度耦合簇计算为评估激发截断效应提供参考。

title: Unified contact-free formulation of linear-response transport theory
summary: Thermal Hall transport is conventionally formulated as a current--current Kubo response supplemented by an energy-magnetization correction obtained through an auxiliary pseudogravitational magnetic field. Motivated by this structure, we develop a unified contact-free moment formulation of linear response to scalar sources. For channels whose source contributions vanish in the dc limit, the transport coefficient is the low-frequency residue of a retarded moment--moment correlator, with equal-time endpoint contributions incorporated before the dc limit is taken. The formulation uses only scalar sources, requires no separate magnetization subtraction, is independent of the local-current gauge, and is invariant under admissible redistributions of bond or interaction energy. It organizes particle, grand-energy, and specified spin-density channels within a common source--moment response matrix. Quadratic Landau--Lifshitz spin waves illustrate the method: the secular growth of polarization-moment correlations isolates the finite Hall residue and yields the magnon thermal Hall and spin Nernst coefficients from the same paraunitary band geometry. The formulation provides a unified operator framework that simplifies the organization of particle, thermal, and spin transport and can streamline calculations by eliminating separate contact and magnetization corrections.

AI.tldr: 提出无接触矩公式统一描述线性响应，用标量源和矩-矩关联子的低频留数给出输运系数，无需居里磁化修正。
AI.motivation: 传统热霍尔输运用电流-电流Kubo响应加辅助赝引力磁场得到的能量-磁化修正，结构复杂且需额外修正项。
AI.method: 发展统一的接触-free矩公式：对dc极限消失的通道，输运系数取推迟矩-矩关联子的低频留数，先含等时端点贡献再取dc极限；仅用标量源，将粒子、大能量、指定自旋密度通道组织进同一源-矩响应矩阵；以二次Landau-Lifshitz自旋波验证。
AI.result: 极化矩关联的长期增长分离出有限霍尔留数，从同一准幺正能带几何得到磁子热霍尔与自旋Nernst系数。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一简化粒子、热、自旋输运组织，消除独立接触与磁化修正，独立于局域电流规范且对能量重分布不变。

title: Wrinkles and Magnetic Flux Trapping in Graphite Nanoflakes: A Possible Source and Manifestation of Room-Temperature Superconductivity
summary: The paper reports on a possible manifestation of local high-temperature superconductivity in graphite nanoflakes obtained from the bulk pyrolytic graphite by an extended grinding and subsequent annealing at 670 K in the air. Analysis of transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images shows that such treatment leads to a formation of high-density wrinkle-type defects at the basal-plane surface. The sample reveals the magnetic flux trapping - one of the key signatures of superconductivity - that persists up to 390 K and above. At the same time, both the as-ground (unannealed) and annealed in the vacuum samples manifest negligible flux trapping, and no wrinkles in their TEM images were found. The direct correlation between the appearance of high-density wrinkle arrays and the detection of the trapped magnetic flux above the room temperature strongly suggests that wrinkled regions serve a source of local high-temperature superconductivity in graphite.

AI.tldr: 该论文报道了通过研磨并在空气中670 K退火处理石墨纳米片，在基面表面形成高密度褶皱缺陷，并观察到可持续到390 K以上的磁通俘获现象，暗示褶皱区域是石墨中局部高温超导的来源。
AI.motivation: 探索石墨中是否可能存在局部高温超导性，并寻找其微观结构来源（如特定缺陷类型）。
AI.method: 将块体热解石墨经长时间研磨，再在空气中670 K退火制备石墨纳米片；用透射电镜（TEM）观察缺陷结构，并测量磁通俘获（超导的关键特征）进行对比分析。
AI.result: 空气中退火样品表面形成高密度褶皱型缺陷，并表现出持续到390 K及以上的磁通俘获；而未退火及真空退火样品磁通俘获可忽略，TEM中也未见褶皱。
AI.conclusion: 高密度褶皱阵列的出现与室温以上磁通俘获之间存在直接相关性，强烈表明石墨中的褶皱区域是局部高温超导性的来源。

title: Sharp Bounds on the Mean Efficiency of a Fluctuating Machine
comment: 34 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Journal of Statistical Physics. Replication code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22735868
summary: The efficiency of a machine at the scale of thermal fluctuations is a random variable that conventionally has no moments of any order: the input heat in the denominator of $-W/Q_h$ fluctuates through zero. We work instead with the exergetic ratio $η=W/(W+T_0S)$, whose denominator vanishes only with its numerator, so that for non-negative dissipation it lies in $[0,1]$ pointwise and every moment exists, and we ask what the energy budget alone determines about its mean. With $α=T_0\langle S\rangle/W$ the mean dissipation per unit useful work and $σ^2$ the relative variance of the dissipation, $1/(1+α)<\langleη\rangle\leσ^2/(1+σ^2)+1/[(1+σ^2)(1+α(1+σ^2))]$, with both ends sharp and no distributional assumption. The lower bound is Jensen's inequality: fluctuating dissipation always raises the mean efficiency above its deterministic value. The upper bound is attained by an intermittently reversible law, which dissipates nothing at all in a fraction $σ^2/(1+σ^2)$ of realisations; it is a moment-problem extremal rather than a realised machine, but a stability result turns it into a prediction: a device measured near the bound must operate intermittently, testable against the trajectory record alone. A third moment closes the bracket entirely. When the delivered work also fluctuates, the bounds hold with the moments taken on the ratio $T_0S/W$, and the thermodynamic uncertainty relation then converts the ceiling into a precision-efficiency frontier: a machine with more reproducible output has a strictly lower efficiency ceiling. At zero dissipation variance this reduces to the known bound on a molecular motor's ratio-of-means efficiency, identifying it as one member of a family and showing it unsafe for the mean of the fluctuating ratio. Inside the interval lies the maximum-entropy benchmark $α^{-1}e^{1/α}E_1(1/α)$.

AI.tldr: 引入功㶲比 η=W/(W+T₀S) 以解决传统效率因分母过零而无矩的问题，并给出仅由能量预算决定的均值上下界。
AI.motivation: 传统效率 -W/Q_h 的分母经零波动，导致所有阶矩不存在，无法讨论随机效率的均值；需寻找一种点态有界且各阶矩存在的效率定义。
AI.method: 采用㶲比 η=W/(W+T₀S)；用平均单位有用功耗散 α=T₀⟨S⟩/W 与耗散相对方差 σ² 建立矩问题的上下界；借助三阶矩收拢区间，并利用热力学不确定性关系把上界转化为精度-效率前沿。
AI.result: 得到 1/(1+α)<⟨η⟩≤σ²/(1+σ²)+1/[(1+σ²)(1+α(1+σ²))]，两端紧且无需分布假设；下界为 Jensen 不等式，上界由间歇可逆律达到；零耗散方差时退化为分子马达已知界。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将均值效率限制为一族界，指出已知分子马达界不适用于波动比的均值；接近上界的器件必为间歇运行，可仅由轨迹记录检验。

title: Kagome lattice candidate URhSn: Measured Bragg diffraction patterns and theory for hexagonal and trigonal Sohncke phases
summary: Ternary intermetallics use a ZrNiAl-type chemical structure known as a kagome system. Complexity observed in the phase diagrams of these compounds is attributed to the geometric frustration. The 5f-electron compound URhSn exhibits two phase transitions at 16 K and 54 K. No super-lattice reflections in neutron powder diffraction patterns are detected in the intermediate range of temperatures (16 K - 54 K). Recent resonant x-ray diffraction patterns for uranium ions in the intermediate phase suggest a chiral structure and a trigonal Sohncke space group. It is firmly established that a simple hexagonal space group describes the parent structure at room temperature. A ferroic order parameter that includes hexadecapoles is shown to characterize the trigonal Sohncke phase. Resonant x-ray diffraction by this phase is fully investigated with our symmetry informed theory. It repairs symmetry in the original data analysis by using a grey group, and it lifts an unjustified spatial condition on uranium positions. The theory uses axial atomic multipoles that satisfy sum-rules established in the first instance for x-ray dichroic signals. A confrontation between observed and calculated diffraction patterns lends support to a trigonal Sohncke phase, and exposes grounds for additional experimental work on an enigmatic compound.

AI.tldr: URhSn 在 16-54 K 中间相被提出为三角 Sohncke 相（手性结构），含十六极序参量。作者用对称性理论的轴向多极子分析共振 X 射线衍射数据，修正原分析中的灰群引入与非正当铀位条件，结果支持这一相。
AI.motivation: ZrNiAl 型三元金属间化合物（kagome 体系）相图复杂，源于几何阻挫。URhSn 在 16 K 与 54 K 发生两次相变，中间相缺乏超晶格反射，近期共振 X 射线衍射提示可能存在手性结构与三角 Sohncke 空间群，需理论澄清其对称性。
AI.method: 提出基于对称性的理论，用满足 X 射线二向色信号求和规则的轴向原子多极子（含十六极）构造铁性序参量；修正原数据分析中灰群的使用，并解除对铀位置的不合理空间条件；将计算衍射图样与观测对比。
AI.result: 理论计算与观测的共振 X 射线衍射图样相互印证，支持中间相为三角 Sohncke 相，并揭示原分析中的对称性处理问题。
AI.conclusion: URhSn 中间相很可能为三角 Sohncke 手性相，需进一步实验验证这一复杂化合物的磁性/多极子序。

title: Probing (sub)nanoscale ferrons in an electron microscope
summary: Ferrons are collective excitations of polarization fluctuations that can enable terahertz communications and quantum transduction due to long propagation lengths. Although ferrons have been experimentally demonstrated in van der Waals ferroelectrics and relaxor ferroelectrics, there is no direct (sub)nanoscale experimental evidence of ferrons in three-dimensional ferroelectrics. Here, we detect two types of ferrons, Higgs and pseudo-Goldstone, at the (sub)nanoscale in lead titanate by measuring vibrational signals due to polarization fluctuations. By harnessing momentum transfer in electron energy loss spectroscopy (EELS), we directly distinguish between soft-phonons and ferrons. We observe that the Higgs mode originates from the soft optical phonon parallel to the polar axis, whereas the pseudo-Goldstone mode originates from the soft optical phonon perpendicular to the polarization axis. Together with Landau theory, Raman spectroscopy measurements, and EELS, we observe that Higgs group velocities, in the bulk limit, are eight times greater than those of out-of-plane soft phonons and the pseudo-Goldstone ferrons have group velocities six times greater than in-plane soft phonons due to long-range dipole interactions. We further show that the domain size confinement effects lead to doubling of the respective bulk ferron group velocities, reaching up to approximately 15 km per second (almost 15 times higher than the out-of-plane soft phonon modes). Overall, this study opens a pathway to the detection of ferrons in three-dimensional ferroelectrics with domain engineering as a promising avenue for terahertz communication and transduction.

AI.tldr: 本文利用EELS在三维铁电体钛酸铅中(亚)纳米尺度直接探测到Higgs和赝Goldstone两种ferron，并证明其群速度远高于软声子。
AI.motivation: ferron可实现太赫兹通信与量子转换，虽已在范德华和弛豫铁电体中观测到，但三维铁电体中缺乏直接的(亚)纳米尺度实验证据。
AI.method: 通过电子能量损失谱(EELS)测量极化涨落引起的振动信号，利用动量转移区分软声子与ferron，并结合Landau理论、拉曼光谱和EELS进行分析。
AI.result: Higgs模源自平行于极轴的软光学声子，赝Goldstone模源自垂直于极化轴的软光学声子；bulk极限下Higgs群速度是面外软声子的8倍，赝Goldstone是面内软声子的6倍；畴尺寸限域效应使群速度翻倍达约15 km/s。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为三维铁电体中ferron的探测开辟了途径，畴工程为太赫兹通信与转换提供了有前景的方向。

title: Optical activation of nonlinear Hall effect in topological insulators with warped Fermi surface
summary: Topological insulators (TIs) with hexagonally warped Fermi surface are natural platforms for the nonlinear Hall effect, as warping breaks inversion symmetry while preserving time-reversal symmetry (TRS). Here we show that this inversion breaking alone is insufficient: although warping generates a strongly anisotropic Berry curvature, the preserved threefold rotational symmetry forces the equilibrium Berry curvature dipole (BCD) to vanish identically. We demonstrate that linearly polarized light removes this symmetry obstruction: in the off-resonant Floquet regime, it lowers the rotational symmetry while preserving TRS, thereby generating a finite BCD whose magnitude, orientation, and sign are continuously tunable by the light intensity and polarization. For realistic Bi$_2$Te$_3$ parameters, we show that the induced BCD reaches $\sim$0.03~nm, yielding microampere-scale nonlinear Hall currents under experimentally accessible conditions. Our results therefore establish Floquet symmetry engineering as a route to activating the symmetry-forbidden nonlinear transport on TI surfaces without breaking the TRS.

AI.tldr: 六角翘曲拓扑绝缘体表面虽具有各向异性贝里曲率，但因三重旋转对称性使平衡态贝里曲率偶极子（BCD）严格为零；线偏振光的Flquet工程可降低旋转对称性并保持时间反演对称，从而激活可调的BCD与非线性霍尔电流。
AI.motivation: 六角翘曲费米面的拓扑绝缘体被认为是非线性霍尔效应的天然平台，因为翘曲打破反演对称而保持时间反演对称。然而作者指出仅靠反演破缺并不充分，平衡态BCD会被三重旋转对称性所禁止，需要探索新的对称性工程手段来激活该效应。
AI.method: 采用非共振Floquet理论分析线偏振光照射下拓扑绝缘体表面态的对称性与贝里曲率；并结合真实Bi₂Te₃参数进行数值计算，评估诱导BCD的大小、取向与符号随光强和偏振的可调性。
AI.result: 线偏振光在Floquet区域降低旋转对称性同时保持TRS，产生有限BCD，其大小、方向和符号可由光强与偏振连续调控；对Bi₂Te₃，诱导BCD约0.03 nm，在实验可达条件下可产生微安量级非线性霍尔电流。
AI.conclusion: Floquet对称性工程可在不破坏时间反演对称性的前提下，激活拓扑绝缘体表面被对称性禁止的非线性输运效应，为非线性霍尔效应提供了新的调控途径。

title: Stripe-Like Superconducting Enhancement and Coexisting Magnetic Texture in an Infinite Layer Nickelate
summary: Despite their promise as structural and electronic analogs to cuprates, nickelate thin films consistently exhibit broadened superconducting transitions in many experiments that remain poorly understood. Local measurements are ideal for revealing the presence of defects or competing phases, which may cause this transition broadening through a phase-separation. Here, we use scanning SQUID microscopy to investigate local superfluid density and magnetic texture of optimally doped $\mathrm{Nd}_{1-x}\mathrm{Eu}_{x}\mathrm{NiO}_{2}$ (NENO) (x=0.25) grown via molecular beam epitaxy. We observed a weakly-magnetic texture coexisting with superconductivity. Spatially resolved susceptibility imaging reveals a highly non-uniform superconducting state, characterized by a robust stripe-like enhancement pattern appearing near the phase transition. By resolving the mesoscopic landscape of electronic and magnetic inhomogeneities, these findings suggest that a competing magnetic phase is a primary contributor to the unusually broad superconducting transitions of these optimally doped NENO samples. Understanding the uncovered superconducting enhancement may provide a path to raising superconducting temperatures in these materials.

AI.tldr: 利用扫描SQUID显微镜研究最优掺杂NENO薄膜，发现弱磁织构与超导共存及非均匀超导态，条纹状增强源于竞争磁相。
AI.motivation: 镍酸盐薄膜作为铜酸盐的结构与电子类似物，其超导转变普遍异常宽化，机制不明；需通过局域测量揭示缺陷或竞争相导致的相分离。
AI.method: 对分子束外延生长、最优掺杂的Nd1-xEuxNiO2 (x=0.25) 薄膜，用扫描SQUID显微镜测量局域超流密度与磁织构，并进行空间分辨磁化率成像。
AI.result: 观测到与超导共存的弱磁织构；磁化率成像显示超导态高度不均匀，在相变附近出现稳健的条纹状增强图案。
AI.conclusion: 竞争磁相是该最优掺杂NENO样品超导转变异常宽化的主要因素；理解这种超导增强可能为提升此类材料的超导温度提供途径。

title: Reconstruction of the superstatistical temperature distribution from single-particle kinetic energies
summary: The framework of superstatistics can be used to describe non-Maxwellian single-particle velocity distributions as mixtures of Maxwellian distributions, where the weight is imposed by a probability density associated to the inverse temperature $β= 1/(k_B T)$. Among the typical model choices for $β$ are gamma, inverse gamma and lognormal distributions, sometimes called the universality classes of superstatistics. Given a set of observed velocities, however, there is no direct method to determine the underlying temperature distribution, as temperature itself is not a phase-space observable, and numerically inverting the Laplace transform is an unreliable process. In this work, we show that Jaynes' principle of maximum entropy can be used to successfully reconstruct the inverse temperature distribution from data, by using the logarithmic moments of the kinetic energy as constraints. Although the kinetic energy distributions for the three universality classes are almost indistinguishable at the same mean and variance of $β$, the method correctly discriminates between them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用最大熵原理，通过动能的对数矩约束，从观测速度数据重建超统计框架下的逆温度分布，并能正确区分gamma、逆gamma与对数正态三个普适类。
AI.motivation: 超统计用逆温度β的概率密度作为权重的麦克斯韦分布混合来描述非麦克斯韦速度分布，但温度不是相空间可观测量，且拉普拉斯逆变换数值不可靠，因此缺乏从观测速度直接确定温度分布的方法。
AI.method: 利用Jaynes最大熵原理，以动能的对数矩作为约束条件，重建逆温度分布。
AI.result: 尽管在β相同均值和方差下三个普适类的动能分布几乎无法区分，该方法仍能正确区分它们。
AI.conclusion: 最大熵原理结合动能对数矩约束是从数据重建逆温度分布的有效、可靠方法，并具备区分超统计普适类的能力。

title: Finite-temperature quantum Monte Carlo study of Dirac quantum criticality: Algorithmic advances and comprehensive analysis
summary: We present a systematic study of the quantum phase transition from a Dirac semimetal to an antiferromagnetic Mott insulator in the honeycomb-lattice Hubbard model, using finite-temperature auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo (AFQMC) simulations. Given the dynamical critical exponent $z=1$ at criticality, we scale the inverse temperature $β$ with the linear system size $L$, i.e., $βt=L$ (with $t$ as the hopping amplitude), to approach the thermodynamic and zero-temperature limits simultaneously. On the algorithmic front, we generalize the fast Fourier transform in path propagation to multi-sublattice systems and employ the delayed update technique in configuration updates to accelerate the AFQMC simulations. These advances enable us to access unprecedented system sizes of up to $3528$ sites (with $L=42$ and $βt = 42$). We additionally use twist-averaged boundary conditions to reduce the finite-size effects in computed observables. On the physical side, we determine the Dirac quantum criticality via finite-size scaling analysis of the spin correlations and off-diagonal single-particle Green's function, and locate the critical point at $U_c/t=3.731(4)$ with the critical exponents $ν=1.097(7)$, $η_φ=0.72(2)$ and $η_ψ=0.155(6)$. We further corroborate the critical point by examining several relevant quantities, including the quasiparticle weight, Fermi-liquid parameter, charge compressibility, $U$-derivative of double occupancy, and fidelity susceptibility. Our work establishes an independent benchmark for the chiral Heisenberg Gross-Neveu-Yukawa criticality in the honeycomb Hubbard model, offering a complementary perspective to previous ground-state simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文用有限温度AFQMC系统研究蜂窝晶格Hubbard模型中Dirac半金属到反铁磁Mott绝缘体的量子相变，通过算法改进实现迄今最大规模模拟，并精确确定临界点与临界指数。
AI.motivation: 探究蜂窝晶格Hubbard模型中Dirac半金属—反铁磁Mott绝缘体相变，为手性Heisenberg Gross-Neveu-Yukawa临界性提供独立基准，并与以往基态模拟互补。
AI.method: 采用有限温度行列式辅助场量子蒙特卡洛(AFQMC)；利用临界处动力学指数z=1，取βt=L同时趋向零温与热力学极限；将路径传播中FFT推广到多子晶格系统，并用延迟更新技术加速；使用twist-averaged边界条件减小有限尺寸效应；对自旋关联和off-diagonal单粒子Green函数做有限尺寸标度分析。
AI.result: 可达最大3528格点(L=42, βt=42)；确定临界点U_c/t=3.731(4)，临界指数ν=1.097(7)、η_φ=0.72(2)、η_ψ=0.155(6)；并通过准粒子权重、费米液体参数、电荷压缩率、双占据的U导数及fidelity susceptibility等量交叉验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了蜂窝Hubbard模型中手性Heisenberg Gross-Neveu-Yukawa临界性的独立基准，为以往基态模拟提供了互补视角。

title: B-type Quadratic Planar Hall Effect as a Probe of Altermagnetic Order
summary: Conventional transport and optical responses, such as the Hall effect, can only distinguish material phases with substantially different symmetries. However, many quantum materials, such as candidate altermagnetic materials, host competing phases with similar structures, making it difficult to differentiate them using conventional transport or optical measurements. Here, guided by symmetry principles, we introduce a B-type quadratic planar Hall effect (B2-PHE) as a sensitive probe of magnetic structures. B2-PHE features a planar Hall current that scales quadratically with the applied magnetic field. This response originates from the interplay among external magnetic fields, intrinsic magnetic order, and quantum geometric properties of the electronic bands. We investigate B2-PHE in two altermagnetic candidates, KV2Se2O and RuO2, whose ground-state magnetic orders are under intense debate. Remarkably, B2-PHE emerges in their altermagnetic phases but is symmetry-forbidden in their antiferromagnetic (nonmagnetic) phases. We also show that B2-PHE should be detectable under a moderate magnetic field on the order of 1 Tesla. These findings establish B2-PHE as an experimentally convenient and potentially unambiguous probe of altermagnetic order, which is otherwise difficult to realize.

AI.tldr: 本文提出B型二次平面霍尔效应（B2-PHE）作为探测磁性结构的灵敏探针，可区分具有相似对称性的竞争量子物态。
AI.motivation: 传统霍尔效应等输运和光学响应只能区分对称性差异显著的材料相，而许多量子材料（如候选交变磁体）存在结构相似的竞争相，难以用常规手段区分其对称性相近的磁结构，因此需要新的灵敏探测手段。
AI.method: 基于对称性原理，引入B型二次平面霍尔效应（B2-PHE），该响应的平面霍尔电流随外加磁场二次方缩放，源于外磁场、本征磁序与电子能带量子几何性质之间的相互作用。在KV2Se2O和RuO2两个交变磁体候选材料中研究了该效应。
AI.result: B2-PHE在两种材料的交变磁相中出现，但在其反铁磁（非磁）相中被对称性禁止；该效应应在约1特斯拉量级的中等磁场下可被探测。
AI.conclusion: B2-PHE是一种实验上方便且可能无歧义地探测交变磁序的手段，而这类磁序原本难以被探测。

title: Two Strategies to Measure Spin-Orbit-Torque Efficiency Acting on the Insulating Magnet Li$_{0.5}$Al$_{0.7}$Fe$_{1.8}$O$_4$
summary: For insulating magnets, widely-used electrically-based techniques to measure spin-orbit-torque efficiency can suffer from poor signal-to-noise ratios and unwanted artifacts, while optical measurements based on conventional magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) imaging often lack sufficient sensitivity. Here we analyze two strategies for measuring the spin-torque efficiency acting on an insulating magnet, focusing on the torque from Pt acting on thin films of the low-damping magnet lithium aluminum ferrite (LAFO). First, lateral + longitudinal spin-torque ferromagnetic resonance (ST-FMR) allows separation of the spin-torque signal from artifacts due to spin-pumping and resonant heating. With this technique, we measure a spin-torque efficiency $ξ^\text{ST-FMR}_\text{DL}\sim\ 0.07$, comparable to but a bit less than for Pt acting on metallic ferromagnets. Second, we attempted optical measurements of spin-orbit-torque-induced magnetic deflection using Sagnac interferometry. We find that Sagnac interferometry provides sufficient sensitivity to measure signals from 14.4 nm LAFO thin films, but the inferred torque efficiency is much weaker than the result from lateral + longitudinal ST-FMR. We speculate that there may be another contribution to the Sagnac signal other than current-induced magnetic deflection, perhaps an out-of-plane component of itinerant electron spins. This becomes relevant for insulating magnets in which the magneto-optic coupling coefficient is very weak.

AI.tldr: 本论文分析两种测量Pt对绝缘磁体LAFO薄膜的自旋轨道力矩效率的方法：横向+纵向ST-FMR测得ξ_DL~0.07，而Sagnac干涉光学测量结果偏弱，推测存在非磁偏转的其他信号贡献。
AI.motivation: 绝缘磁体的电学自旋轨道力矩测量信噪比差且易受伪信号干扰，而传统MOKE成像光学测量灵敏度不足，因此需要评估更可靠的测量策略。
AI.method: 采用两种方法：(1) 横向+纵向自旋力矩铁磁共振(ST-FMR)，可分离自旋力矩信号与自旋泵浦及共振加热伪信号；(2) 使用Sagnac干涉仪进行自旋轨道力矩诱导磁偏转的光学测量。
AI.result: ST-FMR测得阻尼类自旋力矩效率ξ_DL~0.07，与Pt作用于金属铁磁体相当但略低；Sagnac干涉仪对14.4 nm LAFO薄膜具有足够灵敏度，但推断的力矩效率远弱于ST-FMR结果。
AI.conclusion: Sagnac信号可能包含电流诱导磁偏转之外的其他贡献（如 itinerant电子自旋的面外分量），这对磁光耦合系数很弱的绝缘磁体尤为重要。

title: Modulated structures in discrete approximations to a three-dimensional cholesteric model on a recursive lattice
summary: We study finite-state approximations to a chiral nematic lattice model whose local directors are embedded in three-dimensional orientational space. The model analyzed here is formulated in terms of a rotated quadrupolar interaction, which provides a direct angular chirality parameter $Δ$ and reduces to the usual planar chiral-nematic form for directors confined to the xy plane. On a rooted Cayley tree, the statistical problem is written as a nonlinear recursion for branch partition functions. In the infinite-coordination limit, with $rJ_Q$ fixed, the recursion becomes a softmax map for the state probabilities. We analyze Cartesian three-state, planar four-state, and non-planar four-state discretizations. The first supports ordered and period-two attractors, whereas the planar four-state discretization displays a sequence of commensurate and longer-period modulated attractors. Its disordered fixed point loses stability at $t=9/16$ through a complex-conjugate pair with phase $q=\pm 2Δ$, so a modulated critical mode is selected for every nonzero chirality. The non-planar four-state set is intrinsically anisotropic and, when the stated model is reconstructed directly, supports prominent period-three as well as period-two and higher-period cycles. Because attractor stability does not by itself establish global thermodynamic stability, the diagrams reported here are interpreted as attractor/stability diagrams rather than equilibrium phase diagrams.

AI.tldr: 研究手性向列晶格模型的有限状态近似，分析Cayley树上软max映射的吸引子与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 探索局域指向矢嵌入三维取向空间时的手性向列模型行为，用旋转四极相互作用引入直接的角手性参数Δ，并考察不同有限状态离散化下的统计与动力学特征。
AI.method: 在根化Cayley树上将统计问题写成分支配分函数的非线性递推；无限配位极限下（固定rJ_Q）递推化为状态概率的softmax映射；分析Cartesian三态、平面四态与非平面四态离散化。
AI.result: 三态支持有序与周期二吸引子；平面四态出现一系列公度及更长周期调制吸引子，其无序不动点在t=9/16处通过相位q=±2Δ的复共轭对失稳，非零手性下选定调制临界模；非平面四态固有各向异性，重构模型后支持明显的周期三、周期二及更高周期循环。
AI.conclusion: 由于吸引子稳定性本身不能确立全局热力学稳定性，所报告图示应解释为吸引子/稳定性图，而非平衡相图。

title: Rhombohedral Multilayer Graphene as a $p$-Wave Magnet
summary: We propose rhombohedral multilayer graphene in an applied in-plane magnetic field as a highly tunable platform for nonrelativistic collinear $p$-wave magnetism. The orbital coupling to the magnetic field breaks time-reversal symmetry and, together with interaction-driven layer antiferromagnetism, generates an odd-in-momentum spin splitting without relying on spin-orbit coupling. Using a minimal low-energy effective theory, we show that the resulting $p$-wave spin splitting is strongly enhanced with increasing layer number. This enhancement originates from the surface-localized nature of the low-energy states and their layer-dependent orbital coupling to the in-plane field. The Zeeman coupling only weakly perturbs this predominantly orbital-field-induced mechanism. We further estimate stability of the $p$-wave magnetism under hole-doping and distinct transport signature using a more realistic Hubbard model. Our results establish orbital coupling to an external magnetic field as a controllable route to odd-parity spin splitting in collinear magnets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在面内磁场下的菱方多层石墨烯是一种高度可调的非相对论共线p波磁性平台，磁场轨道耦合与层间反铁磁相互作用共同产生奇宇称自旋劈裂，且随层数增加显著增强。
AI.motivation: 寻找不依赖自旋轨道耦合即可产生奇宇称（p波）自旋劈裂的可控机制，并利用面内磁场与多层石墨烯的可调性构建共线p波磁性平台。
AI.method: 采用最小低能有效理论分析磁场轨道耦合、层间反铁磁序与塞曼耦合的作用；并用更现实的Hubbard模型研究空穴掺杂下的稳定性及输运特征。
AI.result: 轨道磁场耦合打破时间反演对称性，与相互作用驱动的层反铁磁性相结合产生奇宇称自旋劈裂；p波自旋劈裂随层数增加而强烈增强，源于低能态的局域表面性质及层依赖轨道耦合；塞曼耦合对该机制扰动较弱。
AI.conclusion: 面内磁场下的菱方多层石墨烯可作为可调的非相对论共线p波磁性平台，外部磁场轨道耦合为共线磁体中产生奇宇称自旋劈裂提供了可控途径。

title: A Direct Algebraic Approach to Normal Ordering of Exponential Bosonic Operators with Applications to Two-Dimensional Excitonic Form Factors
summary: We develop a systematic algebraic approach, based on the Wei--Norman factorization method, to the normal ordering of exponential bosonic operators and apply it to derive analytical excitonic form factors in two-dimensional semiconducting materials. By introducing an auxiliary parameter, the normal-ordering problem is reduced to a system of ordinary differential equations determined by the commutation relations of the underlying closed Lie algebra. The approach is first illustrated for exponential operators associated with the Heisenberg--Weyl and $su(1,1)$ algebras, and is then extended to two-mode bosonic operators involving $su(2)$ and a six-generator closed algebra that contains two coupled $su(1,1)$ subalgebras. For the excitonic application, the Levi--Civita transformation maps the two-dimensional exciton problem onto an oscillator representation, providing a natural formulation in terms of bosonic creation and annihilation operators. Combined with the Laplace and Fourier representations of the Rytova--Keldysh potential, this formulation reduces the interaction matrix elements to the evaluation of exponential bosonic form factors. The isotropic problem is governed by a three-generator $su(1,1)$ algebra, whereas the anisotropic case requires the full six-generator algebra together with an additional $su(2)$ factorization. Explicit analytical expressions for both form factors, $\langle e^{-rt}\rangle$ and $\langle e^{i\mathbf q\cdot\mathbf r}\rangle$, are obtained, providing useful building blocks for matrix-element calculations in two-dimensional excitonic systems and potentially in other quantum problems involving exponential bosonic operators.

AI.tldr: 基于Wei–Norman分解法发展系统代数方法求解指数玻色算符的正规序，并应用于二维半导体材料中的激子形状因子。
AI.motivation: 指数玻色算符的正规序在量子多体问题中常见但计算繁琐；二维激子的解析形状因子对矩阵元计算有实用价值。
AI.method: 引入辅助参数将正规序问题化为由李代数对易关系确定的常微分方程组；用Levi–Civita变换把二维激子映射为振子表示，结合Rytova–Keldysh势的Laplace/Fourier表示，将相互作用矩阵元化为指数玻色形状因子。
AI.result: 对Heisenberg–Weyl、su(1,1)、su(2)及含两个耦合su(1,1)的六生成元代数给出处理；各向同性激子由三生成元su(1,1)描述，各向异性需六生成元代数加su(2)分解；得到⟨e^{-rt}⟩和⟨e^{iq·r}⟩的显式解析表达式。
AI.conclusion: 提供了二维激子矩阵元计算的解析构件，也可推广到其他涉及指数玻色算符的量子问题。

title: Percolation threshold in cluster-assembled nanogranular palladium films and related strategies for hydrogen detection
summary: Electrical transport in cluster-assembled nanogranular palladium films was investigated in-situ during growth by Supersonic Cluster Beam Deposition. The percolation onset is observed at a thickness of 1.5 nm, while the percolation completion at 2.5 nm. Films at the percolation thickness (2 nm) and beyond the percolation end (5 nm) were subsequently exposed ex-situ to 0.25% hydrogen in air to investigate how hydrogen-induced structural changes in Pd clusters modulate electrical transport and can be exploited as mechanism for selective hydrogen detection. Implantation of palladium clusters in soft polymer styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene was also explored to promote clusters separation and enhance quantum tunnelling phenomena within electrical transport. The observed electrical transport pattern features stable baselines in air, suggesting material stability, fast response time (T50% < 10 s), and the coexistence of reversible and irreversible components in conduction changes induced by hydrogen exposure. The irreversible component is tentatively attributed to hydrogen-promoted partial coalescence of Pd clusters.
