The behaviour of the polymer implanted samples suggests an alternative gas detection mechanism where hydrogen-induced polymer swelling dominates over palladium structural modifications. These results disclose novel possible transducing routes for miniaturized hydrogen detection and multimodal sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文原位研究了超声团簇束沉积生长的纳米颗粒钯薄膜的电输运，并探索其在氢气检测中的传感机制。
AI.motivation: 理解氢气诱导的Pd团簇结构变化如何调制电输运，并寻找小型化氢气检测和多模态传感的新转导机制。
AI.method: 原位测量生长过程中Pd纳米颗粒膜电导，确定渗流起始（1.5 nm）与完成（2.5 nm）厚度；将2 nm和5 nm膜暴露于0.25%氢气；并将Pd团簇植入SEBS聚合物以增强量子隧穿。
AI.result: 空气基线稳定，响应快（T50%<10 s）；氢气诱导电导变化含可逆与不可逆成分，不可逆成分归因于氢气促发的Pd团簇部分融合；聚合物样品中氢气诱导的聚合物溶胀主导响应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了纳米颗粒Pd膜及聚合物植入体系中氢气传感的新转导路径，为小型化氢检测和多模态传感提供可能。

title: Charge order before superconductivity in the doped kagome Dirac spin liquid
summary: Doping a quantum spin liquid is expected to give a superconductor. On kagome it gives charge order first, because of band structure rather than interaction. In the chargon (Higgs) construction of its U(1) Dirac spin liquid the two gauge components, degenerate on square and triangular lattices, are split by a line-graph effect: one disperses, four minima at $-(1+\sqrt6)t$; the other has two exactly flat lowest bands at $-2t$. Only the dispersive component condenses, over a bare-mass window of width exactly $(\sqrt6-1)t$, in which the doped spin liquid forms charge and loop-current crystals on the $M$, $K$ and $K/2$ stars, the physical U(1) unbroken: a chargon Higgs phase that does not superconduct. Its pairing channels are those of the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ descendants, a pair-density wave, uniform $d+id$ excluded at leading order and at all orders on the $M$ star. The projective symmetry group reduces the quartic competition to one angle, on which projected on-site repulsion sits exactly at the $M$/$K/2$ boundary, a direction protected to all orders by $O(4)\times U(1)$ under renormalization, though lattice matching gives the physical coupling off-ray components. The competing $M$-star crystals are degenerate through sextic order, split only at eighth. The charge sector carries its own classification, the charged counterpart of the undoped bilinear-and-monopole catalog, which holds no charge-carrying operator; it puts the doped Mott insulator and kagome metals on one $F$-irrep grid, separated by the charge-order irrep ($F_1$ there, $F_3$ here) and the Landau cubic. Predicted: $C_2$-odd ($F_3$) charge order, no cubic invariant; vestigial pair phases of period $h/4e$ or $h/6e$; loop-current fields of order ten gauss at herbertsmithite's $^{17}$O and $^{35}$Cl; and, if the $Γ$ flux orders with the condensate, charge and current order setting in together below the condensation scale.

AI.tldr: 在Kagome格子上掺杂U(1) Dirac自旋液体，由于线图能带效应而非相互作用，先形成电荷序而非超导，只涌现出带电但U(1)未破缺的"chargon Higgs相"。
AI.motivation: 掺杂量子自旋液体通常预期产生超导。但在Kagome格子上，还需理解为何电荷序先于超导出现，以及其背后是能带结构还是相互作用主导。
AI.method: 采用chargon（Higgs）构造研究U(1) Dirac自旋液体：分析两个规范分量（在方格子/三角格子上简并）被"线图效应"劈裂的能带；用投影对称群约化四次竞争为一个角度；结合重整化分析$O(4)\times U(1)$保护方向，并进行晶格匹配。
AI.result: 一个分量弥散，四个极小值在$-(1+\sqrt6)t$；另一个有两条精确平带在$-2t$。仅弥散分量凝聚，裸质量窗口宽度恰为$(\sqrt6-1)t$，形成$M$、$K$、$K/2$星上的电荷与环流晶体，U(1)未破缺。配对通道为$\mathbb{Z}_2$后代，均匀$d+id$被排除。投影现场排斥恰好位于$M$/$K/2$边界；竞争$M$星晶体至六阶简并、第八阶才劈裂。预测$C_2$-odd($F_3$)电荷序、无立方不变量、周期$h/4e$或$h/6e$的残余配对相、约十高斯的环流场，以及可能电荷与电流序同步出现。
AI.conclusion: Kagome掺杂自旋液体因线图能带效应先形成电荷序，产生不超导的chargon Higgs相；电荷扇区具有独立分类，将掺杂Mott绝缘体与kagome金属置于同一$F$-irrep网格上。

title: Bridging Control, Inference, Transport, and Thermodynamics: From Theory to Applications in Learning
summary: The last decade has seen the development of powerful methods for learning complex structure from high-dimensional data. These advances have brought to the foreground fundamental connections between subdisciplines of physics, applied mathematics, and machine learning. In this review, we bring together some of these ideas, often expressed in different languages, to highlight a conceptual thread that links five distinct fields: control theory, optimal transport, probabilistic inference, non-equilibrium thermodynamics, and machine learning. A common theme is the optimization of free-energy-like functionals under dynamical or statistical constraints. We offer a guided tour through this thread and present selected applications in reinforcement learning, variational inference, and generative modeling. The review does not assume prior familiarity with these topics, and begins with principles originating from physics.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述，串联控制论、最优传输、概率推断、非平衡热力学与机器学习五个领域，核心主题是动力/统计约束下类自由能泛函的优化。
AI.motivation: 过去十年高维数据复杂结构学习的强大方法发展，凸显了物理学、应用数学与机器学习之间的根本联系。本文希望把用不同"语言"表述的相关思想整合起来，梳理出一条贯穿五个领域的概念主线。
AI.method: 综述性引导式梳理（guided tour），以源自物理学的原理为起点，围绕"在动力学或统计约束下优化类自由能泛函"这一共同主题，串联控制论、最优传输、概率推断、非平衡热力学与机器学习，并选取应用案例。
AI.result: 呈现了五个领域间的概念关联，并给出了在强化学习、变分推断和生成建模中的代表性应用。
AI.conclusion: 这些领域共享同一概念脉络，将物理原理与机器学习方法联系起来有助于相互借鉴；综述不要求读者具备相关主题基础。

title: The Propagating Nature of Single- and Multimagnons in LaCrO$_3$
summary: The dispersion of an excitation is commonly used to infer its microscopic character: dispersive modes are associated with propagation, whereas nondispersive features are often interpreted as localized. This distinction becomes less straightforward for composite excitations, whose spectral maxima can remain nearly dispersionless even when they are built from propagating quasiparticles. Here we use momentum- and temperature-dependent resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) to reveal the origin of multimagnon excitations in antiferromagnetic LaCrO$_3$. Whereas the single magnon disperses strongly, the two- and three-magnon features remain nearly flat. On approaching the Neel temperature, thermal population of the magnon band produces an anti-Stokes branch and opens an additional three-magnon channel involving the creation of two magnons and annihilation of one. Its energy and momentum dependence are reproduced by a thermally weighted multimagnon joint density of states calculations. These results establish thermal population as a means of exposing the propagating constituents hidden within nondispersive composite excitations, and position RIXS as a probe of multimagnon dynamics and, ultimately, magnon-magnon interactions.

AI.tldr: 利用动量与温度依赖的RIXS研究LaCrO₃中多磁振子激发的起源，发现双磁振子和三磁振子特征几乎无色散，但通过热激发的反斯托克斯支揭示了其由传播的磁振子构成。
AI.motivation: 激发的色散通常被用来推断其微观性质：有色散的模式对应传播，无色散的特征被解读为局域化。但对于复合激发，即使由传播的准粒子构成，其谱峰也可能几乎无色散，这一判据不再可靠，因此需要新的手段揭示其内在构成。
AI.method: 对反铁磁LaCrO₃进行动量与温度依赖的共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）测量，并结合热加权的多磁振子联合态密度计算来解释实验数据。
AI.result: 单磁振子强烈色散，而双磁振子和三磁振子特征几乎保持平坦。接近奈尔温度时，磁振子带的热占据产生反斯托克斯支，并开启额外的三磁振子通道（产生两个磁振子并湮灭一个），其能量与动量依赖与热加权多磁振子联合态密度计算吻合。
AI.conclusion: 热占据可作为揭示无色散复合激发中隐藏的传播组分的手段，并确立RIXS作为探测多磁振子动力学乃至磁振子-磁振子相互作用的探针。

title: Quantum interpretation of classical LiF simulations
summary: Recent studies have shown that classical LiF simulations can reproduce low-temperature experimental spectra when performed at a simulation temperature $T^*$ higher than the physical temperature $T$. We show that the characteristic scale of this rescaling follows naturally from quantum vibrational statistics. An effective temperature $T_{\rm eff}(T)$ is obtained by matching classical and quantum harmonic energies and is evaluated using an analytic acoustic-optical model and a first-principles LiF vibrational density of states $D(\varepsilon)$. The resulting temperature reproduces the low-temperature scale of the reported spectral temperature and approaches the physical temperature in the classical regime. Our results identify zero-point motion and Planck-Bose-Einstein statistics as the origin of the reported temperature scale.

AI.tldr: 经典LiF模拟需用高于物理温度$T$的模拟温度$T^*$才能重现低温实验谱；本文证明该温标重标定源于量子振动统计，通过匹配经典与量子谐振子能量得到有效温度$T_{\rm eff}(T)$，可自然解释此现象。
AI.motivation: 经典分子动力学模拟在低温下无法直接重现实验谱，文献中需人为设定更高的"模拟温度"$T^*$，但这一温标重标定的物理起源此前不清楚。
AI.method: 通过匹配经典与量子谐振子能量定义有效温度$T_{\rm eff}(T)$，并利用解析声学-光学模型及第一性原理计算的LiF振动态密度$D(\varepsilon)$进行数值评估。
AI.result: $T_{\rm eff}$在低温下重现了文献报道的谱温标，并在经典极限下趋近物理温度$T$。
AI.conclusion: 零点运动与Planck-Bose-Einstein统计是所报道温标现象的根本原因。该框架为低温经典模拟的温标校正提供物理解释。

title: Unbiased first-principles construction of complete tensorial spin Hamiltonians
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, supplementary information will be released in publication
summary: Magnetic ground states are commonly predicted using spin Hamiltonians whose interaction terms are selected a priori, potentially overlooking the microscopic interactions that govern complex magnetic order. Here, we introduce a general framework for the unbiased first-principles construction of symmetry-complete tensorial spin Hamiltonians and its automated implementation in AMATIS. The framework constructs the Hamiltonian directly from density-functional theory while rigorously enforcing quantum spin algebra and crystallographic symmetry. Applied to representative two-dimensional van der Waals magnets, the framework reproduces established magnetic interactions and uncovers hidden physics beyond conventional spin models, including chiral interactions that stabilize metastable skyrmions, higher-rank tensorial interactions that reconstruct the magnetic phase diagram and establish stabilizing competing multi-Q phases, and an emergent p-wave altermagnetic electronic structure. Our results demonstrate that unbiased tensorial Hamiltonian construction provides a predictive alternative to the conventional practice of manually selecting spin-model interactions, enabling first-principles discovery of unconventional magnetic phases.

AI.tldr: 提出无偏构建对称完备张量自旋哈密顿量的第一性原理框架AMATIS，直接由DFT出发并严格满足量子自旋代数与晶体对称性，在二维范德华磁体中揭示了传统自旋模型遗漏的物理。
AI.motivation: 传统磁性基态预测依赖事先人为选取相互作用项的spin Hamiltonian，可能遗漏支配复杂磁序的微观相互作用，亟需无偏、对称完备的第一性原理构建方法。
AI.method: 构建从DFT直接导出的自旋哈密顿量框架，严格强制量子自旋代数与晶体对称性，实现对称完备的张量自旋哈密顿量无偏构建，并在AMATIS中自动化实现。
AI.result: 应用于代表性二维范德华磁体：重现已知磁相互作用，并发现手性相互作用稳定亚稳skyrmion、高阶张量相互作用重构磁相图并稳定竞争性多Q相、以及涌现的p波altermagnetic电子结构。
AI.conclusion: 无偏张量哈密顿量构建为传统人工选择自旋模型相互作用提供了具预测性的替代方案，可实现非常规磁相的第一性原理发现。

title: Opto-Electrical Detection of Donor Bound Excitons in Silicon-on-Insulator Substrate
summary: Spin of a donor bound electron in silicon has been shown to be a very coherent qubit system but lacks a coherent optical interface. There does, however, exist a donor bound exciton transition that can be excited optically but decays dominantly via an Auger recombination producing an electrical signal. This provides an opto-electrical pathway for spin readout. Scaling this readout to single-spin level will require interfacing the spins with silicon photonics for efficient guiding of photons, which in turn will require moving to silicon-on-insulator (SOI) substrates. Here we demonstrate first ensemble opto-electronic measurements of donor bound excitons in SOI material, including isotopically purified 28-Si device layers. The experiments show pronounced shifts in the resonance wavelengths and broadenings of the transition linewidths compared to the bulk experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在绝缘体上硅(SOI)材料中实现供体束缚激子的系综光电测量，为硅基自旋量子比特的光学读出铺路。
AI.motivation: 硅中供体束缚电子自旋是相干性优良的量子比特体系，但缺乏相干光学接口。供体束缚激子可通过光学激发并主要经俄歇复合产生电信号，从而提供自旋读出的光电通路。将该读出推广至单自旋级别需借助硅光子学高效导引光子，这要求转向SOI衬底。
AI.method: 在SOI材料（包括同位素纯化的28-Si器件层）上开展供体束缚激子的系综光电测量。
AI.result: 与体材料实验相比，观察到共振波长显著偏移及跃迁线宽展宽。
AI.conclusion: 初步验证了SOI中供体束缚激子的光电特性，是其向单自旋光学读出与硅光子集成方向发展的第一步。

title: Quantum Hall Ferromagnetism in a Cavity Vacuum
summary: We uncover a continuous phase transition in a quantum Hall ferromagnet (QHF) at filling factor $ν=1$, driven by vacuum fluctuations of a cavity. Our analysis starts with a Landau level projection in dipole gauge, where we find the states to be well-represented by a tensor product of the electronic and photonic degrees of freedom. Through analytic spin wave calculations, mean-field theory and density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) simulations, we show that for a spatially antisymmetric cavity field, the uniform QHF state is stable only for weak light-matter coupling and gives way to states of inhomogeneous electron density above a critical coupling. These states involve "flanks" of uniform QHF fluids, separated by a "compact core" of doubly occupied orbitals with the core size being the order parameter, which we dub as "compact-core phases". While the fully spin polarized electronic states are product states, entanglement builds up between the uniform QHF flanks across the compact core in the $S_z=0$ magnetic sector, motivating an ansatz for the compact-core electronic states. The transition boundary is exactly derived for product electronic states in terms of matter and cavity parameters, and numerically confirmed by DMRG. We also study the thin-cylinder limit near the critical point where quantum fluctuations are enhanced, and the many-body excited states in both phases by focusing on the entanglement spectrum degeneracies. Remarkably, the photon number is found to probe the order parameter of the transition, providing a possible experimental signature of the electronic transition and the compact-core states. Our study offers a rare example of a phase of electrons stabilized solely by coupling to the enhanced vacuum fluctuations of a cavity mode.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示填充分数ν=1的量子霍尔铁磁体(QHF)在腔真空涨落驱动下发生连续相变，弱耦合下均匀QHF稳定，强耦合下转变为"紧凑核心相"（均匀QHF侧翼夹着双占据轨道核心），核心尺寸为序参量；光子数可探测序参量。
AI.motivation: 探索腔真空涨落能否仅凭光-物质耦合稳定新的电子物相，特别是在量子霍尔铁磁体体系中寻找由腔驱动的新奇相变与电子态。
AI.method: 在偶极规范下做朗道能级投影，将态表示为电子与光子自由度的张量积；结合解析自旋波计算、平均场理论和DMRG模拟，并研究薄柱面极限与纠缠谱简并。
AI.result: 发现空间反对称腔场下均匀QHF仅弱耦合稳定，超过临界耦合后出现非均匀电子密度的"紧凑核心相"；精确导出乘积电子态的相变边界并由DMRG数值确认；S_z=0扇区中侧翼间产生纠缠；光子数可探测相变序参量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了电子相仅由腔模增强真空涨落耦合所稳定的罕见实例，并给出可实验探测的电子相变与紧凑核心态信号。

title: A self-compliant selector-free memory with functional bismuth ferrite
summary: In-memory computing requires selector-free operation, low variability, and stable multilevel switching, all of which remain challenging to achieve in a single system. Here, we demonstrate a robust selector-free memory based on a multiferroic BiFeO3 that combines self-compliance with stable bipolar switching, high yield, long endurance, and extended retention. We observe that BiFeO3 memristive crossbar arrays become self-compliant through a naturally formed TiOx interfacial layer, enabling forming-free bipolar switching without external selector devices, addressing major bottlenecks that have limited the practical deployment of resistive memories. The array delivers stable bipolar switching with a 97% device yield, endurance beyond 105 cycles, and data retention exceeding 105 s with low cycle-to-cycle and device-to-device variability. In addition, the devices exhibit 16 well-separated conductance states, enabling 4-bit multilevel operation via precise pulse-controlled programming for digit visualization in edge applications. Noise measurements reveal predominantly 1/f-type behavior with minimal random telegraph noise, indicating robust conductance stability across the programmable window. These results establish BiFeO3 as a practical materials platform for multibit, selector-free crossbar memories offering high reliability, making it well-suited for scalable computing architectures based on functional materials.

AI.tldr: 该论文展示基于多铁BiFeO3的无选择器阻变存储器，通过自然形成的TiOx界面层实现自限流、无forming的双极开关，具备97%良率、长耐久与保持特性及16个电导态（4-bit）多值存储能力。
AI.motivation: 内存计算要求无选择器操作、低变异性与稳定多值开关，但单一体系难以同时满足，限制了阻变存储器的实际部署。
AI.method: 构建多铁BiFeO3忆阻交叉阵列，利用自然形成的TiOx界面层实现自限流；通过脉冲控制编程，并进行噪声（1/f与随机电报噪声）测量。
AI.result: 实现无forming双极开关，97%器件良率，耐久超10^5次循环，保持时间超10^5秒，循环与器件间变异性低；获得16个分离电导态，实现4-bit多值操作并用于边缘端数字可视化；噪声以1/f为主，随机电报噪声极小。
AI.conclusion: BiFeO3可作为高可靠多比特、无选择器交叉阵列存储的实用材料平台，适用于基于功能材料的可扩展计算架构。

title: Heisenberg-like critical behavior in the quasi-two-dimensional metallic ferromagnet LaCrSb3
summary: LaCrSb3 is a material exhibiting both quasi-two-dimensional spin fluctuations and three-dimensional magnetic interaction characteristics. By measuring the isothermal magnetization of single-crystals and conducting a systematic critical behavior analysis, we clarify the critical properties of its ferromagnetic phase transition and the intrinsic magnetic interaction mechanism. Based on high-precision isothermal magnetization data measured in the vicinity of the critical point, the Curie temperature for the ferromagnetic-paramagnetic phase transition is determined to be TC = 126 K, with the critical exponents obtained as $β$ = 0.376, $γ$ = 1.417 and $δ$ = 4.76 via the self-consistent iterative method based on the Arrott-Noakes equation. The reliability of these critical exponents is verified by the Widom scaling law, the magnetic state scaling equation and other analyses. A comparison with theoretical models demonstrates that the critical behavior of the magnetic phase transition in this system basically belongs to the universality class of the three-dimensional Heisenberg model. This conclusion is further confirmed by the distance-dependent decay behavior of the exchange interaction J(r), revealing the dominant role of isotropic direct exchange interactions in this system. Finally, drawing on research findings of other quasi-two-dimensional magnetic materials, this work proposes that LaCrSb3 may exhibit finite-temperature magnetic order in the two-dimensional limit, thereby possessing important theoretical research significance and promising practical application prospects.

AI.tldr: 通过单晶等温磁化测量与临界行为分析，确定LaCrSb3铁磁相变的临界指数并揭示其磁性相互作用机制，归属为三维Heisenberg普适类。
AI.motivation: LaCrSb3同时表现出准二维自旋涨落与三维磁相互作用特征，其铁磁相变的临界性质与内在磁相互作用机制尚不明确，需要系统研究以理解其磁性本质。
AI.method: 测量单晶等温磁化数据，基于Arrott-Noakes方程进行自洽迭代确定临界指数，并用Widom标度律、磁态标度方程验证，同时分析交换相互作用J(r)的距离衰减行为。
AI.result: 居里温度TC=126 K，临界指数β=0.376、γ=1.417、δ=4.76；标度律与标度方程验证其可靠性；结果基本归属于三维Heisenberg模型普适类，J(r)衰减行为证实各向同性直接交换作用主导。
AI.conclusion: LaCrSb3的磁相变临界行为符合三维Heisenberg普适类，各向同性直接交换作用占主导；据此推测其在二维极限下可能呈现有限温度磁有序，具重要理论意义与应用前景。

title: Towards a Metal-Organic Framework with Pore-Confined Electrons
summary: Electrides are an unconventional class of materials in which electrons are localized in crystallographic void spaces rather than solely around atomic nuclei, giving rise to appealing properties such as low work functions, strong electron-donating character, and even superconductivity. Here, we use ab initio methods to investigate metal-organic framework (MOF) electrides, a new class of materials that combines the interstitial electrons of electrides with the permanent porosity and chemical tunability of MOFs. These materials host pore-confined electrons: occupied electronic states localized in the pore space and with bands slightly below or crossing through the Fermi level. Using density functional theory calculations, we establish several design rules for stabilizing pore-confined electrons in MOFs via an anion-electron exchange process and identify candidate MOF electrides. As a proof-of-concept, we also demonstrate that the pore-confined electrons can directly facilitate chemical reactions, substantially lowering the activation barrier for H2 dissociation without requiring adsorption at a surface site. We envision that pore-confined electrons in nanoporous materials may enable a fundamentally new type of catalysis in which chemical reactions take place in the pore space, driven by electron-centered active sites.

AI.tldr: 利用从头算方法研究MOF电子化物，建立孔道受限电子的稳定设计规则，并证明其可催化H2解离。
AI.motivation: 电子化物具有低功函数、强给电子性乃至超导性等特性，而MOF具备永久孔隙率和化学可调性。将两者结合，有望在纳米孔道中实现孔道受限电子，并催生全新的孔道内催化模式。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论等从头算方法，研究MOF电子化物中局域于孔道的电子态；通过阴离子-电子交换过程，建立稳定孔道受限电子的设计规则，并筛选候选材料。
AI.result: 确立了若干稳定MOF中孔道受限电子的设计规则，识别出候选MOF电子化物；概念验证表明孔道受限电子可直接促进化学反应，显著降低H2解离活化能，且无需在表面位点吸附。
AI.conclusion: 纳米多孔材料中的孔道受限电子可实现一类由电子中心活性位点驱动、反应发生在孔道空间内的全新催化方式。

title: Effects of residual exchange coupling on simultaneously driven spin qubits
summary: Exchange coupling and microwave drives are widely used control mechanisms for spin qubits. However, the influence of exchange coupling on microwave-driven spin dynamics is not fully understood. We report simultaneous drive measurements of two spin qubits as a function of exchange coupling and drive power. When the Rabi frequency exceeds exchange, we observe a beating pattern in the Rabi oscillations. In the opposite limit, two exchange-split patterns emerge in the Rabi chevrons. We find that these exchange-induced effects are suppressed when the difference in the Rabi frequencies exceeds the exchange coupling. A theoretical model is developed that reproduces the main features in our data.

AI.tldr: 研究了交换耦合对微波驱动自旋动力学的影响，发现Rabi频率与交换耦合的相对大小决定不同的Rabi振荡模式。
AI.motivation: 交换耦合和微波驱动是自旋量子比特常用控制手段，但交换耦合如何影响微波驱动的自旋动力学尚不完全清楚。
AI.method: 对两个自旋量子比特进行同步驱动测量，扫描交换耦合和驱动功率，并建立理论模型解释数据。
AI.result: Rabi频率超过交换耦合时，Rabi振荡出现拍频；反之，Rabi chevrons中出现两个交换劈裂图样。当两Rabi频率差超过交换耦合时，这些交换诱导效应被抑制。
AI.conclusion: 理论模型再现了主要实验特征，揭示了交换耦合与微波驱动共同作用下的自旋量子比特动力学规律。

title: Fractional vortices in a spin-isotropic spiral spin liquid
summary: Spiral spin liquids are magnetic states whose classical ground-state manifold consists of planar incommensurate spin spirals with wave vectors lying on a continuous ring or surface in reciprocal space. The resulting subextensive degeneracy suppresses magnetic long-range order and gives rise to liquid-like behavior. Despite numerous material realizations and theoretical investigations, the structure of low-temperature spin configurations of spin-isotropic Heisenberg spiral spin liquids has remained poorly understood. Here, we classify and characterize the classical topological defects supported by these systems. We uncover a rich family of vortex types involving concerted windings of spin directions, spiral-plane normals, and wave-vector orientations, yielding a $\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}_2$ classification. Remarkably, the elementary defects are half-vortices carrying fractional $2π$ windings in both spin and momentum space and obey fusion rules resembling to those of Ising anyons. Large-scale classical simulations of a square-lattice spiral spin liquid reveal that these vortices are dense in the spiral-spin-liquid regime, and bind tightly below an order-by-disorder phase transition, eventually fusing to vacuum.

AI.tldr: 本文对自旋各向同性海森堡螺旋自旋液体中的经典拓扑缺陷进行分类与表征，揭示出由自旋方向、螺旋面法向与波矢取向协同绕转构成的丰富涡旋家族，给出 Z×Z₂ 分类，并发现其基本缺陷是同时携带自旋与动量空间分数 2π 绕转的半涡旋。
AI.motivation: 螺旋自旋液体的基态流形由波矢位于倒空间连续环/面上的面内非公度自旋螺旋构成，这种亚广延简并抑制长程磁序并产生类液体行为。尽管已有大量材料实现与理论研究，自旋各向同性海森堡螺旋自旋液体低温自旋构型的结构仍理解不足，尤其是其支持的拓扑缺陷类型尚不清楚。
AI.method: 通过经典拓扑缺陷的分类与表征方法，对自旋各向同性海森堡螺旋自旋液体中的缺陷进行系统分类；结合方格子螺旋自旋液体模型的大规模经典模拟，研究缺陷在螺旋自旋液体区及相变附近的行为。
AI.result: 发现了一类丰富的涡旋类型，涉及自旋方向、螺旋面法向和波矢取向的协同绕转，得到 Z×Z₂ 分类。基本缺陷为半涡旋，在自旋空间和动量空间均携带分数 2π 绕转，其融合规则类似 Ising 任意子。方格子模型模拟表明这些涡旋在螺旋自旋液体区密集存在，并在序中序相变以下紧密束缚，最终融合为真空。
AI.conclusion: 螺旋自旋液体支持的拓扑缺陷具有非平凡分类结构，其基本半涡旋展现类似 Ising 任意子的融合规则；数值模拟证实这些涡旋在螺旋自旋液体区普遍存在并在序中序相变下发生束缚与融合，为理解该类磁体的低温物理提供新视角。

title: Observation of complex orbital order in MnV2O4
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, supplementary text with 7 supplementary figures and 7 supplementary tables
summary: Orbital ordering in vanadium spinel oxides with a geometrically frustrated pyrochlore structure has been a subject of controversy, owing to competing theoretical models and the absence of direct experimental evidence. Here we combine high-precision single-crystal synchrotron x-ray diffraction with core differential fourier synthesis to visualize the valence electron density (VED) of the orbital-ordered ground state in real space. By carefully investigating multiple-scattering artifacts, we identify the low-temperature structure as belonging to the I41/amd space group. The reconstructed VED around the V sites reveals an orbital-ordered state distinct from both previously proposed real- and complex-orbital models. Our results resolve the long-standing controversy in MnV2O4 and establish a route to identifying orbital states in frustrated spin-orbital systems.

AI.tldr: 本文结合高精度单晶同步辐射X射线衍射与核心差分Fourier合成，直接可视化MnV2O4中有序基态的价电子密度，确认低温结构为I41/amd空间群，并发现了一种不同于以往实轨道和复轨道模型的新型轨道有序态。
AI.motivation: 钒尖晶石氧化物中，几何阻挫烧绿石结构下的轨道有序长期存在争议，主要由于理论模型相互竞争且缺乏直接实验证据。
AI.method: 结合高精度单晶同步辐射X射线衍射与核心差分Fourier合成技术，在实空间中可视化轨道有序基态的价电子密度，并仔细处理多重散射伪影。
AI.result: 识别出低温结构属于I41/amd空间群；重建的V位点周围价电子密度揭示的轨道有序态既不同于此前提出的实轨道模型，也不同于复轨道模型。
AI.conclusion: 研究解决了MnV2O4中长期存在的争议，并为识别阻挫自旋-轨道体系中的轨道态建立了新途径。

title: Sodium Incorporation in CsPbBr$_{3-x}$I$_x$ Nanocrystal Electrodes: Lattice Contraction and the Suppression of Field-Driven Iodine Expulsion
summary: Mixed-halide perovskite nanocrystal electrodes fail in supercapacitors through field-driven halide segregation. In undoped $\mathrm{CsPbBr_2I}$, this appears as a capacitance that climbs to 218% of its first-cycle value by cycle 1378 and then collapses to 39% by cycle 2500, with complete loss of the iodine signal from the cycled electrode. This work tests whether sodium incorporation suppresses that failure mode. Na-doped $\mathrm{CsPbBr_{3-x}I_x}$ ($x = 0, 1, 2$) nanocrystals were prepared by ligand-assisted reprecipitation at a Na/Pb precursor ratio of 1.25:1.00 and compared with undoped analogues in 0.1 M tetrabutylammonium tetrafluoroborate in anhydrous dichloromethane. Sodium contracts the pseudocubic lattice parameter of $\mathrm{CsPbBr_3}$ from $5.908 \pm 0.029$ to $5.851 \pm 0.019$ $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ after correction for specimen displacement. Specific capacitance at 0.3 A g$^{-1}$ rises for every composition, from 42 to 75, from 63 to 96, and from 56 to 84.5 F g$^{-1}$. Na-$\mathrm{CsPbBr_2I}$ gives the lowest charge-transfer resistance at 175 $Ω$ and the highest ion diffusion coefficient at $1.6 \times 10^{-16}$ m$^2$ s$^{-1}$, and power-law exponents between 0.33 and 0.45 at all potentials examined show that charge storage is limited by ion transport through the pore network rather than by the interfacial process. In the sodium-containing (Na-$\mathrm{CsPbBr_2I}$) electrode, the capacitance rise reaches only 115% at cycle 600, no collapse follows, and 97% is retained at 2500 cycles, the excess above the first-cycle value being reduced by a factor of 7.9. Iodine is retained at unchanged binding energy, and the Br:I ratio measured by elemental mapping is 2.30 after cycling against 2.25 before.

AI.tldr: 钠掺杂可抑制混合卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶电极在超级电容器中的场致卤化物偏析，显著提升循环稳定性。
AI.motivation: 未掺杂混合卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶电极因场致卤化物偏析而失效：电容先异常爬升后崩溃，碘信号完全丢失。本研究检验钠掺入能否抑制该失效模式。
AI.method: 用配体辅助再沉淀法在Na/Pb前驱体比1.25:1.00下制备Na掺杂CsPbBr3-xIx(x=0,1,2)纳米晶，与未掺杂对照在0.1 M四丁基四氟硼酸铵/无水二氯甲烷中对比测试；通过晶格参数、比电容、电荷转移电阻、离子扩散系数、幂律指数及循环后元素映射表征。
AI.result: Na使CsPbBr3赝立方晶格参数从5.908±0.029收缩至5.851±0.019 Å。0.3 A/g比电容各组分均升高（42→75、63→96、56→84.5 F/g）。Na-CsPbBr2I电荷转移电阻最低(175 Ω)，离子扩散系数最高(1.6×10^-16 m²/s)，幂律指数0.33–0.45表明受孔网离子输运限制。Na-CsPbBr2I电容爬升仅至115%(600圈)，不再崩溃，2500圈保持97%，超首圈部分降低7.9倍；碘结合能不变，循环后Br:I为2.30(前2.25)。
AI.conclusion: 钠掺杂有效抑制场致卤化物偏析，保持卤化物组成与碘信号，使钙钛矿纳米晶超级电容器电极获得稳定的长循环电容性能。

title: Scalable construction of force-constant basis sets for large-scale anharmonic lattice-dynamical calculations
summary: A projector-based formulation of force constants in crystalline materials provides a systematic framework for constructing force-constant bases and determining force constants from force--displacement datasets while rigorously satisfying crystal symmetry, permutation symmetry, and translational invariance. In this work, we develop an efficient eigenvalue solver for projection matrices and integrate it into the projector-based framework. The proposed method substantially reduces the computational cost and enables practical calculations for large-scale systems, low-symmetry crystals, and higher-order force constants that are difficult to treat using conventional approaches. Applications to self-consistent phonon calculations for assessing the grain-boundary excess free energy, lattice thermal conductivity calculations in complex compounds, and fourth-order force-constant estimations demonstrate the efficiency and robustness of the proposed framework for large and complex materials systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出高效特征值求解器并集成到基于投影算子的力常数框架中，降低计算成本，使大体系、低对称晶体和高阶力常数的计算成为可能。
AI.motivation: 传统力常数方法难以处理大尺度体系、低对称晶体及高阶力常数，计算成本高，因此需要更高效的求解方案。
AI.method: 开发投影矩阵的高效特征值求解器，并集成进基于投影算子的力常数框架，该框架严格满足晶体对称性、置换对称性与平移不变性。
AI.result: 应用于晶界过剩自由能的自洽声子计算、复杂化合物晶格热导率计算及四阶力常数估计，展示了框架的效率和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法显著降低成本，适用于大型复杂材料体系，为高阶力常数计算提供实用工具。

title: Spatiotemporal programming via asymmetric dielectric engineering for nonvolatile 2D optoelectronics
summary: Ambipolar two dimensional (2D) semiconductors integrated with floating-gate architectures offer a promising platform for nonvolatile, reconfigurable electronics. However, the switching between p-n and n-p junction polarities has conventionally required complex multi-gate designs, hindering the scalability and integration density. Here, we demonstrate a spatiotemporal programming strategy using a dual-floating-gate architecture with a symmetry broken tunneling dielectric. An asymmetric dielectric stack creates distinct tunneling thresholds for two floating gates, enabling a single input gate to encode spatial doping profiles in the 2D channel via defined voltage pulse sequences. We achieve on demand, nonvolatile, and reversible switching between p-n and n-p configurations with excellent retention and endurance. The reconfigurable homojunction serves as a multifunctional platform for logic encoding, rectification, photodetection, and in sensor computing. This work establishes a design paradigm that replaces spatial input complexity with spatiotemporal programming, paving the way for high-density, multifunctional intelligent hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双浮栅架构配合非对称隧穿介电层，通过时空编程策略实现二维半导体p-n与n-p结极性的非易失可逆切换，用于多功能智能硬件。
AI.motivation: 传统双极性2D半导体浮栅器件在p-n与n-p极性切换上依赖复杂的多栅极设计，限制了器件的可扩展性与集成密度。
AI.method: 采用双浮栅架构配合对称性破缺（非对称）隧穿介电层。非对称介电堆叠为两个浮栅提供不同的隧穿阈值，使单一输入栅可通过设定的电压脉冲序列，在2D沟道中编码空间掺杂分布。
AI.result: 实现了按需、非易失、可逆的p-n与n-p构型切换，具有优异的保持性与耐久性。该可重构同质结可作为逻辑编码、整流、光电探测及传感计算的多功能平台。
AI.conclusion: 本工作以时空编程替代空间输入复杂度，建立了新的设计范式，为高密度、多功能智能硬件铺平道路。

title: Non-Abelian chiral spin liquid in a spin-$1$ antiferromagnet on the square lattice
summary: Non-Abelian chiral spin liquids (CSLs) host non-Abelian anyon excitations and are promising platforms for topological quantum computation. However, realizing non-Abelian CSLs in short-range interacting spin systems remains elusive. Here, we study a spin-$1$ square-lattice model with the first- and second-neighbor bilinear ($J_1,J_2$) and biquadratic interactions ($K_1,K_2$), as well as the three-spin scalar chiral coupling $J_χ$. Inspired by the evidence of the Moore-Read state in exact diagonalization and infinite Projected Entangled Pair States calculations, we fix $J_1=1.0$, $J_2/J_1=0.623$, $K_1/J_1=-0.176$, and obtain a quantum phase diagram for $0 \leq K_2/J_1 \leq 0.4$ and $0.3 \leq J_χ/J_1 \leq 0.6$ by using the density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations. We identify a stripe antiferromagnetic phase, a Néel antiferromagnetic phase, a magnetically ordered chiral spin state phase, and a non-Abelian CSL phase emerging near the boundaries of the ordered phases. The unbiased DMRG results provide strong evidence for the Moore-Read state, including the three topological sectors, the quantized spin Chern number $C=1$, and the level counting of low-lying entanglement spectra which is consistent with the chiral SU(2)$_2$ conformal field theory. Our results may shed new light on searching for non-Abelian CSLs in other higher-spin ($S > 1/2$) systems with short-range couplings.

AI.tldr: 该文通过DMRG研究自旋-1方格子模型，给出了包含非阿贝尔手性自旋液体(CSL)的量子相图，并为Moore-Read态提供了有力证据。
AI.motivation: 非阿贝尔CSL具有非阿贝尔任意子激发，是拓扑量子计算的理想平台，但在短程相互作用自旋系统中实现仍很困难。
AI.method: 研究包含第一、第二近邻双线性(J1,J2)、双二次(K1,K2)及三自旋标量手性耦合Jχ的自旋-1方格子模型；受精确对角化和iPEPS中Moore-Read态证据启发，固定J1=1.0、J2/J1=0.623、K1/J1=-0.176，用DMRG计算0≤K2/J1≤0.4、0.3≤Jχ/J1≤0.6的相图。
AI.result: 识别出条纹反铁磁相、Néel反铁磁相、磁性有序手性自旋态相，以及在有序相边界附近出现的非阿贝尔CSL相。无偏DMRG结果给出Moore-Read态的有力证据：三个拓扑扇区、量子化自旋陈数C=1、与手性SU(2)2共形场论一致的低能纠缠谱能级计数。
AI.conclusion: 结果为在其他高阶自旋(S>1/2)短程耦合系统中寻找非阿贝尔CSL提供了新思路。

title: Large spin splitting metallic altermagnets from machine-learned design rules
summary: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with momentum-dependent spin splitting, providing spin-polarized electronic states without a net magnetization. Metallic $d$-wave altermagnets are particularly promising because they can support time-reversal-odd spin currents in linear response, yet experimentally validated bulk realizations remain scarce. Here, we use high-throughput density-functional-theory data to relate the magnitude of altermagnetic band splitting to compositional, structural, and DFT-derived magnetic descriptors. An interpretable gradient-boosted model identifies two candidate-prioritization criteria: compact unit cells and magnetic sublattices that sustain sizable local moments. Guided by these trends, we screen tetragonal $A_2XY$ Heusler compounds in space group $P4/mmm$. Among 307 structures, symmetry identifies 169 altermagnetic arrangements, of which 157 remain metallic altermagnets in DFT. Sixteen realize an altermagnetic collinear ground state, of which 15 are dynamically and mechanically stable and 10 also lie on or below the calculated thermodynamic hull. Six candidates exceed the CrSb splitting obtained under the same computational protocol, led by Co$_2$AlSc ($Δ_\mathrm{max}=2.24$~eV) and Fe$_2$AlGe ($2.07$~eV). A Julliere-model estimate gives a tunneling magnetoresistance of up to $203\%$ at the Fermi level for Co$_2$AlSc. These results identify a chemically tunable family of metallic $d$-wave altermagnets and demonstrate how interpretable machine learning can guide targeted first-principles searches.

AI.tldr: 利用高通量DFT数据与可解释机器学习，识别金属d波交错磁体的描述符并筛选四方A₂XY Heusler化合物，得到Co₂AlSc等候选材料。
AI.motivation: 金属d波交错磁体可在线性响应下产生时间反演奇自旋流，但实验验证的体相材料稀缺，需要高效搜索策略。
AI.method: 用高通量DFT数据关联交错磁能带劈裂与成分、结构及磁性描述符；训练可解释梯度提升模型提取筛选准则；据此筛查空间群P4/mmm的四方A₂XY Heusler化合物。
AI.result: 307个结构中169个为交错磁排布，157个保持金属性；16个实现共线交错磁基态，15个动力学与力学稳定，10个位于或低于热力学凸包；6个候选劈裂超过CrSb，Co₂AlSc（2.24 eV）和Fe₂AlGe（2.07 eV）领先，Co₂AlSc估计TMR达203%。
AI.conclusion: 确立了一类化学可调的金属d波交错磁体家族，并展示了可解释机器学习引导第一性原理定向搜索的有效性。

title: Induced superconductivity in selective-area grown SnTe devices
summary: Topological superconductors are of high interest for applications in topological quantum computation. The required topologically superconducting state can be engineered by proximityinducing superconductivity in a topological insulator. Here, we explore the induced superconductivity in selective-area grown nanowires of the topological crystalline insulator SnTe on a InP substrate, through TEM/EDX and low-temperature electronic transport studies. The observed superconducting behavior likely originates from indium in the substrate diffusing upwards into the SnTe nanowire, forming a thin layer of InxSn1-xTe at the interface between the nanowire and the substrate. InxSn1-xTe is intrinsically superconducting for indium concentrations above 2%, resulting in superconductivity within the heterostructure. Little-Parks oscillations are observed in loop-shaped nanowire networks in an out-of-plane magnetic field. The half-period shift indicative of a topological superconducting state is absent, which is explained by dominant trivial transport channels obscuring any topological signatures.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了在InP衬底上选区生长拓扑晶体绝缘体SnTe纳米线的诱导超导性，发现超导源自In扩散形成的InxSn1-xTe界面层，并在环形网络中观测到Little-Parks振荡，但未出现拓扑超导的半周期位移特征。
AI.motivation: 拓扑超导态对拓扑量子计算至关重要，可通过在拓扑绝缘体中近邻诱导超导来实现，因此探索拓扑晶体绝缘体SnTe纳米线中的诱导超导行为具有重要价值。
AI.method: 通过TEM/EDX表征和低温电子输运测量，研究在InP衬底上选区生长的SnTe纳米线；并在环形纳米线网络中施加面外磁场以观测Little-Parks振荡。
AI.result: 超导行为很可能源于InP衬底中的In向上扩散进入SnTe纳米线，在界面处形成InxSn1-xTe薄层（In浓度>2%时本征超导）；在环形网络中观测到Little-Parks振荡，但未观察到指示拓扑超导态的半周期位移。
AI.conclusion: 缺失半周期位移可由主导的平庸输运通道掩盖了拓扑特征来解释，说明该体系中拓扑超导信号尚被平庸通道遮蔽。

title: Band-Saddle-Point Engineering in Mixed $A$-site $A$V$_3$Sb$_5$ Kagome Metals
summary: $A$V$_3$Sb$_5$ compounds ($A$ = K, Rb, Cs) offer an experimental platform for probing the physics of kagome metals near ideal Van Hove filling. Here, we use optical spectroscopy on $A$V$_3$Sb$_5$ with mixed $A$-site compositions to reveal the effect of the alkali metal on the low-energy electronic structure. Supported by density-functional-theory calculations, we identify a band-saddle-point inversion as a chemical consequence of Cs substitution, revealing that $A$-site composition controls the orbital character of Van Hove singularities, Fermi surface topology, and electron-phonon interactions while leaving the kagome layer intact.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过光学光谱研究混合A位组分的AV₃Sb₅（A=K, Rb, Cs），揭示了碱金属元素对低能电子结构的影响。
AI.motivation: AV₃Sb₅化合物为研究近理想Van Hove填充附近的kagome金属物理提供了实验平台，需要探究碱金属元素如何影响其低能电子结构。
AI.method: 对具有混合A位组分的AV₃Sb₅进行光学光谱测量，并结合密度泛函理论计算进行分析。
AI.result: 识别出能带鞍点反转是Cs取代的化学结果。
AI.conclusion: A位组分控制了Van Hove奇点的轨道特性、费米面拓扑结构和电子-声子相互作用，同时保持kagome层完整。

title: Exchange-Driven Chiral Magnons and Weyl States in Room-Temperature Metallic XCoB$_2$ (X= Ta, Zr and Hf) Altermagnets
summary: Metallic altermagnets remain rare, particularly in low-symmetry three-dimensional crystals where spin-split electronic bands and chiral magnon excitations can coexist. We report a family of metallic $d_{yz}$-wave altermagnets in the orthorhombic ternary borides XCoB$_2$ (X = Ta, Zr, Hf), which crystallize in the centrosymmetric $Pnma$ structure with G-type collinear magnetic order. Symmetry analysis within the magnetic space group $Pnm'a'$ (BNS No.~62.447) predicts a nonrelativistic spin splitting proportional to $k_yk_z$, with symmetry-enforced degeneracy on the $k_y$ and $k_z$ nodal planes, consistent with first-principles calculations. On the $k_x=0$ plane, the momentum-averaged spin splitting reaches 88.4, 52.3, and 70.6~meV at the Fermi level in TaCoB$_2$, ZrCoB$_2$, and HfCoB$_2$, respectively, with maxima exceeding 200~meV in all three compounds. Exchange analysis shows that the altermagnetic magnon splitting originates from symmetry-inequivalent sixth-neighbour inter-sublattice interactions. The chirality splitting reaches 1.51, 2.03, and 3.10 meV below 50 meV in TaCoB$_2$, ZrCoB$_2$, and HfCoB$_2$, respectively, making it accessible to inelastic neutron scattering. Monte Carlo simulations yield N'eel temperatures of $67\pm1.1$, $330\pm5.7$, and $307\pm5.0$~K, placing ZrCoB$_2$ and HfCoB$*2$ above room temperature. With spin-orbit coupling included, all three compounds host symmetry-protected Weyl points near the Fermi level, Fermi-arc surface states and sizable intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivities $σ*{zx}$ of $+342$, $-392$, and $-221$~S/cm at the Fermi level, reaching maximum magnitudes of $763$, $942$, and $924$~S/cm for TaCoB$_2$, ZrCoB$_2$, and HfCoB$_2$, respectively. $X$CoB$_2$ therefore provides a single compensated platform carrying both magnonic and electronic chirality, one in the spin waves and the other in the Berry curvature, without any stray field.

AI.tldr: 报道了正交三元硼化物XCoB₂(X=Ta,Zr,Hf)这一金属d_yz波交错磁体家族，兼具自旋劈裂能带、手性磁振子及拓扑电子态，为无杂散场下的磁子与电子手性共存平台。
AI.motivation: 金属性交错磁体稀少，尤其在低对称三维晶体中，自旋劈裂能带与手性磁振子激发难以共存，亟需寻找新材料平台。
AI.method: 结合磁空间群对称性分析(Pnm'a')、第一性原理计算、交换分析、蒙特卡罗模拟及考虑自旋轨道耦合的拓扑与输运计算。
AI.result: 自旋劈裂正比于k_yk_z，k_x=0面费米能处动量平均劈裂达88.4/52.3/70.6 meV；手性磁振子劈裂达1.51/2.03/3.10 meV；奈尔温度67/330/307 K(Zr、Hf高于室温)；存在Weyl点、费米弧表面态及本征反常霍尔电导率(最大763/942/924 S/cm)。
AI.conclusion: XCoB₂是单一补偿的金属交错磁体平台，在没有杂散场情况下同时承载磁振子与电子两类手性，具有潜在自旋电子学应用价值。

title: Up/down-conversion of infrared light by few-layer graphene polytypes
summary: Optical nonlinearity of materials with broken inversion symmetry enables two-photon processes where an incoming pair of photons can generate an up-converted photon with the combined frequency, or a high-energy photon can be split into a correlated pair of down-converted photons. Here, we identify few-layer graphene films that offer up/down-conversion capability in the infrared spectral range. For mixed stacking tetralayers (ABCB), which are non-centrosymmetric 2D crystals, we find highly efficient nearly resonant up/down-conversion of [$ω_1,ω_2$] photon pairs into/from a photon with $0.7$eV$<Ω=ω_1+ω_2<1.1$eV. We also note that a pronounced second-order nonlinearity in the spectral range of $0.7$eV$<Ω<0.9$eV can be promoted in rhombohedral tri- and tetralayers by asymmetrical encapsulation. Potentially, for fibers coated with few-layer graphene, this opens the door for ``in fiber" production of photon pairs with correlated polarizations.

AI.tldr: 少层石墨烯（特别是非中心对称的ABCB四层）在红外波段可实现高效近共振的上/下频率转换，为光纤内光子对产生提供可能。
AI.motivation: 寻找在红外波段具备上/下转换能力的材料，以利用破缺反演对称性实现双光子过程（和频产生与参量下转换）。
AI.method: 识别并研究少层石墨烯薄膜，重点关注混合堆垛ABCB四层（非中心对称2D晶体）以及经非对称封装的菱面体三层和四层结构。
AI.result: ABCB四层对[ω1,ω2]光子对在0.7eV<Ω<1.1eV范围内实现高效近共振上/下转换；非对称封装的菱面体三/四层在0.7eV<Ω<0.9eV范围内表现出显著二阶非线性。
AI.conclusion: 少层石墨烯涂层光纤有望实现具有相关偏振的光子对的“光纤内”产生。

title: Twinning of domains and spin anisotropy in K$_5$Fe$_4$Ag$_6$Te$_{10}$
summary: The Fe-based superconductors are derived from metallic parent compounds with nematic and stripe magnetic orders, which lead to two types of magnetic domains. Recently it was found that K$_5$Fe$_4$Ag$_6$Te$_{10}$ (KFAT), an Fe-based semiconductor, exhibits similar nematic and stripe magnetic orders, and is thus an analogue to the Fe-based superconductors in the limit of localized electrons. In this work, the superstructure and magnetic domains of KFAT are elucidated by fully mapping the reciprocal space using time-of-flight single crystal neutron diffraction. In KFAT, Fe and Ag atoms order to form a $\sqrt{5}\times\sqrt{5}$ superstructure containing $2\times2$ Fe blocks, which leads to two superstructure domains with identical main Bragg peaks but distinct superstructure peaks. Below $T_{\rm N}\approx35$~K, magnetic and nematic orders break in-plane rotational symmetry of the tetragonal $\sqrt{5}\times\sqrt{5}$ superstructure, and further give rise to two magnetic domains. These four equally populated domains account for the complex scattering pattern observed in our time-of-flight elastic neutron scattering measurements. Using polarized neutron scattering, we demonstrate a prominent spin anisotropy with an easy-plane spanned by the $c$-axis and the intra-block antiferromagnetic Fe-Fe bond direction. Such an anisotropy at ${\bf q}\neq0$ persists well above $T_{\rm N}$, accounts for the in-plane ${\bf q}=0$ magnetic anisotropy observed in uniaxial-strained KFAT, and offers an indicator for discovering similar piezomagnetic effects in other materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用飞行时间单晶中子衍射全面映射K₅Fe₄Ag₆Te₁₀(KFAT)的倒空间，阐明了其√5×√5超结构及由磁性和向列序产生的四类畴，并发现显著的易平面自旋各向异性。
AI.motivation: KFAT作为Fe基半导体，是Fe基超导体在局域电子极限下的类似物，其超结构与磁畴结构此前不明确，理解它有助于揭示Fe基超导体中向列序与条纹磁序的本质。
AI.method: 采用飞行时间单晶中子衍射全面映射倒空间，结合弹性中子散射和极化中子散射研究KFAT的超结构畴、磁畴及自旋各向异性。
AI.result: Fe与Ag原子有序形成含2×2 Fe块的√5×√5超结构，产生两个超结构畴；在T_N≈35 K以下磁性与向列序打破面内旋转对称性，进一步产生两个磁畴，四类畴等量分布解释了复杂散射图样；极化中子散射显示易平面由c轴与块内反铁磁Fe-Fe键方向张成，该q≠0各向异性在远超T_N时仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 该q≠0自旋各向异性解释了单轴应变KFAT中的面内q=0磁各向异性，并为在其他材料中寻找类似压磁效应提供了指标。

title: Spinodals and Domain Instabilities in Ionically-compensated Ferroelectric Films
summary: A ferroelectric surface in contact with an ionic or molecular reservoir is intrinsically a ferroionic state in which polarization and compensating surface charge are thermodynamically coupled. Surface chemical compensation is known to control the magnitude and sign of ferroelectric polarization, yet the competing instability toward domain formation has usually been treated separately. Here we develop a static theory in which polarization, electrochemical surface charge, and finite-wave-vector domain formation are analyzed within a single thermodynamic framework for uniaxial polarization orientation. The central quantity is the differential chemical capacitance, which determines how strongly the surface charge can respond to a spatial modulation of polarization and therefore differs fundamentally from the equilibrium screening charge. We derive the homogeneous equation of state, the finite-wave-vector stability kernel, analytical domain-onset wavelengths and thickness scalings, and weakly nonlinear stripe and checkerboard solutions for both second- and first-order ferroelectrics. For a first-order transition, a finite-amplitude stripe state can become thermodynamically favorable before the homogeneous linear spinodal when the effective quartic coefficient is negative; this pre-spinodal window closes as the biased background polarization increases. Dense numerical phase maps confirm the analytical structure and show how chemical potential and film thickness reorganize weakly polar, monodomain, and polydomain states. Numerical analysis for BaTiO3 realization illustrates the corresponding temperature, oxygen-pressure, and thickness scales and identifies experimentally testable regimes in which chemical screening stabilizes the homogeneous state against the columnar 180° instability considered here or domain formation becomes the preferred route for depolarization-energy reduction.

AI.tldr: 本文建立统一热力学理论，将铁电极化、电化学表面电荷与有限波矢畴形成耦合分析，引入微分化学电容作为关键量，揭示化学屏蔽与畴不稳定性竞争。
AI.motivation: 铁电表面与离子/分子储库接触时形成"铁离子态"，极化与补偿表面电荷热力学耦合。表面化学补偿已知可控制极化大小和符号，但畴形成的不稳定性通常被单独处理，缺乏统一框架。
AI.method: 对单轴极化取向建立静态理论，将极化、电化学表面电荷及有限波矢畴形成纳入单一热力学框架；以微分化学电容为核心量，推导均匀态方程、有限波矢稳定性核、解析畴起始波长与厚度标度、弱非线性条纹与棋盘解，涵盖二级和一级铁电体；并进行稠密数值相图和BaTiO3实例分析。
AI.result: 对一级相变，当有效四次系数为负时，有限振幅条纹态可在均匀线性spinodal之前热力学占优，该spinodal前沿窗口随偏置背景极化增大而关闭。数值相图证实解析结构，显示化学势与膜厚重构弱极性、单畴和多畴态；BaTiO3分析给出温度、氧压和厚度标度，识别可实验检验的区间。
AI.conclusion: 微分化学电容从根本上区别于平衡屏蔽电荷，决定表面电荷对极化空间调制的响应强度。化学屏蔽可稳定均匀态对抗柱状180°不稳定性，或使畴形成成为降低退极化能的首选路径，为实验提供可检验预测。

title: Effect of Near-surface Thermal Spikes on Radiation Hardness of Gallium Oxide
summary: Gallium oxide (Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$) stands out as an extraordinary high radiation-tolerant semiconductor, because its lattice displacements induce polymorph transitions, holding material crystalline instead of leading to amorphization. Meanwhile, under extremely severe irradiation conditions many crystals become amorphous, often starting from surfaces where the translation symmetry breaks. Here, we show that the surface amorphization may prevail over the crystallisation in Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$, however only if the mass and energy of irradiated ions produce sufficiently dense heat spikes in the immediate vicinity of the free surface. Applying machine-learned molecular dynamics simulations together with experimental broad-beam and focused ion-beam irradiations, we conclude that the presence of the free surface enables asymmetric displacements of Ga and O atoms, leading to a local non-stoichiometry. Consequently, when the affected cascade volume is sufficiently large, this compositional imbalance suppresses recrystallization and promotes amorphization. As such, our results are ready to use for tailoring irradiation conditions to either prevent or induce surface amorphization, depending on the requirements of the intended applications in Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ or other compound semiconductors.

AI.tldr: 氧化镓通常因晶格位移引发多晶型转变而保持晶态、抗辐照强，但本研究表明在离子质量与能量足以在自由表面附近产生致密热尖峰的条件下，表面非晶化会胜过晶化。
AI.motivation: 氧化镓被视为极耐辐照半导体，其晶格位移导致多晶型转变而非非晶化；然而极端辐照下许多晶体往往从对称性破缺的表面开始非晶化。作者希望厘清表面非晶化与晶化在Ga2O3中谁占主导及其条件。
AI.method: 结合机器学习分子动力学模拟与宽束、聚焦离子束辐照实验。
AI.result: 自由表面导致Ga与O原子的非对称位移，产生局部非化学计量；当受影响级联体积足够大时，成分失衡抑制再结晶并促进非晶化。
AI.conclusion: 可据此定制辐照条件，按应用需求抑制或诱导Ga2O3及其他化合物半导体的表面非晶化。

title: Shot noise signatures of Majorana-assisted transport in an Aharonov-Bohm interferometer
summary: In this work, we investigate the finite-bias charge current, shot noise, and Fano factor in an Aharonov-Bohm interferometer composed of two parallel quantum dots, each side-coupled to a topological superconducting nanowire represented by an effective Kitaev chain hosting Majorana bound states at its ends. The transport properties are calculated using the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism within the equation-of-motion approach. Our results show that coupling to the Majorana bound states significantly modifies the interference pattern, producing distinctive signatures in the current, shot noise, and Fano factor. These signatures are particularly pronounced at the half-flux condition, where destructive interference suppresses the conventional transport background and enhances the visibility of Majorana-assisted transport. These findings demonstrate that finite-bias shot-noise spectroscopy provides a sensitive indirect probe of Majorana bound states in hybrid superconducting-nanowire interferometers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究两个并联量子点侧耦合拓扑超导纳米线的Aharonov-Bohm干涉仪中的有限偏压电流、散粒噪声与Fano因子，发现Majorana束缚态显著改变干涉图样，是灵敏的间接探测手段。
AI.motivation: Majorana束缚态的直接探测困难，需要寻找灵敏的间接探测方法。本文旨在研究有限偏压下的输运特性（电流、散粒噪声、Fano因子）能否作为探测Majorana束缚态的探针。
AI.method: 采用非平衡格林函数方法（结合运动方程方法），计算由两个并联量子点组成的Aharonov-Bohm干涉仪的输运性质，每个量子点侧耦合由有效Kitaev链描述的拓扑超导纳米线（其末端存在Majorana束缚态）。
AI.result: 耦合到Majorana束缚态显著改变干涉图样，在电流、散粒噪声和Fano因子中产生独特特征；这些特征在半通量条件下尤为明显，此时破坏性干涉抑制了常规输运背景并增强了Majorana辅助输运的可见度。
AI.conclusion: 有限偏压散粒噪声谱为混合超导-纳米线干涉仪中的Majorana束缚态提供了一种灵敏的间接探测手段。

title: Engineering Competing Fractional Topological States in a BHZ Superlattice
summary: Scalar superlattices offer a route from simple topological bands to fractionalized states, while multicomponent systems raise the additional question of which fractional order is energetically selected. We show that a scalar superlattice applied to the Qi-Wu-Zhang (QWZ) Chern-insulator model produces an isolated C = +1 miniband with strongly improved Berry-curvature and quantum metric uniformity. Exact diagonalization of the projected interaction identifies a 1/3 fractional Chern insulator in this miniband. Restoring the time-reversed partner to form the Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang (BHZ) superlattice yields, at total filling 2/3, a balanced fractional quantum spin Hall (FQSH)-like state and a fully polarized 2/3 fractional Chern insulator. Their competition separates two aspects of fractional-state control: the finite-momentum intercomponent coupling governs the stability of the balanced FQSH-like state, whereas a uniform pseudospin anisotropy shifts the relative energies of conserved sectors and can switch the global ground state between the balanced and polarized states. These results establish a minimal lattice setting that connects topological-miniband reconstruction, fractional-state formation, and fractional-state selection, illustrating how distinct levels of control can be combined to navigate competing fractional topological states.

AI.tldr: 在QWZ陈绝缘体模型中引入标量超晶格，得到具有优良Berry曲率与量子度规均匀性的孤立C=+1微带，并在投影相互作用下发现1/3分数量子陈绝缘体；恢复时间反演配对形成BHZ超晶格后，在总填充2/3处出现平衡的类FQSH态与完全极化的2/3 FCI，其竞争由有限动量分量间耦合与均匀赝自旋各向异性分别控制。
AI.motivation: 标量超晶格可将简单拓扑带导向分数化态，而多分量体系中额外的问题是：哪种分数序在能量上被选中。本文旨在建立一个最小晶格框架，连接拓扑微带重构、分数态形成与分数态选择。
AI.method: 对QWZ陈绝缘体模型施加标量超晶格；对投影相互作用做精确对角化；再恢复时间反演配对形成BHZ超晶格，在总填充2/3处分析竞争态。
AI.result: QWZ超晶格产生孤立C=+1微带，Berry曲率与量子度规均匀性显著改善，精确对角化确认其中存在1/3分数量子陈绝缘体。BHZ超晶格在2/3填充出现平衡的类FQSH态与完全极化的2/3分数陈绝缘体；有限动量分量间耦合决定平衡FQSH态的稳定性，而均匀赝自旋各向异性可移动守恒扇区相对能量，从而在平衡态与极化态之间切换全局基态。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提供了一个最小晶格平台，将拓扑微带重构、分数态形成与分数态选择联系起来，说明不同层面的控制可以组合以导航相互竞争的分数拓扑态。

title: Ultrafast Magnetization Induced from Raman-Active Axial Chiral Phonons
summary: Axial chiral phonons, which carry angular momentum and exhibit unusually large magnetic moments, provide a new degree of freedom for controlling the time-reversal symmetry and magnetic properties of quantum materials. While infrared-active axial phonons are efficiently excited to large amplitudes by circularly polarized terahertz pulses, their application may be constrained by short lifetimes, small penetration depths, low spatial resolution, and limited availability of optical sources. Here, we report that an axial Raman-active phonon mode in CeF3 exhibits a significant magnetic moment and an exceedingly long lifetime that more closely matches the paramagnetic spin dynamics. The axial phonon population is resonantly driven by a near-infrared laser pulse with rotating linear polarization, known as an optical centrifuge, a coherent control scheme never applied to solids before. The phonon-driven magnetization observed by time-resolved Faraday rotation scales quadratically with incident power and rapidly decreases at high temperatures, consistent with phonon inverse Faraday effect from many-body spin-phonon coupling. Our findings open a new avenue for using shaped laser pulses from widely accessible light sources to manipulate coherent axial chiral phonons and ultrafast spintronics.

AI.tldr: 该论文报道在CeF3中发现轴向拉曼活性声子模式具有显著磁矩和超长寿命，并用近红外光学离心机脉冲共振驱动，实现声子驱动的超快磁化控制。
AI.motivation: 红外活性轴向手性声子虽可由圆偏振太赫兹脉冲激发，但寿命短、穿透深度小、空间分辨率低且光源受限，亟需寻找更优的替代方案。
AI.method: 利用光学离心机（旋转线偏振近红外激光脉冲）共振驱动CeF3的轴向拉曼活性声子模式，并通过时间分辨法拉第旋转探测声子驱动的磁化。
AI.result: 该轴向拉曼活性声子具有显著磁矩和超长寿命，与顺磁自旋动力学匹配；磁化随入射功率二次增长，高温下快速衰减，符合多体自旋-声子耦合的声子逆法拉第效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作开辟了用广泛可得的激光光源通过整形脉冲操控相干轴向手性声子及超快自旋电子学的新途径。

title: Hidden Magnetic Complexity Within a Simple van der Waals Ferromagnet Ce$_2$Te$_5$
summary: Ce$_2$Te$_5$ is a layered $f$-electron van der Waals magnet in which reduced dimensionality and inequivalent Ce sites give rise to competing magnetic interactions. We investigate its magnetic ground state using muon spin relaxation ($μ$SR), neutron powder diffraction (NPD), and inelastic neutron scattering (INS). Zero-field $μ$SR reveals an onset of static magnetism below $T_{\mathrm{C}} = 5.0(1)$~K, followed by an additional anomaly in the internal field at $T_{\mathrm{2}} = 2.3(2)$~K, consistent with features observed in bulk thermodynamic and transport measurements. In contrast, NPD data collected between $0.05-8$~K reveal a single long-range ordered magnetic phase below $T_{\mathrm C}$, with the magnetic Bragg intensities vanishing at $T_{\mathrm C}$ with no evidence for additional structural or magnetic phase transitions down to base temperature. The ordered state is characterized by a commensurate propagation vector $\mathbf{k}=(0,0,0)$ and ferromagnetic alignment of Ce moments along the crystallographic $b$ axis. Remarkably, only one of the two crystallographically distinct Ce sites carries an ordered moment of $\sim 0.85(3)~μ_{\mathrm B}$ per Ce at 0.05~K. INS measurements establish the crystal electric field (CEF) energy scale of Ce$^{3+}$, revealing low-lying excitations at 7.94 and 21.46~meV and a Kramers doublet ground state with strong single-ion anisotropy. These results demonstrate that Ce$_2$Te$_5$ undergoes a single symmetry-breaking magnetic transition, while additional low-temperature anomalies reflect subtle modifications of the ordered state driven by competing interactions and CEF effects.

AI.tldr: 通过μSR、中子粉末衍射和INS研究Ce2Te5磁性基态，发现其在TC=5.0 K下发生单一对称破缺磁转变，仅一个Ce位点携带~0.85 μB的有序磁矩，并揭示CEF效应。
AI.motivation: Ce2Te5是层状f电子范德华磁体，降低的维度和不等价Ce位点导致竞争性磁相互作用，需要确定其磁性基态本质。
AI.method: 结合 muon自旋弛豫（μSR）、中子粉末衍射（NPD）和非弹性中子散射（INS）进行联合测量。
AI.result: 零场μSR显示TC=5.0(1) K以下出现静态磁性，并在T2=2.3(2) K出现内场异常；NPD显示TC以下单一长程有序磁相，传播矢量k=(0,0,0)、Ce磁矩沿b轴铁磁排列，仅一个Ce位点有序磁矩~0.85(3) μB；INS测得CEF激发在7.94和21.46 meV，基态为强单离子各向异性的Kramers二重态。
AI.conclusion: Ce2Te5经历单一对称破缺磁转变，低温额外异常源于竞争相互作用和CEF效应对有序态的细微调制。

title: Cryothermal Measurements of Variable-Emittance Coatings with Lower Phase Transition Temperatures for Space Thermal Control
summary: Space thermal control is critically important to ensure proper operation of on-board equipment in a regulated temperature range. Passive thermal control with variable-emittance coatings (VECs) could help save power consumption in a dynamically changing space thermal environment. Vanadium dioxide (VO2) based VECs have been studied for space thermal control but its intrinsic phase transition around 68°C limits its wider space applications where lower temperature ranges are expected. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate enhanced radiative heat dissipation in space-like thermal environment via cryothermal measurements with VECs of undoped and tungsten doped VO2. The fabricated undoped VEC exhibits a large emittance change of 0.6 across the phase transition, while the 1 at.% tungsten doped one shows an appreciable emittance variable of 0.4 with phase transition temperature lowered by 25°C. A vacuum cryothermal setup is developed with a liquid nitrogen cooled coldfinger to mimic cold space thermal background and a custom-designed sample mount suspended by nylon wires. After careful calibration and validation, greatly enhanced radiative heat dissipation upon VO2 phase transition up to 3.5 times with transition temperature lowered by 25°C from 1 at.% tungsten doping is clearly observed from the cryothermal tests. In the actual space thermal environment, radiative heat flux could further increase across phase transition from 160 W/m2 to 650 W/m2 with undoped VO2 coating from 55°C to 80°C, and from 175 W/m2 to 493 W/m2 with 1 at.% tungsten doped VEC from 30°C to 55°C.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过低温热学测量，验证了未掺杂与钨掺杂VO2可变发射率涂层在类太空热环境下增强辐射散热的效果，并将相变温度降低约25°C。
AI.motivation: 太空热控对在轨设备正常运行至关重要，被动热控中的可变发射率涂层（VEC）可在动态热环境下节省功耗。但VO2基VEC的相变温度约68°C，限制了其在更低温度范围太空场景中的应用。
AI.method: 制备未掺杂和1 at.%钨掺杂的VO2基VEC，搭建由液氮冷却冷指模拟冷太空背景、尼龙线悬挂定制样品台的真空低温热学测试装置，经校准验证后进行辐射散热测量。
AI.result: 未掺杂VEC相变时发射率变化达0.6；1 at.%钨掺杂VEC发射率变化为0.4，相变温度降低25°C。低温测试观察到相变时辐射散热增强最高达3.5倍。实际太空热环境下，未掺杂VO2在55–80°C辐射热流从160增至650 W/m²，钨掺杂VEC在30–55°C从175增至493 W/m²。
AI.conclusion: 钨掺杂可有效降低VO2相变温度并保持可用的发射率变化，显著增强类太空环境下的辐射散热，拓展了VO2基VEC在低温太空热控中的应用潜力。

title: Chiral Antiferromagnetism from Momentum-Space Resonance in a 2D Semiconductor
summary: Understanding the principles governing the emergence of chiral quantum phases is a fundamental challenge, not only for uncovering new mechanisms of quantum-state formation but also for realizing giant electronic responses and transport phenomena arising from chirality and topology. While Fermi-surface instabilities in metals can stabilize complex ordered states through multiple competing scattering channels, their microscopic origin is often obscured by the complexity of the underlying electronic structure, limiting the development of general microscopic design principles. Here, we introduce a complementary strategy based on the simplicity of semiconductor band extrema. Using the layered van der Waals semiconductor GdGaI, whose low-energy electronic structure consists of simple electron and hole valleys, we discover the spontaneous emergence of an intertwined chiral triple-$q$ antiferromagnetic state accompanied by a cooperative reconstruction of the electron-hole band edges, beyond the conventional expectation of a single-$q$ ground state. This collective reconstruction generates substantial momentum-space Berry curvature, giving rise to a pronounced spontaneous anomalous Hall effect despite the semiconducting character and negligible net magnetization. Remarkably, this chiral state is realized within an atomically well-defined ($\approx2a$), topologically nontrivial magnetic texture, showing that such collective quantum states can emerge at an exceptionally small length scale from a simple two-dimensional magnetic semiconductor. More broadly, our results introduce a remarkably simple design concept for chiral quantum matter: using simple semiconductor band extrema as building blocks for resonance-like interplay in momentum space, providing a route to Berry curvature, topological transport, and emergent quantum phases.

AI.tldr: 在层状范德瓦尔斯半导体GdGaI中，发现由简单电子/空穴能谷驱动的自发交织手性三重-q反铁磁态，伴随能带边缘重构，产生显著动量空间Berry曲率与自发反常霍尔效应。
AI.motivation: 手性量子相的形成机制是量子物态研究的基本问题，可带来手性与拓扑相关的巨电子响应。金属中费米面失稳虽可稳定复杂有序态，但受制于复杂电子结构，微观起源难以厘清，缺乏通用设计原则。
AI.method: 提出基于半导体能带极值简单性的互补策略，选取低能电子结构由简单电子谷与空穴谷构成的层状范德瓦尔斯半导体GdGaI，研究其基态磁有序与能带重构。
AI.result: 发现自发涌现的交织手性三重-q反铁磁态（超出常规单一-q基态预期），伴随电子-空穴能带边缘的协同重构；该态产生可观动量空间Berry曲率，在半导体性质且净磁化可忽略条件下仍表现出显著自发反常霍尔效应；手性态实现于约2a尺度、拓扑非平庸的原子级磁织构中。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出以简单半导体能带极值作为动量空间类共振相互作用的构建单元，为手性量子物质提供极简设计理念，为Berry曲率、拓扑输运与涌现量子相开辟新路径。

title: Time- and Frequency-Resolved Observation of Inverse Orbital Hall Effect in Gallium Nitride via Terahertz Polarimetry
summary: Orbitronics has attracted significant attention as a platform for information storage and processing that exploits the orbital angular momentum (OAM) of electrons without the need for spin-orbit coupling. However, experimental evaluation of OAM-charge interconversion remains a challenge and the results are often controversial due to the coexistence of bulk and interfacial contributions and the complexity in sample structures. Here, using circularly polarized light pulses and terahertz (THz) polarimetry, we developed a non-contact method to observe the inverse orbital Hall effect as a bulk response within a single material without employing heterostructure samples. In a semiconductor GaN, we directly captured the OAM-to-charge current conversion of holes in the THz frequency range. By analyzing the sharp frequency dependence of the Hall conductivity, we disentangled the competing microscopic mechanisms and revealed the dominant role of extrinsic contributions to the orbital Hall effect in the dc limit. By contrast, the Hall conductivity at THz frequencies above the impurity scattering rate is attributed to the intrinsic Berry-curvature mechanism,allowing a quantitative comparison with the microscopic theory. Furthermore, the ultrafast dynamics of the inverse orbital Hall signal directly revealed sub-picosecond OAM relaxation of holes, comparable to that of phonon-mediated thermalization. The quantitative argument based on theoretical calculations suggested the existence of an even faster decay channel due to momentum redistribution by acoustic phonons, suggesting a sub-nanometer-scale OAM relaxation length. Our results provide comprehensive and crucial insights into OAM transport and establish an ultrafast, contact-free approach for investigating OAM-to-charge conversion.

AI.tldr: 该文利用圆偏振光脉冲与太赫兹偏振测量，在单个半导体GaN材料中非接触地观测到逆轨道霍尔效应，实现了OAM-电荷电流转换的直接测量，并区分了外禀与内禀机制、揭示了亚皮秒OAM弛豫。
AI.motivation: 轨道电子学无需自旋-轨道耦合即可利用电子轨道角动量，但OAM-电荷互转换的实验评估困难，体态与界面贡献共存、样品结构复杂导致结果常存争议，缺乏在单一材料中直接观测体态响应的方法。
AI.method: 采用圆偏振光脉冲激发结合太赫兹偏振测量，在半导体GaN中非接触观测逆轨道霍尔效应；通过分析霍尔电导率的频率依赖关系分离不同微观机制；利用逆轨道霍尔信号的超快动力学测量OAM弛豫，并结合理论计算进行定量分析。
AI.result: 在GaN中直接捕获了空穴的OAM-电荷电流转换；dc极限下外禀贡献主导轨道霍尔效应，而高于杂质散射率的THz频率下霍尔电导率源于内禀Berry曲率机制，可与微观理论定量比较；超快动力学揭示亚皮秒OAM弛豫，理论计算表明存在由声学声子动量再分配导致的更快衰减通道，暗示亚纳米级OAM弛豫长度。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了对OAM输运的全面认识，建立了超快、非接触研究OAM-电荷转换的方法，并揭示了轨道霍尔效应中外禀与内禀机制的频率依赖竞争关系。

title: Interfacial Engineering Enabled High-Resolution Stretchable Metal-Level Conductive Lines and Transparent Conductor
summary: As stretchable electronics advance toward higher integration density and finer feature sizes, stretchable conductors, which serve as the architectural backbone of these electronics, must be scaled down accordingly. However, achieving both high stretchability and high electrical conductivity at high resolution remains a challenge using existing conductive materials. Here, through material design and interfacial engineering, we develop a thiol-functionalized conducting polymer/gold hybrid stack that can be patterned down to 4 micrometer linewidths using standard photolithography, while maintaining high stretchability, metal-like conductivity (>40,000 S/cm), and environmental stability. Leveraging this capability, we demonstrate grid-based stretchable transparent electrodes that surpass the figure-of-merit of indium tin oxide, as well as a 1000-pixel-per-inch image interconnected with stretchable lines. This work helps to broaden the scope of next-generation functional soft electronics, including e-skins and bioelectronics.

AI.tldr: 通过材料设计与界面工程，开发出可光刻至4微米线宽、兼具高拉伸性、类金属导电性（>40,000 S/cm）和环境稳定性的硫醇功能化导电聚合物/金杂化叠层，并展示超越ITO优值的可拉伸透明电极及1000 ppi像素互连。
AI.motivation: 随着可拉伸电子向高集成度和精细特征尺寸发展，作为架构骨架的可拉伸导体也需相应微缩；但现有导电材料难以在高分辨率下同时实现高拉伸性与高导电性。
AI.method: 采用材料设计与界面工程，构建硫醇功能化的导电聚合物/金杂化叠层，并用标准光刻工艺将其图案化至4微米线宽。
AI.result: 实现4微米线宽图案化，保持高拉伸性、类金属导电性（>40,000 S/cm）和环境稳定性；演示了优值超越ITO的可拉伸透明电极，以及用可拉伸导线互连的1000 ppi图像。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拓宽了下一代功能软电子的应用范围，包括电子皮肤和生物电子学。

title: Multi4D: an end-to-end neural network for structural determination at complex material interfaces
summary: Heterogeneous interfaces dictate the performance and degradation of functional materials, making it essential to link local structural variations with macroscopic failure mechanisms to guide future materials design. Yet structural heterogeneity, phase overlap, and local disorder produce highly convoluted diffraction signatures, making extended transition regions difficult to interpret at atomic resolution across large fields of view. Here, we introduce Multi4D, a physics-informed neural network framework for automated multi-component crystallographic identification using four-dimensional scanning transmission electron microscopy (4D-STEM). By combining a latent-space Diffusion Transformer for physics-constrained style translation with a rotation-invariant convolutional neural network for orientation-agnostic classification, this approach translates multi-components diffraction datasets into deterministic crystallographic maps with 98.82% accuracy. In addition, we introduce Diffraction-Inferred Structural Complexity as an information-theoretic entropy metric derived from classifier predictive uncertainty that quantifies local structural ambiguity. We apply Multi4D to generate high-fidelity structural maps of complex superconducting heterostructures, corroded alloy surfaces, and degraded solid-state battery interfaces down to single-nanometer spatial resolution. This framework establishes a statistically robust analytical paradigm for automated microscopy, facilitating both industrial quality control and the data-driven discovery of interfacial design principles.

AI.tldr: 提出Multi4D物理信息神经网络框架，用4D-STEM实现多组分晶体学自动识别，准确率达98.82%，并引入熵度量量化局部结构模糊性。
AI.motivation: 异质界面决定功能材料的性能与退化，但结构异质性、相重叠和局部无序导致衍射信号高度复杂，难以在大视场下以原子分辨率解析过渡区域，因此需要将局部结构变化与宏观失效机制关联。
AI.method: Multi4D框架结合潜空间扩散Transformer进行物理约束风格迁移，以及旋转不变卷积神经网络进行分类，将多组分衍射数据转化为确定性晶体学图；并引入由分类器预测不确定性衍生的信息熵指标Diffraction-Inferred Structural Complexity。
AI.result: 实现98.82%分类准确率，生成高保真结构图，应用于超导异质结构、腐蚀合金表面和退化固态电池界面，空间分辨率达单纳米级。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为自动化显微分析建立了统计稳健的分析范式，可促进工业质量控制及界面设计原理的数据驱动发现。

title: Contribution of photogenerated charge carriers to photothermal effect in optically opaque semiconductor samples
summary: As a consequence of laser radiation absorption, the photothermal response of semiconductors is governed by both the thermalization of the crystal lattice and the dynamics of photogenerated charge carriers. This carrier-related contribution leaves a characteristic signature in the temperature field through carrier diffusion and recombination, making the photothermal response sensitive to electronic transport and recombination properties. This sensitivity provides the basis for using photothermal methods to characterize the electronic properties of semiconductors. In this paper, we develop a theoretical model of the photothermal response of moderately doped opaque semiconductors under harmonically modulated laser excitation, accounting for the generation, diffusion, and recombination of minority charge carriers. We analyze how carrier lifetime, diffusion length, and surface recombination velocity affect the resulting temperature field and, consequently, the photothermal signal. In particular, we show that the thermal contribution associated with carrier recombination remains nonzero even when the surface recombination rate vanishes and for short carrier lifetimes, demonstrating that the signature of photogenerated carriers may persist under conditions where their contribution might otherwise be expected to become negligible. The results provide guidance for both the design and interpretation of photothermal and photoacoustic experiments, including the choice of modulation frequency and detection geometry, to enhance the sensitivity to carrier-related thermal signatures and improve the determination of electronic properties of semiconductor materials and devices.

AI.tldr: 本文建立中等掺杂不透明半导体在谐波调制激光激发下的光热响应理论模型，纳入少数载流子的产生、扩散与复合，揭示载流子寿命、扩散长度与表面复合速度对温度场和光热信号的影响。
AI.motivation: 激光吸收导致半导体光热响应同时受晶格热化与光生载流子动力学支配，载流子扩散和复合在温度场中留下特征信号，使光热方法可用来表征半导体的电子输运与复合性质。因此需要一个能刻画载流子贡献的理论模型，以指导实验设计与信号解释。
AI.method: 构建中等掺杂不透明半导体在谐波调制激光激发下的光热响应理论模型，显式考虑少数载流子的产生、扩散和复合过程，并分析载流子寿命、扩散长度及表面复合速度对温度场与光热信号的影响。
AI.result: 分析表明，载流子寿命、扩散长度和表面复合速度会显著改变温度场及光热信号；尤其发现即使表面复合速率趋于零、载流子寿命很短，与载流子复合相关的热贡献仍然非零，说明光生载流子的特征在通常被认为可忽略的条件下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为光热与光声实验的设计和解释提供指导，包括调制频率与探测几何的选择，以增强对载流子相关热信号的灵敏度并改进半导体材料与器件电子性质的测定。

title: Binder chemistry sets the interfacial balance constant in CsPbBr$_3$ nanocrystal supercapacitor electrodes
summary: Previous work on lead-free tin halide perovskites showed that the binder instead sets the electrolyte concentration at which capacitance is maximised, following the relationship $100 \times [\mathrm{Li}^+]_{\mathrm{opt}} + \mathrm{PVDF}_{\mathrm{wt}\%} = ξ_{\mathrm{Int}}$ with $ξ_{\mathrm{Int}} = 25 \pm 2.5$, established by varying the loading of a single polymer. Whether $ξ_{\mathrm{Int}}$ is universal or specific to that polymer has not been tested. Here, four binders spanning fluorinated (PVDF), carboxylic (PAA), cellulosic (CMC) and sulfonic (PEDOT:PSS) chemistry are compared on $\mathrm{CsPbBr_3}$ nanocrystal electrodes at four LiTFSI concentrations in acetonitrile, with binder loading fixed at 15 wt% and all other formulation variables held constant. The relationship applies to $\mathrm{CsPbBr_3}$: PVDF at 15 wt% gives an optimum at 0.10--0.15 M and 112 F g$^{-1}$, against 126 F g$^{-1}$ reported for $\mathrm{CsSnCl_3}$ under the same conditions, extending the result to a different B-site cation, halide and crystal system. PVDF and CMC optimise at 0.10 M, giving $ξ_{\mathrm{Int}} = 25$, while PAA and PEDOT:PSS optimise at 0.15 M, giving $ξ_{\mathrm{Int}} = 30$, with maximum values of 188 F g$^{-1}$ for PAA and 146 mF cm$^{-2}$ for PEDOT:PSS. The two binders showing the shift carry ionisable acid groups at high density, indicating that $ξ_{\mathrm{Int}}$ expressed in weight percent requires a binder-specific value. In all four electrodes, $\mathrm{CsPbBr_3}$ converts to $\mathrm{PbBr_2}$ and CsBr during electrochemical characterisation, and the surface lead content of the PEDOT:PSS electrode decreases.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了无铅锡卤钙钛矿中"粘结剂-电解液浓度"关系常数ξ_Int是否通用，通过对比四种不同化学粘结剂，发现ξ_Int依赖于粘结剂类型而非普适。
AI.motivation: 此前在无铅锡卤钙钛矿中发现电容最大化时的电解液浓度与粘结剂含量满足 100×[Li⁺]_opt + PVDF_wt% = ξ_Int（ξ_Int=25±2.5），但仅基于单一聚合物PVDF验证，尚不清楚该常数是普适还是仅针对该聚合物。
AI.method: 在CsPbBr₃纳米晶电极上，固定粘结剂负载为15 wt%，其他配方变量不变，对比四种覆盖氟化(PVDF)、羧酸(PAA)、纤维素(CMC)、磺酸(PEDOT:PSS)化学的粘结剂，在四种LiTFSI浓度(乙腈)下进行电化学表征。
AI.result: 关系式适用于CsPbBr₃，将结果扩展到不同B位阳离子、卤素和晶系。PVDF在15 wt%时最优浓度0.10–0.15 M，达112 F g⁻¹（CsSnCl₃同条件为126 F g⁻¹）；PVDF和CMC在0.10 M最优(ξ_Int=25)，PAA和PEDOT:PSS在0.15 M最优(ξ_Int=30)，最大值为PAA 188 F g⁻¹、PEDOT:PSS 146 mF cm⁻²。电化学表征中CsPbBr₃均转化为PbBr₂和CsBr，PEDOT:PSS电极表面铅含量下降。
AI.conclusion: ξ_Int以重量百分比表示时需要粘结剂特异数值，并非普适常数；发生偏移的两种粘结剂(PAA、PEDOT:PSS)均含高密度可电离酸基团，这是偏移的可能原因。

title: Origins of Pressure-Enhanced Thermal Transport in Organic Semiconductors
comment: Supporting Information attached below the references
summary: While pressure is known to dramatically alter the electronic properties of organic semiconductors, its impact on their thermal conductivity remains poorly understood. We combine machine learned potentials with the Wigner transport equation to compute the pressure-dependent thermal conductivity of crystalline naphthalene as a model system. When high-pressure reference data are included in the training, our simulations quantitatively reproduce the experimentally observed dramatic increase in thermal conductivity for compressed naphthalene. Most importantly, our results reveal the microscopic origin of this massive enhancement: pressure stiffens especially the intermolecular bonds, increasing the group velocities of heat-carrying phonons and simultaneously suppressing the scattering that impedes intraband (propagation) thermal transport. In contrast, interband (tunneling) transport is relatively weakened by a reduced spectral overlap between different phonon bands. These findings provide fundamental insights into heat conduction in soft molecular materials and suggest that strengthening intermolecular interactions, here, via applying pressure can be used to tune thermal transport in molecular crystals.

AI.tldr: 本文结合机器学习势与Wigner输运方程，计算了萘晶体在压力下的热导率，揭示了压力大幅提升热导率的微观机制。
AI.motivation: 压力可显著改变有机半导体的电子性质，但其对热导率的影响尚不清楚，缺乏对软分子材料中压力调控热传导的微观理解。
AI.method: 将机器学习势与Wigner输运方程相结合，以晶体萘为模型体系计算其压力依赖的热导率；训练中引入高压参考数据。
AI.result: 模拟定量再现了实验观测到的压缩萘热导率的大幅提升；压力使分子间键刚化，提高热载声子的群速度并抑制带内（传播）散射，而带间（隧穿）输运因声子带谱重叠减小而相对减弱。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了软分子材料热传导的基本机制，表明通过施加压力增强分子间相互作用可调控分子晶体的热输运。

title: Misfit-dislocation hierarchy governs sliding of asymmetric non-CSL grain boundaries
summary: Grain boundary (GB) deformation significantly influences the mechanical response of polycrystalline materials, yet most atomistic studies have focused on coincidence site lattice (CSL) boundaries. Motivated by in situ atomic-resolution observations, we investigate step-free sliding along asymmetric non-CSL tilt GBs in face-centered cubic (FCC) metals using atomistic modeling. In these incommensurate GBs, a dense array of primary misfit dislocations accommodates the local interfacial mismatch, whereas a more widely spaced array of secondary GB misfit dislocations accommodates the residual mismatch. Uniform sliding calculations reveal two distinct quantities: the minimum GB structural periodicity λ, defined by the repeating arrangement of primary GB misfit dislocations, and the slip vector b, determined by the minimum displacement-shift-complete translation that restores an equivalent GB structure. Nonuniform sliding proceeds through the glide of secondary GB misfit dislocations, which carry b and transform successive boundary segments between crystallographically equivalent translation states. These secondary misfit dislocations dissociate into partials, each carrying a partial Burgers vector b_p and connecting intermediate interfacial states. The characteristic spacing between secondary misfit partials defines a longer periodicity Λ. Below the athermal stress, each partial glides through a two-step thermally activated kink-pair mechanism, advances the partial by one structural period l. These results establish a unified crystallographic and dislocation-based framework for understanding stress-driven sliding in structurally complex asymmetric GBs.

AI.tldr: 本文用原子模拟研究FCC金属中非CSL不对称倾斜晶界的无台阶滑动，揭示其由二次失配位错（分解为分位错）的扭结对机制控制，并建立统一的晶体学与位错框架。
AI.motivation: 现有晶界变形的原子尺度研究多集中于重合位置点阵(CSL)晶界，对更普遍的非CSL、非共格不对称倾斜晶界的滑动机制认识不足，而原位原子分辨观测已提示此类晶界的重要性。
AI.method: 对FCC金属中非CSL不对称倾斜晶界进行原子尺度建模，分析其失配位错结构；通过均匀与非均匀滑动计算，确定结构周期性λ、滑移矢量b、二次失配位错及其分位错行为，并考察热激活扭结对机制。
AI.result: 不均匀滑动由二次晶界失配位错的滑移主导，携带滑移矢量b并逐段转变晶界状态；二次失配位错分解为分位错（携带分Burgers矢量b_p），其间距定义更长周期性Λ；低于无热应力时，每个分位错以两步热激活扭结对机制滑移，每次推进一个结构周期l。
AI.conclusion: 研究为结构复杂的非对称晶界中应力驱动滑动提供了统一的晶体学与位错基础框架，区分了主/次失配位错及分位错的角色与特征周期性。

title: Beyond binary at submicron dimensions: crossed-ellipse MTJ free layers as multi-state cells for spintronic crossbars
summary: Spintronic crossbars are promising hardware platforms for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, but conventional magnetic tunnel junctions (MTJs) are binary, limiting the information density and synaptic precision of each crosspoint. Here, MuMax3 micromagnetic simulations are used to investigate how size and aspect ratio control the switching and remanent-state landscape of crossed-ellipse MTJ free layers, with permalloy as the main model system and CoFeB checks for transferability. At fixed 8:1 aspect ratio, shrinking the device from 16 micron x 2 micron to 80 nm x 10 nm lowers the absolute switching current but raises the switching field from about 11 Oe to about 301 Oe and increases the SOT current density. At fixed major axis 1.6 micron, aspect-ratio tuning produces a low-field four-state regime, while lower aspect ratios stabilize additional remanent states with lower switching fields and current densities. A 1.6 micron x 0.8 micron device exhibits twelve accessible remanent plateaus in its angle-resolved planar Hall response, with the resolved state count depending on both aspect ratio and absolute size. Projected MTJ readout gives multiple electrical levels, while minimum-energy-path calculations show that the twelve configurations are not all thermally independent. Independent MuMax+ calculations reproduce the multistate topology and reveal lower-barrier multistep escape pathways between nominally distant states. These results define a geometry-dependent design window for scalable multistate spintronic crossbar cells.

AI.tldr: 利用MuMax3微磁模拟研究交叉椭圆MTJ自由层的尺寸与纵横比如何调控其开关行为和多阻态特性，为多态自旋电子交叉阵列单元确定几何设计窗口。
AI.motivation: 自旋电子交叉阵列是实现能效神经形态计算的有前景平台，但传统MTJ是二值的，限制了每个交叉点的信息密度和突触精度。
AI.method: 采用MuMax3微磁模拟，以坡莫合金为主要模型体系、CoFeB用于可迁移性验证，研究交叉椭圆MTJ自由层的开关与剩磁态随尺寸和纵横比的变化；并结合最小能量路径计算与独立MuMax+计算验证多态拓扑。
AI.result: 固定8:1纵横比时，器件从16 μm×2 μm缩小到80 nm×10 nm，绝对开关电流降低但开关场由约11 Oe升至约301 Oe，SOT电流密度增大。固定长轴1.6 μm时，调节纵横比可产生低场四态区，较低纵横比稳定额外剩磁态并降低开关场与电流密度。1.6 μm×0.8 μm器件在角度分辨平面霍尔响应中呈现十二个可及剩磁平台，态数取决于纵横比与绝对尺寸。MTJ读出可给出多电学电平，但最小能量路径计算表明十二种构型并非全部热独立，MuMax+揭示低势垒多步逃逸路径。
AI.conclusion: 研究定义了可扩展多态自旋电子交叉阵列单元的几何依赖设计窗口。

title: Colossal magnetostriction effect in rare-earth orthoferrites
summary: Within the entire gamut of magnetostrictive, piezomagnetic, and ferromagnetic shape memory alloy systems, the striction effect is found to vary from a few tens of parts per million to a few percent. Here, we report the observation of an unprecedentedly large magnetic-field-induced lattice strain along the $c$ axis (more than 60-100% at 90 kOe field) in single crystals of orthorhombic $R$FeO$_3$ ($R$ = Dy, Ho) below their spin-reorientation transition temperature $T_{SR}$. However, the striction effect is two orders of magnitude smaller along the $a$ and $b$ axes. Like magnetostriction, the magnetodielectric effect is highly anisotropic and very large along the $c$ axis. Such gigantic striction and dielectric effects along the $c$ axis arise as a result of a magnetic-field-induced first-order structural phase transition which possibly stems from large spin-orbit coupling (and, thereby, enormous magnetocrystalline anisotropy). The observed colossal striction in rare-earth orthoferrites could open new opportunities for applications requiring large, reversible magnetic-field-induced strain.

AI.tldr: 在Dy/Ho正铁氧体单晶中，发现沿c轴磁场诱导的巨大利晶格应变（90 kOe下达60-100%），源于磁场诱导的一级结构相变。
AI.motivation: 现有磁致伸缩、压磁及铁磁形状记忆合金体系的应变效应通常仅从几十ppm到百分之几，缺乏超大、可逆的磁场诱导应变的材料。
AI.method: 对正交结构RFeO3（R=Dy、Ho）单晶，在其自旋重取向转变温度TSR以下施加磁场（最高90 kOe），测量沿c轴及a、b轴的晶格应变与磁介电效应。
AI.result: 沿c轴观测到前所未有的巨大磁场诱导晶格应变（90 kOe下超过60-100%），而a、b轴应变小两个数量级；磁介电效应同样沿c轴高度各向异性且巨大。
AI.conclusion: c轴方向的巨大应变和介电效应源于磁场诱导的一级结构相变，可能由大自旋-轨道耦合（及巨大磁晶各向异性）导致，为需要大且可逆磁场诱导应变的应打开了新机遇。

title: Prescreening Point Defects in Semiconductors With Machine Learning
summary: High-throughput calculations using density-functional theory (DFT) are commonly used to explore point defects for applications in power electronics and quantum technologies. There is currently a major shift away from these traditional simulation techniques towards machine learning (ML) methods. We explore a class of physics-guided ML models for predicting defect formation energies and zero-phonon lines (ZPL) to identify point defects for quantum applications. The models are specifically targeted for use in a prescreening step for accelerated high-throughput workflows, and are therefore designed to avoid the costly relaxation step typically present with ML interatomic potentials (MLIPs). We compare performance for single and double point defect systems in 4H-SiC with ridge, kernel ridge, and multilayer perceptron (MLP) models using three different descriptors representing the defect systems. For vacancies and substitutions, the optimized models give mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 0.437 eV for the formation energy and 0.202 eV for ZPLs, which is just above the level at which such predictions can be useful even beyond the targeted prescreening, i.e., in some applications they may completely replace the need for costly DFT calculations. For interstitials the MAEs are larger, 1.101 eV for the formation energy and 0.230 eV for the ZPL, which, while still useful for prescreening, will not generally be useful for more detailed characterization. Hence, while the results may be further improved by model design and optimization, the models presented in this work are already useful for prescreening in high-throughput characterization of point defects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理引导的机器学习模型，用于预测4H-SiC中缺陷形成能和零声子线，服务于高通量筛选流程。
AI.motivation: 传统DFT高通量计算成本高，研究正转向机器学习方法。现有ML原子间势通常需要昂贵的结构弛豫步骤，因此需要设计避免弛豫、适用于预筛选的物理引导模型。
AI.method: 针对4H-SiC的单、双点缺陷，采用三种缺陷体系描述符，比较岭回归、核岭回归和多层感知机（MLP）模型的性能（省略MLIP常见的弛豫步骤）。
