AI.result: 对空位和替位缺陷，优化模型MAE为形成能0.437 eV、ZPL 0.202 eV，接近甚至部分应用可替代DFT的水平；对间隙缺陷，MAE较大（形成能1.101 eV、ZPL 0.230 eV），仍可用于预筛选但不足以精细表征。
AI.conclusion: 所提模型已可用于点缺陷高通量表征的预筛选，未来通过模型设计与优化仍有提升空间。

title: Proximity-induced charge density waves in a moiré heterobilayer
summary: Twisted heterobilayers of two-dimensional materials have emerged as a platform for studying emergent phases of matter. In this work, we investigate charge density waves (CDW) in a twisted NbSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$ bilayer using first-principles calculations. We observe CDW formation in both layers, even though MoSe$_2$ does not feature a CDW in its monolayer form. Moreover, we find that the CDW is highly non-uniform with filled-center, hollow-center and hexagonal CDWs coexisting in the moiré unit cells of both layers. We assess different mechanisms of CDW formation in the MoSe$_2$ layer and conclude that the dominant one is the steric repulsion between Se atoms across the van der Waals gap. The strength of this effect is highly sensitive to the interlayer separation, which explains why the CDW amplitude in the MoSe$_2$ layer depends strongly on the local stacking arrangement. Our work demonstrates that novel broken-symmetry phases can be induced in twisted heterobilayers through proximity effects.

AI.tldr: 本文用第一性原理计算研究扭转NbSe₂/MoSe₂异质双层中的电荷密度波(CDW)，发现两层均出现CDW（尽管MoSe₂单层无CDW），且CDW高度非均匀、在莫尔原胞内多种构型共存，其主要机制为跨范德华间隙的Se原子间位阻排斥。
AI.motivation: 扭转二维异质双层是研究新物态的平台，作者希望探究莫尔超晶格能否诱导本征不发生CDW的材料（MoSe₂单层）产生CDW等破缺对称相。
AI.method: 对扭转NbSe₂/MoSe₂双层进行第一性原理计算，分析两层CDW形成、比较不同CDW形成机制，并考察层间距对CDW振幅的影响。
AI.result: 两层均形成CDW；CDW高度非均匀，填充中心、空心中心与六角CDW在两层莫尔原胞中共存；MoSe₂层CDW主导机制为跨范德华间隙Se原子间位阻排斥，其强度对层间距高度敏感，导致CDW振幅强烈依赖局部堆叠构型。
AI.conclusion: 扭转异质双层可通过邻近效应诱导新的破缺对称相（如使本征无CDW的MoSe₂产生CDW）。

title: Neural-Network Solutions to Real-Space Charge Density and Generalization
summary: The Hohenberg-Kohn theorem establishes that, in principle, the ground state (GS) charge density contains all GS information of a many-electron system, such that all GS observables can be expressed as functionals of the GS charge density. Conventional Kohn-Sham density functional theory requires iterative solution of the self-consistent-field equations at substantial computational cost, motivating the development of deep learning surrogates for electronic structure calculations and, in turn, accelerating computer-aided materials design. Here, we propose \textbf{AIDEN}, an \underline{A}tomic-\underline{I}nteraction \underline{D}ensity \underline{E}quivariant \underline{N}etwork for solving real-space charge density. AIDEN separates the element-dependent one-center density from environment-induced density redistribution and represents the latter through complementary atom- and edge-centered tensor correlations. A continuous low-rank Gaussian decoder then reconstructs the density at arbitrary spatial coordinates while reusing atomic encodings independently of the evaluation grid. AIDEN achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on periodic crystal benchmarks while remaining competitive for molecular systems, and further demonstrates zero-shot transferability across several structurally distinct out-of-distribution case studies. Furthermore, AIDEN provides substantially faster inference than both baseline models and full SCF calculations, enabling efficient charge density reconstruction for large-scale electronic structure calculations.

AI.tldr: 提出AIDEN，一个用于求解实空间电荷密度的原子相互作用密度等变网络，实现高精度、可零样本迁移且推理远快于SCF的电子结构预测。
AI.motivation: Hohenberg-Kohn定理表明基态电荷密度包含全部基态信息，但传统Kohn-Sham DFT需迭代求解自洽场方程，计算代价高昂，因此需要深度学习代理模型来加速电子结构计算和材料设计。
AI.method: AIDEN将元素相关的一中心密度与环境诱导的密度重分布分离；用互补的原子中心和边中心张量关联表示环境诱导部分；采用连续低秩高斯解码器在任意空间坐标重建密度，并独立于评估网格复用原子编码。
AI.result: 在周期性晶体基准上达到最先进精度，在分子体系上保持竞争力；在多个结构差异大的分布外案例中展示零样本迁移能力；推理速度显著快于基线模型和完整SCF计算。
AI.conclusion: AIDEN能高效重建大尺度电子结构计算所需的电荷密度，为深度学习加速DFT提供了有效方案。

title: Machine Learning Guided CALPHAD Design of Ru-Stabilized BCC B2 Refractory Alloys
summary: Refractory alloys with a ductile body-centered-cubic (BCC) matrix strengthened by ordered B2 precipitates offer a high-temperature analogue to the gamma/gamma-prime architecture of Ni-based superalloys. Ruthenium is particularly attractive as a B2 stabilizer because RuHf, RuZr, and RuTi can retain ordered phases well above 1300 C. In this work, equilibrium CALPHAD calculations were coupled with random-forest-guided active learning to explore a ten-element Nb-based, Ru-bearing composition space containing Nb, Ta, Mo, V, Ru, Ti, Zr, Hf, Al, and Y at 1 at.% resolution. Across 500 CALPHAD-evaluated alloys, the calculations reproduced the principal trends reported for the Ru-B2 design space. RuHf and RuZr remained stable to the solidus, RuTi commonly exhibited a solutionizing window, and Al-containing alloys preferentially formed competing sigma and A15 phases. The upper bound of the BCC+B2 field increased from a median of approximately 1570 C at 5 at.% Ru to approximately 1980 C near 9-10 at.% Ru. Among the group-IV additions, Hf, Zr, and Ti produced progressively lower two-phase stability. Re-screening using physically motivated criteria identified 100 alloys satisfying requirements for high-temperature BCC+B2 stability, absence of liquid, phase purity, and appropriate secondary-phase fraction, including 19 Ru-lean compositions and two independently reported HfRu-B2 alloys. The results establish practical compositional design rules for Ru-stabilized dual-phase refractory alloys and identify phase-specific BCC/B2 lattice misfit as a key target for future design cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文结合CALPHAD计算与随机森林主动学习，探索十元素Nb基含Ru难熔合金成分空间，筛选出100种满足高温BCC+B2稳定性的合金，并确立设计规则。
AI.motivation: 难熔合金以韧性BCC基体加有序B2析出相，可类比Ni基高温合金的gamma/gamma-prime结构，用于高温应用；Ru能稳定B2相（RuHf、RuZr、RuTi在1300°C以上仍保持有序），但需高效探索多元素成分空间以找到可行设计。
AI.method: 将平衡CALPHAD计算与随机森林引导的主动学习相结合，以1 at.%分辨率探索含Nb、Ta、Mo、V、Ru、Ti、Zr、Hf、Al、Y的十元素成分空间，评估500种合金，并依据物理准则重新筛选。
AI.result: 计算再现了Ru-B2设计空间的主要趋势：RuHf和RuZr稳定至固相线，RuTi常存在固溶窗口，含Al合金倾向形成sigma和A15竞争相。BCC+B2相区上限从5 at.% Ru的约1570°C升至9-10 at.% Ru附近的约1980°C；IV族添加中Hf、Zr、Ti的两相稳定性依次降低。筛选出100种合金（含19种贫Ru成分和两种已报道的HfRu-B2合金）。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了Ru稳定双相难熔合金的实用成分设计规则，并将相特异性BCC/B2晶格错配确定为未来设计周期的关键目标。

title: Quantitative control and recording of materials-synthesis processes using an automated experimentation platform
summary: Data-driven materials development requires the collection of large amounts of high-quality materials data. Full autonomy of materials experiments is anticipated, but its technical hurdles are high and its adoption remains limited. In this study, we constructed a simple, easy-to-deploy automated experimentation platform that focuses not on full autonomy but on the reliable automation and quantitative recording of experimental processes. Specifically, commercially available instruments such as robot arms, electric pipettes, web cameras, and an electronic balance are combined, components such as fixtures are fabricated with a 3D printer, and the instruments are operated by control code generated by an AI agent based on a large language model. As a demonstration, we applied the platform to a two-solution mixing experimental system and synthesized ZIF-8, a metal-organic framework. A white suspension phase was observed in the product, and X-ray diffraction measurements confirmed that it was ZIF-8. We also found that its particle size distribution depends strongly on the solution dispensing speed of the electric pipette, which is a parameter that is difficult to control or record in manual operation. This dependence was reproduced in repeated runs, confirming the repeatability of the automated synthesis. This result is a good example showing that the control and recording of process parameters that are rarely quantified in manual work can govern the quality of materials data. All control code, CAD models, and documentation are made publicly available to encourage the spread of laboratory-scale automation of experiments.

AI.tldr: 该研究搭建了一个易部署的自动化实验平台，结合机器人臂、电动移液器等商用仪器与LLM生成的控制代码，用于ZIF-8合成，并公开了全部代码、CAD模型与文档。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动材料开发需要大量高质量数据，但全自主实验技术门槛高、采用受限。因此作者转向"可靠自动化与定量记录"这一更务实的目标。
AI.method: 整合商用仪器（机器人臂、电动移液器、网络摄像头、电子天平），用3D打印制作夹具，由基于大语言模型的AI agent生成控制代码；将平台应用于双溶液混合体系合成ZIF-8。
AI.result: 产物呈白色悬浮相，XRD确认为ZIF-8；发现其粒径分布强烈依赖电动移液器分液速度——手工操作难以控制或记录的参数，且该依赖在重复实验中被重现。
AI.conclusion: 自动化的过程参数控制与记录可决定材料数据质量，该平台为实验室规模自动化实验的推广提供了可复现且公开共享的范例。

title: Thermally stimulated depolarization in hafnium oxide: experiment and numerical simulation
summary: This paper presents an experimental and theoretical study of thermally stimulated depolarization (TSD) in hafnium oxide. Three different models for the probability of trap ionization are considered: the Frenkel effect and two variants of the multiphonon trap ionization mechanism, the multiphonon ionization mechanism of isolated traps at low trap concentrations and phonon-assisted tunneling between neighboring traps at high trap concentrations. The best agreement between the TSD experiment and theory is observed for the multiphonon ionization mechanism of isolated traps. Similar thermal energies of electron and hole traps in HfO2 are obtained ~ 1.3 eV.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验与理论研究了氧化铪中的热刺激退极化，比较三种陷阱电离模型，发现孤立陷阱的多声子电离机制与实验最吻合，电子和空穴陷阱热激活能约为1.3 eV。
AI.motivation: 氧化铪（HfO2）中的陷阱电离机制尚不明确，需要厘清哪种模型能准确描述其热刺激退极化行为。
AI.method: 结合热刺激退极化（TSD）实验与理论计算，对比三种陷阱电离概率模型：Frenkel效应，以及多声子陷阱电离机制的两种变体（低陷阱浓度下的孤立陷阱多声子电离、高陷阱浓度下的相邻陷阱间声子辅助隧穿）。
AI.result: 孤立陷阱的多声子电离机制与TSD实验结果吻合最佳；测得HfO2中电子与空穴陷阱的热激活能相近，约为1.3 eV。
AI.conclusion: HfO2中陷阱电离主要由孤立陷阱的多声子电离机制主导，且电子与空穴陷阱具有相近的热激活能（~1.3 eV）。

title: Multiple Linear Regression-Enhanced RGB-based Luminescence Thermometry for High-sensitivity Thermal Readout
summary: The practical implementation of phosphors for luminescence-based thermal sensing and imaging requires simple, user-friendly approaches that enable convenient and sensitive temperature readout. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of combining RGB-based thermal imaging using a conventional digital camera with multiple linear regression (MLR) to achieve straightforward and highly sensitive temperature determination and spatially resolved thermal imaging. Importantly, the implementation of the MLR approach enhances the relative sensitivity by more than 3-fold, compared with conventional analysis based solely on the G/R or B/R intensity ratios. The application of Ca3Al2O6:Mn2+-Ce3+ as a luminescent temperature probe, in which the intensity ratio between the Ce3+ and Mn2+ emission bands exhibits a pronounced temperature dependence, enables temperature readout through several complementary approaches. These include conventional luminescence intensity ratio thermometry (SR = 1.46% K-1), analysis of the CIE 1931 chromaticity coordinates (SRx = 0.45% K-1 and SRy = 0.14% K-1), as well as RGB-based thermal sensing and imaging using a digital camera. This multimodal optical response, together with the accessibility of camera-based readout and the substantial sensitivity enhancement enabled by MLR, establishes a practical strategy for spatially resolved luminescence thermometry.

AI.tldr: 首次将数码相机的RGB热成像与多元线性回归(MLR)相结合，实现简便、高灵敏的温度测定与空间分辨热成像，灵敏度较传统G/R或B/R比值法提升3倍以上。
AI.motivation: 基于发光的温度传感与成像在实用化中需要简单、易用且灵敏的温度读出方法。传统基于单一强度比的分析灵敏度有限，作者希望借助数码相机RGB成像结合MLR实现更简便、更灵敏的温度读取。
AI.method: 以Ca3Al2O6:Mn2+-Ce3+作为发光温度探针，其Ce3+与Mn2+发射带强度比具显著温度依赖性；采用传统发光强度比测温、CIE 1931色坐标分析，以及数码相机RGB热成像结合多元线性回归(MLR)进行温度读出与空间分辨成像。
AI.result: 传统发光强度比测温SR=1.46% K-1，色坐标分析SRx=0.45% K-1、SRy=0.14% K-1；引入MLR后相对灵敏度较仅基于G/R或B/R比值的方法提升3倍以上，并可通过数码相机实现空间分辨热成像。
AI.conclusion: 该多模态光学响应、相机读出的便捷性及MLR带来的显著灵敏度提升，为空间分辨发光测温提供了一种实用策略。

title: Re4+ Luminescence as a Highly Sensitive Alternative to Ruby for Optical Pressure Sensing
summary: Luminescence-based remote pressure sensing provides a powerful approach for pressure determination under conditions where conventional contact methods are difficult to implement. Although ruby remains the undisputed gold standard among luminescent pressure indicators, its relatively low pressure sensitivity and susceptibility to temperature variations represent important limitations. Therefore, in this work, Cs2HfCl6:Re4+ is proposed as an alternative luminescent pressure indicator exhibiting a 15-fold higher pressure sensitivity (6.93 nm GPa-1) than ruby while maintaining a comparable thermal sensitivity, making it a particularly attractive material for optical manometry. Furthermore, Cs2HfCl6:Re4+ enables ratiometric pressure readout, providing a high relative pressure sensitivity reaching 175.1% GPa-1. To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the first demonstration of Re4+ luminescence for pressure sensing, introducing a new class of luminescent pressure indicators and opening new opportunities for the development of highly sensitive optical manometers based on Re4+-activated materials.

AI.tldr: 提出Cs2HfCl6:Re4+作为新型发光压力指示材料，压力灵敏度比红宝石高15倍，并首次实现Re4+发光压力传感。
AI.motivation: 远程发光压力传感适用于常规接触法难以实施的场景，但红宝石虽为标准材料，却存在压力灵敏度低、易受温度影响等局限，亟需更高灵敏度的替代材料。
AI.method: 采用Cs2HfCl6:Re4+作为发光压力指示材料，利用其Re4+发光特性进行压力检测，并实现比率型压力读出。
AI.result: Cs2HfCl6:Re4+的压力灵敏度为6.93 nm GPa-1，约为红宝石的15倍，同时保持相当的热灵敏度；比率型读出相对压力灵敏度达175.1% GPa-1。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次展示Re4+发光用于压力传感，开辟了基于Re4+激活材料的高灵敏光学压力计新方向。

title: Ionic-Radius Mismatch as a Structural Lever for Tuning Phase Transitions and Luminescent Thermometry
summary: The widespread implementation of luminescence thermometers requires a comprehensive understanding of the structural factors governing their thermometric performance. Establishing such structure-property relationships is essential for the rational design of sensing materials with application-tailored characteristics. This is particularly relevant for phase-transition-based luminescence thermometers, which offer exceptionally high relative sensitivities. The systematic analysis of K3Lu(PO4)2:Eu3+ demonstrates that introducing co-dopant ions with a controlled ionic-radius mismatch provides an effective strategy for tailoring phase-transition characteristics. This approach enables both the phase-transition temperature and thermal operating range to be controlled. Specifically, the transition temperature shifts from 210 K for K3Lu(PO4)2:Eu3+ to 310 K for K3Lu(PO4)2:Eu3+,10%La3+, while the operating range broadens from 30 to 60 K. Importantly, linear correlations between the ionic-radius mismatch parameter, Ω, and the phase-transition temperature, enthalpy, and entropy provide a quantitative framework for controlling the thermodynamics of the transition through compositional engineering. Beyond luminescence thermometry, these relationships establish a general strategy for designing materials exhibiting first-order phase transitions with tailored thermodynamic characteristics, opening opportunities for their optimization across a broad range of functional applications.

AI.tldr: 通过引入离子半径失配的共掺杂离子调控相变型发光温度计的相变温度与工作范围，建立成分-热力学定量关系。
AI.motivation: 相变型发光温度计相对灵敏度极高，但其热测量性能受结构因素影响，缺乏系统的结构-性能关系，阻碍了按需设计传感材料。
AI.method: 系统分析K3Lu(PO4)2:Eu3+，引入具有可控离子半径失配的共掺杂离子（如La3+），研究其相变特性，并用离子半径失配参数Ω关联相变热力学量。
AI.result: 相变温度从K3Lu(PO4)2:Eu3+的210 K升至K3Lu(PO4)2:Eu3+,10%La3+的310 K，工作范围由30 K拓宽至60 K；Ω与相变温度、焓、熵呈线性相关。
AI.conclusion: 提供通过组分工程定量调控相变热力学的框架，并可作为设计具有定制热力学特性一级相变材料的通用策略。

title: Demonstrate of High-Performance Top-Gate ALD Crystalline In2O3 Transistor Enabled by Lattice-Matched HfO2 and In2O3 Heterostructure
summary: In this work, we demonstrate high-mobility top-gate (TG) atomic-layer-deposited (ALD) crystalline In2O3 transistors through simultaneous interface and crystallinity engineering. First, a HfO2/In2O3/HfO2 stack is employed, enabling epitaxial-like crystallization of the ultrathin In2O3 channel, because of the lattice matching between monoclinic phase HfO2 and cubic phase In2O3. Second, an oxygen-rich gate insulator process is applied using high-dose O3 precursor and elevated deposition temperature, effectively suppressing oxygen scavenging during gate dielectric deposition, significantly reducing interfacial defect formation. Third, the homogeneous In-O bonding network in crystalline In2O3 exhibits substantially enhanced resistance to oxygen scavenging by source/drain contacts, which significantly improves the immunity to threshold voltage (VTH) roll-off at short channel length compared to amorphous In2O3. As a result, high-performance TG long-channel In2O3 transistors are achieved with a high mobility of 163 cm2/V s and a steep subthreshold slope of 64 mV/dec. High-performance TG short-channel In2O3 transistors with high ION of 1650 μA/μm at VD of 1 V, large on/off ratio over 1010 and VTH of -0.27 V are demonstrated. These results establish lattice-engineered crystalline In2O3 as an effective strategy for high-mobility, aggressively scaled TG oxide transistors suitable for BEOL-compatible applications.

AI.tldr: 通过界面与结晶度协同工程实现高迁移率顶栅ALD晶态In2O3晶体管。
AI.motivation: 面向BEOL兼容应用，需要高迁移率、可微缩的顶栅氧化物晶体管，而晶态In2O3的界面缺陷与氧清除问题制约性能。
AI.method: 采用HfO2/In2O3/HfO2叠层诱导外延式结晶；用高剂量O3与高温工艺制备富氧栅绝缘层抑制氧清除；利用晶态均一In-O网络增强抗源漏接触氧清除能力。
AI.result: 长沟道器件迁移率163 cm²/V·s、亚阈摆幅64 mV/dec；短沟道器件ION达1650 μA/μm（VD=1 V）、开关比>10¹⁰、VTH=-0.27 V。
AI.conclusion: 晶格工程化晶态In2O3是高性能、可微缩顶栅氧化物晶体管的有效策略。

title: Navigating Sparse Singlet Fission Chemical Space: An Intelligent Generative-Predictive Paradigm
summary: Singlet fission (SF) offers a promising route to surpass the Shockley-Queisser limit by converting a photoexcited singlet exciton into two triplet excitons, thereby enhancing photovoltaic energy conversion efficiency. However, realizing efficient SF process requires stringent energetic requirements among low-lying excited states that render SF molecules intrinsically rare within the vast chemical space. This extreme sparsity presents a grand challenge for molecular discovery. Due to low hit rates and trial-and-error computational waste on nonviable structures, conventional high-throughput virtual screening faces significant constraints, even when accelerated by machine learning models. Here, we establish a synergistic generative-predictive framework for the targeted inverse design of SF molecules by integrating a structure generator, a properties predictor and a multi-criteria validation workflow. By continuously coupling generative exploration with SF predictive models, the framework progressively enriches SF species and achieves a success rate of approximately 90% in generating molecules that satisfy the target SF energetic criteria. High-throughput evaluation of about 100 million generated structures with time-dependent density functional theory (TDDFT) validation of just a random 1% subset confirmed a 90.8% success rate for SF candidates. All together, we constructed an SF database of 283,559 candidates with favorable energetics of excited states and synthetic accessibility. From it, we identified a key fragment strongly associated with the requirements for SF, namely, CN([O])N(C)[O]. These findings establish an efficient route for overcoming the sparsity difficulty in SF molecular discovery and provide interpretable design principles for the development of novel excited-state functional materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成-预测协同的逆向设计框架，高效发现单线态裂分（SF）分子，成功率达约90%。
AI.motivation: SF可突破Shockley-Queisser极限提升光伏效率，但其对低激发态能量有苛刻要求，导致SF分子在化学空间中极为稀少。传统高通量筛选命中率低、算力浪费大，即使有机器学习加速也受限。
AI.method: 整合结构生成器、性质预测器与多准则验证流程的生成-预测协同框架，将生成探索与SF预测模型连续耦合，逐步富集SF物种；对约1亿个生成结构进行高通量评估，并随机抽取1%用TDDFT验证。
AI.result: 生成分子满足目标SF能量准则的成功率约90%，TDDFT验证1%子集确认成功率为90.8%；构建了含283,559个具备有利激发态能量与合成可行性候选分子的SF数据库，并识别出与SF需求强相关的关键片段CN([O])N(C)[O]。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效克服了SF分子发现中的稀疏性难题，并提供了可解释的设计原则，助力新型激发态功能材料的开发。

title: Evaluating Predicted Densities, Hamiltonians, and Density Matrices as Periodic SCF Initializers
summary: Learned electronic states are usually evaluated by prediction error, even though their intended use is to accelerate the self-consistent-field (SCF) loop of density functional theory (DFT). We ask whether lower offline error actually yields a better SCF initializer. We construct $ρ$HD-43K, a 43,851-crystal DFT corpus with aligned charge-density, Hamiltonian, and density-matrix labels, and extend the solver workflow to inject all three predicted states. The closed-loop benchmark compares direct converged-state prediction against residual prediction from solver-native references on a frozen test set of non-magnetic crystals, using paired convergence, iteration, and SCF-loop timing measurements. Injecting the exact converged density matrix or Hamiltonian as an oracle upper bound cuts the median SCF count from 16 to one, revealing substantial acceleration headroom. Among learned inputs, direct charge-density prediction (Charge3Net-E3) accelerates about 91% of paired crystals, saves a median of three SCF iterations, and yields a $1.18\times$ SCF-loop speedup. In contrast, the tested residual-density and matrix initializers do not consistently improve over the standard superposition-of-atomic-densities baseline. These results establish that target-space accuracy alone is insufficient: a learned initializer must also be compatible with the nonlinear solver trajectory, and its utility must be measured in the loop.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑"离线预测误差越低越好"的假设，构建43,851晶体DFT语料ρHD-43K并在闭环SCF中评测，发现只有直接电荷密度预测能稳定加速SCF，而离线精度与求解器轨迹兼容性并不一致。
AI.motivation: 学习的电子态通常以预测误差评价，但其真正用途是加速DFT的自洽场（SCF）循环。作者追问：更低的离线误差是否真能带来更好的SCF初始化？需要建立闭环评测来验证精度与实用加速之间的关系。
AI.method: 构建ρHD-43K语料（43,851个晶体，含对齐的电荷密度、哈密顿量、密度矩阵标签），扩展求解器工作流以注入三类预测态。在非磁性晶体冻结测试集上做闭环基准，对比"直接预测收敛态"与"从求解器原生参考做残差预测"，采用配对收敛、迭代次数与SCF循环计时测量，并以精确收敛密度矩阵/哈密顿量作oracle上界。
AI.result: 注入精确收敛的密度矩阵或哈密顿量将中位SCF次数从16降到1，显示巨大加速空间；直接电荷密度预测（Charge3Net-E3）使约91%配对晶体加速，中位节省3次SCF迭代，SCF循环加速1.18×；而残差密度与矩阵初始化器未能稳定超越标准叠加原子密度基线。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠目标空间精度不足以衡量初始化器价值：学习到的初始化器必须与非线性求解器轨迹兼容，其效用必须在SCF循环内测量。

title: A cylindrical sintering method for more realistic grain boundaries in nanocrystalline thin films
summary: Discrepancies between simulated and experimental mechanical properties in molecular dynamics simulations of nanocrystalline metals typically arise from the sample-construction method and the interatomic potential choice. We introduce a cylindrical sintering method to generate nanocrystalline aluminum thin-film samples with wider, more disordered grain boundaries than the usual Voronoi tessellation method, while maintaining deterministic control over grain size, shape, and orientation. Cylindrical sintered samples are benchmarked against hexagonal Voronoi references under identical conditions using both the classical Pascuet15 MEAM and tabGAP machine-learning potentials. Cylindrical sintered samples consistently show lower mechanical properties than hexagonal Voronoi samples due to their wider, more disordered grain boundaries - an effect independent of the choice of potential. Notably, changing the sample geometry and changing the interatomic potential produce comparable, additive, and independent shifts in predicted properties, highlighting that future molecular dynamics studies must hold both variables fixed for meaningful comparisons. Common neighbor and dislocation extraction analyses confirm that deformation is dominated by grain-boundary-mediated plasticity. Uniaxial tensile tests reveal an inverse Hall-Petch relationship for both sample types and both potentials, with mechanical properties decreasing monotonically as grain size reduces from 40.34 to 4.84 nm. The cylindrical sintering method offers a physically realistic, geometrically controlled alternative that bridges idealized Voronoi models and disordered experimental grain-boundary structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“圆柱烧结法”构建纳米晶铝薄膜样品，获得更宽、更无序的晶界，并与传统Voronoi方法在两种势函数下进行基准对比。
AI.motivation: 分子动力学模拟与实验力学性能存在差异，主要源于样品构建方法和原子间势函数的选择，需厘清两者影响。
AI.method: 采用圆柱烧结法生成可控晶粒尺寸/形状/取向的纳米晶铝薄膜，与六边形Voronoi参考样品在相同条件下对比，使用Pascuet15 MEAM和tabGAP机器学习势，结合共近邻与位错提取分析及单轴拉伸。
AI.result: 烧结样品因晶界更宽更无序而力学性能更低，该效应与势函数无关；几何与势函数带来相当、可叠加且独立的性能偏移；两类样品、两种势均呈现反Hall-Petch关系（晶粒40.34→4.84 nm性能单调下降）。
AI.conclusion: 未来MD研究须同时固定样品几何与势函数才能进行有意义比较；圆柱烧结法提供了兼顾物理真实性与几何可控性的替代方案。

title: Optical properties of As2Se3 from first principles
summary: Crystalline As2Se3 is a promising layered chalcogenide for mid-infrared photonics and optoelectronic applications, yet its fundamental electronic and optical properties remain debated. This paper combines density functional theory with G0W0 quasiparticle corrections and Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) calculations to deliver a robust description of its band structure and optical response. The G0W0 results reveal an indirect band gap of 2.31 eV with nearly degenerate direct transitions at Gamma, while the BSE spectra exhibit strong polarization-dependent anisotropy and pronounced excitonic effects. Several bound excitons are identified near the absorption onset, clarifying the role of electron-hole interactions and resolving previous controversies regarding the nature of the optical gap and the contribution of lone-pair states. This work provides a unified and quantitatively accurate picture of As2Se3, reinforcing its potential for next-generation infrared and anisotropic photonic devices.

AI.tldr: 本论文通过 DFT+G0W0+BSE 方法系统研究了 As2Se3 的能带结构与光学响应，给出间接带隙 2.31 eV 并揭示强激子效应与偏振各向异性。
AI.motivation: 晶体 As2Se3 在中红外光子学和光电子学中具有潜力，但其基本电子与光学性质仍存在争议，需要统一且定量准确的描述。
AI.method: 结合密度泛函理论（DFT）、G0W0 准粒子修正与 Bethe-Salpeter 方程（BSE）进行能带结构和光学响应计算。
AI.result: G0W0 给出 2.31 eV 的间接带隙及 Gamma 点近简并的直接跃迁；BSE 光谱显示强偏振各向异性和显著激子效应，在吸收边附近识别出多个束缚激子。
AI.conclusion: 该工作澄清了光学带隙性质及孤对电子态贡献的争议，提供统一准确的 As2Se3 图像，支撑其在下一代红外与各向异性光子器件中的应用。

title: From bending to stretching driven peeling of heterogeneous adhesives
summary: We study theoretically the peeling behavior of adhesives. Adopting a fracture mechanics approach, we derive the equation of motion of the adhesion front propagating at the interface between the adhesive and the substrate from which the peel strength is inferred. The originality of our approach lies in the description of the interplay during peeling between the stretching and the bending modes of deformation of the adhesive that is described as a F{\''o}ppl-Von Karman's thin film. Considering first a straight adhesion front, we retrieve the most salient feature of homogeneous adhesives, namely a peeling angle dependent peel strength driven by bending at large angles and by stretching at low angles. We also derive the shape of the adhesive that can be described using a single bending length scale derived from our model. We then investigate the impact of adhesion heterogeneities. We evidence that the deformations of the adhesion front are governed by a non-local interface elasticity the strength of which decreases with the peeling angle. This phenomenon reflects the transition between a stretching dominated peeling at low angle to a bending driven peeling at large angles that is captured in our model. This transition impacts the stability of adhesive fronts that relaxe more slowly from perturbations and gives rise to a stronger toughening effect in presence of a disorder distribution of adhesion energy at low peeling angles. Overall, this study sheds light on the central role played the elastic deformations of adhesives on their peeling behavior. The proposed framework unfolds the complex interplay between the deformation of adhesives and the peeling driving force that may be leveraged to engineer heterogeneous adhesives with enhanced properties. It also provides rich insights on the mechanisms underlying the emergence of non-local elasticity in interface problems.

AI.tldr: 本文用断裂力学方法理论研究了粘合剂的剥离行为，将粘合剂建模为Föppl-Von Kármán薄膜，揭示其拉伸与弯曲变形模式的耦合对剥离强度及界面异质性的影响。
AI.motivation: 均质粘合剂剥离强度依赖剥离角（大角度由弯曲主导、小角度由拉伸主导）是已知特征，但粘合剂的弹性变形与剥离驱动力之间的复杂相互作用、以及异质界面下的行为机制尚不清楚，需要统一的理论框架加以描述。
AI.method: 采用断裂力学方法，将粘合剂描述为Föppl-Von Kármán薄膜，推导粘附前沿的运动方程以推断剥离强度。先分析直线粘附前沿，再引入粘附异质性，研究前沿变形、非局域界面弹性及其随剥离角的变化。
AI.result: 直线前沿情形下重现了均质粘合剂剥离强度随角度变化的特征（大角度弯曲主导、小角度拉伸主导），并用单一弯曲长度尺度描述粘合剂形状。存在异质性时，粘附前沿变形由非局域界面弹性控制，其强度随剥离角减小；该现象反映拉伸主导到弯曲主导的转变，并影响前沿稳定性——扰动后弛豫更慢，小剥离角下无序粘附能分布带来更强增韧效应。
AI.conclusion: 粘合剂弹性变形对其剥离行为起核心作用。所提框架揭示了变形与剥离驱动力的复杂耦合，可用于设计具增强性能的异质粘合剂，并为界面问题中非局域弹性的产生机制提供新见解。

title: Gate-tunable magnetic damping in van der Waals Heterostructures
summary: Active control of magnetic damping is a crucial capability for the development of low-power, tunable spintronic devices. In this work, we demonstrate that the intrinsic magnetic damping of 2D materials is highly sensitive to the position of the Fermi level relative to spin-orbit driven anti-crossings, or ``spin hot spots.'' Starting from a minimal multi-band model evaluated via Kamberský's breathing Fermi surface theory, we elucidate the fundamental role that energy gaps and band alignment play in governing magnetic dissipation. We then translate these theoretical insights to van der Waals heterostructures, proposing a concrete mechanism for strongly tunable magnetic damping via electrostatic gating. This concept is validated from first principles via density functional theory calculations on a realistic Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$/graphene heterostructure. Our calculations reveal that an out-of-plane electric field selectively shifts the relevant energy bands, enabling the modulation of the heterostructure's magnetic damping over several orders of magnitude. These findings establish a robust theoretical framework and a promising materials platform for electrically tunable magnetization dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论模型和第一性原理计算，揭示了二维材料本征磁阻尼对费米能级与自旋轨道反交叉（"自旋热点"）相对位置的敏感性，并提出通过静电门控在范德华异质结中实现磁阻尼的可调控制。
AI.motivation: 低功耗、可调谐自旋电子器件的发展亟需对磁阻尼进行主动控制，但如何有效调控二维材料本征磁阻尼仍缺乏理论指导。
AI.method: 从最小多带模型出发，结合Kamberský呼吸费米面理论分析能隙与能带排列对磁耗散的作用；再将理论推广至范德华异质结，并通过Fe₃GeTe₂/石墨烯异质结的密度泛函理论计算进行验证。
AI.result: 面外电场可选择性地移动相关能带，使异质结磁阻尼实现数个数量级的调制；磁阻尼强烈依赖于费米能级相对自旋热点的位置。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了电可调磁化动力学的理论框架，并提供了一种有前景的材料平台，为可调谐自旋电子器件设计提供了依据。

title: The Case Against Hall-Petch Hardening in High Entropy Carbide Ceramics
summary: Grain size is often used with the Hall-Petch relationship to justify differences in hardness in ceramic materials. Herein, hardness does not vary systematically with grain-size for fully dense, single-phase (Cr,Mo,Ta,V,W)C1-δ high entropy carbide ceramics for grain sizes that varied by a factor of three. Fully dense, single-phase ceramics with grain sizes from 9.3+/-0.3 to 28.8+/-0.7 microns exhibited a pronounced indentation size effect, with Vickers hardness decreasing from ~28-30 GPa at 0.49 N to ~20-21 GPa at 9.81 N, and Berkovich nanohardness ranging from 26 to 30 GPa at 10 mN. However, at a given load, hardness remained within a narrow range across the grain-size series, and no consistent Hall-Petch dependence was resolved. The lack of grain-size dependence likely indicates that the deformation volume sampled by the indenter was not controlled by grain-boundary interactions; instead, hardness was governed primarily by indentation load and local response of the rock salt carbide matrix.

AI.tldr: 本文研究(Cr,Mo,Ta,V,W)C高熵碳化物陶瓷的硬度与晶粒尺寸关系，发现晶粒尺寸变化三倍时硬度无系统变化，不遵循Hall-Petch关系，硬度主要由压痕载荷和碳化物基本地响应决定。
AI.motivation: 晶粒尺寸常被用Hall-Petch关系解释陶瓷材料硬度差异，作者希望验证此关系是否适用于高熵碳化物陶瓷。
AI.method: 制备完全致密、单相的(Cr,Mo,Ta,V,W)C1-δ高熵碳化物陶瓷，晶粒尺寸从9.3±0.3到28.8±0.7微米（变化约三倍），进行维氏硬度（0.49–9.81 N）和Berkovich纳米压痕（10 mN）测试。
AI.result: 观察到明显的压痕尺寸效应：维氏硬度从0.49 N时的~28–30 GPa降至9.81 N时的~20–21 GPa，纳米硬度为26–30 GPa。但在给定载荷下，硬度随晶粒尺寸变化范围很窄，未呈现一致的Hall-Petch依赖。
AI.conclusion: 硬度无晶粒尺寸依赖性，表明压痕取样变形体积不受晶界交互控制，硬度主要受压痕载荷和岩盐结构碳化物基体的局部响应支配。

title: Twin Domains in Van der Waals Quaternary Oxides
summary: Optical anisotropy is the basis for many intriguing phenomena in van der Waals materials, including hyperbolic polaritons and extreme birefringence. Stacking and twisting van der Waals materials along the out-of-plane direction emerged as a powerful route to tailor this anisotropy, but designing lateral interfaces remains a challenge. Here, twin domains are reported in the van der Waals quaternary oxides MgTeMoO$_6$, MnTeMoO$_6$, ZnTeMoO$_6$, and CoTeMoO$_6$ - materials that possess strong in-plane optical anisotropy and second-order nonlinearity. The domains naturally form in their orthorhombic crystal structure and extend over hundreds of micrometers. It is proposed that this stability is achieved by the domain wall acting as a diagonal mirror plane in the crystal structure, parallel to the (1-10) or (110) crystal planes, resulting in nearly opposite birefringence between domains. This hypothesis is experimentally confirmed by determining the angle between the crystal axes of neighboring domains using polarization-resolved optical microscopy, infrared-visible sum-frequency generation microscopy, and transmission electron microscopy. The latter further allowed an estimate of the domain wall thickness. Overall, the observation of twin domains with orthogonal optical anisotropy opens new routes to use van der Waals quaternary oxides for birefringent waveguiding, polariton steering, and frequency conversion applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文报道了四种钒德华四元氧化物(Mg/Mn/Zn/Co)TeMoO₆中自然形成的孪晶畴，畴壁沿(1-10)/(110)镜面，使相邻畴具有近乎相反的平面内双折射，为横向光学各向异性调控提供新途径。
AI.motivation: 钒德华材料的光学各向异性可通过堆叠和扭转进行面外调控，但横向(面内)界面的设计仍是难题。作者希望找到一种能自然形成横向界面并调控面内光学各向异性的材料体系。
AI.method: 在正交晶系的四元氧化物MgTeMoO₆、MnTeMoO₆、ZnTeMoO₆、CoTeMoO₆中观察孪晶畴；提出畴壁作为对角线镜面（平行于(1-10)或(110)晶面）的假设；利用偏振分辨光学显微、红外-可见和频产生显微和透射电子显微镜确定相邻畴晶轴夹角并估算畴壁厚度。
AI.result: 孪晶畴在正交结构中自然形成并延伸数百微米；畴壁充当晶体内对角线镜面，导致相邻畴间双折射近乎相反；实验通过三种手段确认了相邻畴晶轴的夹角，TEM还给出畴壁厚度估计。
AI.conclusion: 具有正交光学各向异性的孪晶畴为钒德华四元氧化物在双折射波导、极化激元操控和频率转换等应用开辟了新路径。

title: Freestanding Antiferromagnetic Oxide Membranes: Synthesis and Characterization of Cr$_2$O$_3$
summary: Antiferromagnetic (AFM) insulators stand out as a promising class of materials for fast switching, energy-efficient magnon-based technology, but our understanding of how to tune these properties with the lattice remains limited. As an AFM insulator with strong magnetoelectric response, Cr$_2$O$_3$ membranes stand out as a promising platform to explore multi-modal tunability via strain. However, fabricating these membranes is challenging due to the scarcity of etchable sacrificial layers with compatible lattice constants and sufficient surface quality. We address this issue by utilizing La$_{0.7}$Sr$_{0.3}$MnO$_3$ (LSMO) as a sacrificial layer, enabling successful fabrication of millimeter-scale Cr$_2$O$_3$ membranes. Substrate-free characterization reveals that strain due to the lattice mismatch during growth is released by the formation of small polycrystalline domains, preserving single-crystalline order over ~90% of the membrane area. Bulk-like structural properties are confirmed by transmission electron microscopy, X-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, and second-harmonic generation spectroscopy. Platinum Hall measurements reveal an above-room-temperature N$é$el transition. These results establish Cr$_2$O$_3$ membranes as a viable platform for strain-tuning antiferromagnetism and magnetoelectricity.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用LSMO作为牺牲层，成功制备了毫米级Cr2O3反铁磁绝缘体薄膜，应变通过形成小多晶畴释放，约90%区域保持单晶序，并观察到高于室温的Néel转变，证明其是应变调控反铁磁性与磁电性的可行平台。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁绝缘体在快切换、低能耗磁振子技术中很有前景，但晶格对其性质的调控理解有限；Cr2O3具有强磁电响应，是应变多模态调控的理想平台，但缺乏合适的可刻蚀牺牲层导致薄膜制备困难。
AI.method: 采用La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 (LSMO)作为牺牲层，制备毫米级Cr2O3自支撑薄膜；通过TEM、XRD、拉曼光谱和二次谐波产生光谱表征结构，并用铂霍尔测量探测磁转变。
AI.result: 生长中的晶格失配应变通过形成小多晶畴释放，约90%薄膜面积保持单晶序，结构性质接近块体；观测到高于室温的Néel转变。
AI.conclusion: Cr2O3薄膜可作为应变调控反铁磁性和磁电性的可行平台，LSMO牺牲层策略解决了自支撑薄膜制备难题。

title: Microstructure-Resolved Impedance Modeling of Solid-State Batteries
summary: Solid-state batteries (SSBs) with solid electrolytes (SEs) are attracting substantial investment from the automotive industry to enable fast-charging and safer next-generation electric vehicles. The microstructure of the SE critically affects the battery performance. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) is a powerful, non-destructive probe of charge-transfer and transport processes within SEs and across electrode/SE interfaces but quantitatively connecting measured impedance spectra to the underlying microstructural features remains an open modeling challenge. Here we present a modeling framework that predicts the microstructure-resolved impedance response of a Li/Li6PS5Cl/Li symmetric cell. Taking the Li6PS5Cl SE microstructures from phase-field sintering simulations, we find that increasing porosity shifts the Nyquist semicircle to higher impedance while improved inter-particle contact reduces it, and that impedance decreases monotonically as sintering proceeds. We also isolate the effect of solid electrolyte interphase (SEI) formation: grain boundaries raise impedance only slightly, but SEI volume fraction, and the conductivity of each SEI phase (Li2S, Li3P, LiCl), both strongly affect it. A realistic multi-phase SEI increases interfacial impedance by about two orders of magnitude compared with a grain boundary only network. We further demonstrate that the same pipeline can operate directly on experimental micrographs by extracting pixel-level phase information with AI-assisted image segmentation and using it to predict an impedance spectrum, illustrating a path toward quantitative microstructure-impedance correlations grounded in real, imaged SE microstructures.

AI.tldr: 提出一个预测锂/硫银锗矿/锂电池微观结构解析阻抗响应的建模框架，连接微观结构与EIS谱，并可处理实验显微图。
AI.motivation: 固态电池性能受固态电解质（SE）微观结构强烈影响，EIS是强大的无损表征手段，但将阻抗谱定量关联到微观结构仍是未解决的建模难题。
AI.method: 基于相场烧结模拟获取Li6PS5Cl微观结构，构建微观结构解析的阻抗模型；隔离晶界与SEI（Li2S、Li3P、LiCl多相）影响；并用AI图像分割从实验显微图提取像素级相信息以预测阻抗谱。
AI.result: 孔隙率增加使Nyquist半圆向高阻抗移动，颗粒接触改善降低阻抗，烧结进行阻抗单调下降；晶界仅略微升高阻抗，而SEI体积分数及各相电导强烈影响阻抗，真实多相SEI使界面阻抗升高约两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可从模拟及真实成像的SE微观结构出发，建立定量的微观结构-阻抗关联，推动SE微观结构解析的阻抗预测。

title: High-Temperature Hydrogen Sensors Based on Gallium Oxide Heterojunction Diodes
summary: Long-term, high temperature operation of Ga2O3 devices is a crucial hurdle that must be overcome before widespread adoption of the technology can be achieved, but is largely absent from the overall body of work. Demonstrations up to this point show devices are either limited by material or dopant instability that leads to performance degradation with time. Herein, Ga2O3-based hydrogen sensors employing Pt Schottky and Cr2O3/Ga2O3 p-n diodes (Mg- and N-doped) were fabricated and evaluated for long-term stability at 600C for 800-1,800 hours, with cyclic exposure to N2 and low-concentration H2 (500-1,500 ppm). Transient current density (measured at -0.1 V) and periodic J-V characterization were used to track performance. Despite gradual declines in sensor signal and sensitivity, devices distinguished hydrogen concentrations throughout weeks of operation. Degradation was architecture-dependent: Cr2O3:Mg degraded gradually, consistent with known Mg migration; the Pt Schottky diode showed dramatic changes after 1,000 hours; and Cr2O3:N showed the lowest but most stable performance before failing at 800 hours. Thermionic emission and Lambert W-based modeling confirmed hydrogen exposure reduces interfacial barrier height via a proton-induced dipole mechanism common to both diode types. TEM of aged Pt Schottky diodes revealed Pt grain growth and microvoid formation as key degradation mechanisms. TOF-SIMS confirmed nitrogen dopants remain confined to the Cr2O3:N layer, supporting N-doping as a stable, lower-performance alternative to Mg-doping

AI.tldr: 本文制备了Pt肖特基和Cr2O3/Ga2O3 p-n二极管氢传感器，在600°C、800-1800小时内循环暴露于N2和低浓度H2（500-1500 ppm）下评估长期稳定性。器件虽性能逐渐衰减，但在数周运行中仍能区分氢气浓度。退化机制与结构相关：Mg掺杂迁移、Pt晶粒生长和微孔形成是主要退化原因，而N掺杂稳定性更好。
AI.motivation: Ga2O3器件的长期高温运行是实现该技术广泛应用的关键障碍，但目前相关研究严重不足。已有器件普遍受材料或掺杂剂不稳定性影响，性能随时间退化。因此，亟需研究Ga2O3基氢传感器在高温下的长期稳定性及其退化机制。
AI.method: 制备Pt肖特基二极管和Cr2O3/Ga2O3 p-n二极管（Mg掺杂和N掺杂）氢传感器，在600°C下进行800-1800小时循环暴露测试（N2与500-1500 ppm H2交替）。通过瞬态电流密度（-0.1 V下测量）和周期性J-V表征跟踪性能。采用热电子发射和Lambert W模型分析势垒变化，利用TEM观察老化Pt肖特基二极管，TOF-SIMS分析掺杂剂分布。
AI.result: 器件在整个数周运行中仍能区分氢气浓度，尽管信号和灵敏度逐渐下降。退化具有结构依赖性：Cr2O3:Mg逐渐退化（与Mg迁移一致）；Pt肖特基二极管在1000小时后发生剧烈变化；Cr2O3:N性能最低但最稳定，800小时后失效。建模确认氢气暴露通过质子诱导偶极机制降低界面势垒高度。TEM显示Pt晶粒生长和微孔形成是Pt肖特基二极管的关键退化机制。TOF-SIMS证实N掺杂剂仍局限于Cr2O3:N层内。
AI.conclusion: Ga2O3基氢传感器在600°C高温下可长期运行，但性能退化与器件结构密切相关。N掺杂相比Mg掺杂具有更好的热稳定性，是稳定但性能较低的替代方案。研究揭示了质子诱导偶极机制及Pt晶粒生长、微孔形成等退化机制，为高温Ga2O3器件设计提供了重要指导。

title: An Open-Source Hardware and Software Toolkit to Enable Agentic RHEED-Guided Thin-Film Synthesis
summary: Reflection high-energy electron diffraction (RHEED) provides rich information about evolving surfaces during thin-film growth, but non-automated, operator-dependent alignment and fragmented analysis workflows limit its potential in fully autonomous synthesis. Here, we present an open-source hardware and software toolkit that makes RHEED control and quantitative analysis accessible to operators and artificial intelligence (AI) agents. Demonstrated on a pulsed laser deposition system, the toolkit provides programmable electron-optics control, automated beam alignment and rocking-curve acquisition, and a training-free method for crystallographic azimuthal alignment. The auto RHEED application extracts structural and growth-related observables through shared graphical and programmatic interfaces, including a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. An agent-driven demonstration shows how natural-language requests can guide the selection, configuration, and execution of quantitative analyses. An extensible adapter interface streamlines the incorporation of community-developed methods for AI analysis and RHEED simulation as they emerge, supported by Markdown implementation guides designed for AI coding agents. These capabilities support complementary descriptions of surface evolution through physical measurements and learned image representations while providing a practical route for incorporating new computational methods. Together, these tools reduce barriers to automated and agentic RHEED measurements and establish a foundation for future agentic control of thin-film synthesis guided by the evolving surface.

AI.tldr: 开源RHEED硬件与软件工具包，实现自动化束流对准、摇摆曲线采集与方位角校准，并通过MCP服务器支持AI智能体以自然语言驱动定量分析，推动薄膜生长的自主合成。
AI.motivation: RHEED能提供薄膜生长过程中表面演化的丰富信息，但依赖人工对准、流程碎片化，难以在完全自主合成中发挥作用。作者希望降低自动化与智能体化RHEED测量的门槛。
AI.method: 在脉冲激光沉积系统上演示的工具包，提供可编程电子光学控制、自动束流对准与摇摆曲线采集，以及免训练的晶体方位角对准方法。通过图形与编程接口（含MCP服务器）共享数据，设有可扩展适配器接口与面向AI编码智能体的Markdown实现指南。
AI.result: 智能体演示表明，自然语言请求可引导定量分析的选择、配置与执行；工具包支持物理测量与学习图像表示的互补描述，并便于纳入社区新方法（AI分析与RHEED模拟）。
AI.conclusion: 该工具包减少了自动化与智能体化RHEED测量的障碍，为未来由表面演化引导的智能体化薄膜合成控制奠定基础。
